topics.notes: 代行人身份的核实实务主要在第6单元；目前不强求同一规则在第3单元重复出题。

topics.topic: CDD触发门槛、延后核实及不能完成的后果
covered_aspects: 开户前、12万元非经常交易及8000元电传
怀疑及资料真伪/充分疑虑不受金额限
延后只限业务关系且须必要及风险受控
须尽快完成、不能完成应拒绝/终止

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before a transaction of $120,000 or more for a customer who has no business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 為與金錢服務經營者沒有業務關係的客戶執行涉及$120,000或以上款額的交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 為客戶執行屬電傳轉賬、涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before an occasional currency exchange of $8,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 為客戶執行涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）、屬貨幣兌換的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required when the MSO suspects the customer or its account of money laundering or terrorist financing, whatever the amount involved.
snapshot.tc: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑客戶或客戶的戶口涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，不論所涉款額多少，均須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained to identify or verify the customer.
snapshot.tc: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑過往為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: An MSO that verifies identity after establishing a business relationship must complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable afterwards.
snapshot.tc: 在建立業務關係之後才核實身分的金錢服務經營者，須在該關係建立之後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快完成核實。

snapshot.en: An MSO may verify identity after an occasional transaction of $120,000 or more if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
snapshot.tc: 如為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理，便可在$120,000或以上的非經常交易之後才核實客戶身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO that cannot carry out the required CDD measures for a customer must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with that customer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如不能夠就某客戶執行所需的客戶盡職審查措施，不可與該客戶建立業務關係，亦不可與該客戶執行任何非經常交易。

snapshot.en: An MSO with an existing business relationship that is unable to complete deferred verification must consider restricting or terminating that relationship.
snapshot.tc: 已與客戶建立業務關係的金錢服務經營者，如未能完成延後進行的身分核實，須考慮限制或結束與該客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: Verification may be put off until after a business relationship is established only if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
snapshot.tc: 只有在為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理時，才可延至建立業務關係之後核實身分。

topics.topic: 简化尽调：客户、产品和所有权链
covered_aspects: 简化豁免为实益人身份而非客户身份
怀疑时不得简化
持牌机构、上市公司、政府和投资工具适用
所有权链终止点
合资格退休、保险产品

snapshot.en: The customer is a corporation listed on any stock exchange, whether the exchange is in Hong Kong or elsewhere.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是在任何證券市場上市的法團，不論該證券市場位於香港或其他地方。

snapshot.en: The customer is another licensed money service operator, which the AMLO counts as a financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是另一持牌金錢服務經營者，即《打擊洗錢條例》所指的金融機構。

snapshot.en: The customer is the government of any jurisdiction outside Hong Kong, whether an equivalent jurisdiction or otherwise.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是香港以外任何司法管轄區的政府，包括對等司法管轄區以外的司法管轄區。

snapshot.en: The product is a pension scheme insurance policy that contains no surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral.
snapshot.tc: 產品是為退休金計劃的目的而購買、不載有退回條款及不可用作抵押品的保險單。

snapshot.en: The product is a life insurance policy for which an annual premium of up to $20,000 is payable.
snapshot.tc: 產品是須繳付的每年保費在$20,000或以下的人壽保險單。

snapshot.en: The customer is a body in an equivalent jurisdiction that performs functions similar to those of a public body.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是在對等司法管轄區執行與公共機構的職能相類似的職能的機構。

evidence.covers: 适用触发及不能省略客户身份

snapshot.en: Before establishing a business relationship, an MSO may carry out simplified CDD if it has reasonable grounds to believe that the customer is of a listed kind.
snapshot.tc: 在與客戶建立業務關係之前，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信客戶屬所列的類別，便可執行簡化客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: An MSO may carry out simplified CDD for a listed customer even when it suspects the customer of involvement in money laundering or terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 即使金錢服務經營者懷疑某名所列客戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集，仍可就該客戶執行簡化客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: Under simplified CDD, the MSO may omit verifying the customer's identity, but must still identify and verify the identity of the customer's beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 在簡化客戶盡職審查下，金錢服務經營者可略去核實客戶的身分，但仍須識別及核實客戶的實益擁有人的身分。

snapshot.en: When establishing a business relationship with a customer outside the listed kinds, the MSO need not identify the beneficial owners of an entity of a listed kind in its ownership chain.
snapshot.tc: 與不屬所列類別的客戶建立業務關係時，如其實益擁有權鏈狀架構中有屬所列類別的實體，金錢服務經營者無需識別該實體的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: Before an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or more, an MSO may carry out simplified CDD if it has reasonable grounds to believe that the customer is of a listed kind.
snapshot.tc: 在執行涉及$8,000或以上款額的非經常電傳轉賬之前，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信客戶屬所列的類別，便可執行簡化客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: An investment vehicle is such a customer where a financial institution is the person responsible for carrying out measures similar to CDD measures in relation to all of its investors.
snapshot.tc: 如負責就某投資公司的所有投資者執行與客戶盡職審查措施相類似的措施的人屬金融機構，該投資公司即屬可執行簡化客戶盡職審查的此類客戶。

snapshot.en: The Government is such a customer, and any public body in Hong Kong is one as well, so a customer does not have to be a financial institution in order to qualify.
snapshot.tc: 政府屬此類客戶，任何香港的公共機構亦屬此類客戶，因此客戶即使並非金融機構，亦可屬可執行簡化客戶盡職審查的客戶。

snapshot.en: A scheme providing employees with retirement benefits, however it is described and funded by deductions from employment income, is such a product where its rules allow a member to assign his or her interest under it.
snapshot.tc: 向僱員提供退休福利的計劃（不論實際如何稱述），如供款是從受僱工作獲得的入息中扣減，且計劃規則准許成員轉讓其在計劃下的利益，即屬此類產品。

snapshot.en: Simplified CDD can rest on the product as well as the customer: in the same circumstances as for a listed customer, it may be carried out on reasonable grounds to believe the product related to the transaction is of a listed kind.
snapshot.tc: 簡化客戶盡職審查除可基於客戶外，亦可基於產品：在與所列客戶相同的情況中，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信與交易有關的產品屬所列的產品，便可執行該等審查。

snapshot.en: An institution set up in an equivalent jurisdiction and doing business similar to a financial institution's is such a customer if it also has measures to comply with requirements like Schedule 2's and is supervised for compliance there.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區成立為法團或設立、經營與金融機構相類似業務的機構，如亦設有措施確保類似附表2的規定獲遵從，並就其遵從情況受到當地主管當局監管，即屬此類客戶。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。
topics.notes: B31：法例上市公司条件与指引透明度要求分别成立。

topics.topic: 律师混合客户账户的简化尽调条件
covered_aspects: 账户以律师/律师行而非各客户名义开立
单一客户账户不等同混合账户豁免
missing_aspects: 豁免须客户金钱或证券混合存放，并由律师以客户代理人身份管理；仅开户名义不足

evidence.covers: 开户名义及单一客户边界

snapshot.en: One of the criteria allowing an MSO to apply SDD to the beneficial owners of a solicitor's client account is that the account is kept in the names of the solicitor's clients.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可就律師的當事人戶口執行有關實益擁有人的簡化客戶盡職審查的準則之一，是該戶口以律師的當事人的名義開設。

snapshot.en: If a solicitor's client account is opened on behalf of a single client, the MSO should establish the identity of that underlying client in addition to that of the solicitor opening it.
snapshot.tc: 如律師的當事人戶口是代表單一客戶開設，金錢服務經營者除了核實開設戶口的律師的身分外，亦應識別相關當事人的身分。

source_quotes.text: that is managed by the customer as those clients’ agent.
該戶口是由客戶以其當事人的代理人身分管理。

topics.priority_reason: 补足现有规则的程序或适用深度；不代表考试频率较高。
topics.question_brief: 补齐混合金钱或证券、代理管理两个累计条件；遵循 E22 的“或”，不重出开户名义。
topics.notes: 现有全库只有第6单元的两句间接测试，完整三条件尚未组合受测。

topics.topic: 持续监察与先前客户触发规则
covered_aspects: 定期更新和交易审查
复杂/异常且无明显目的的交易须调查并写结论
高风险加强监察
先前客户的异常、不一致及重大账户变化触发
不能完成须终止

evidence.covers: 持续监察、异常交易、数字识别例外

snapshot.en: The MSO must review from time to time the documents, data and information obtained on the customer under the CDD requirements, to keep them up-to-date and relevant.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須不時覆核為遵從客戶盡職審查規定而取得的關於客戶的文件、數據及資料，以確保它們反映現況及仍屬相關。

snapshot.en: For transactions that are complex, unusually large or of an unusual pattern and lack any apparent economic or lawful purpose, setting out the findings of its examination in writing is at the MSO's discretion.
snapshot.tc: 如交易複雜、款額大得異乎尋常或進行模式異乎尋常，且欠缺明顯經濟或合法目的，是否藉書面列明審查所得由金錢服務經營者酌情決定。

snapshot.en: Before first carrying out CDD measures on a pre-existing customer, the MSO's review need cover only the documents, data and information it holds at that time.
snapshot.tc: 在首次就先前客戶執行客戶盡職審查措施之前，金錢服務經營者的覆核只需涵蓋其在進行覆核時所持有的文件、數據及資料。

snapshot.en: Where a customer or its beneficial owner is involved in a situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, the MSO must take additional monitoring measures.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶或客戶的實益擁有人涉及以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況，金錢服務經營者須在監察時採取額外措施。

snapshot.en: For a customer not physically present for identification, additional monitoring measures are needed unless the MSO identified and verified the customer using a recognized digital identification system.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶不曾為身分識別的目的而現身，金錢服務經營者須在監察時採取額外措施，除非已以認可數碼識別系統提供的數據或資料識別及核實其身分。

snapshot.en: A transaction with regard to a pre-existing customer that is unusual or suspicious by virtue of its amount or nature obliges the MSO to carry out CDD measures on that customer.
snapshot.tc: 如有關乎先前客戶的交易憑藉其款額或性質屬異乎尋常或可疑的，金錢服務經營者須就該客戶執行客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: The MSO must carry out CDD measures on a pre-existing customer when a transaction with regard to the customer is not consistent with its knowledge of the source of the customer's funds.
snapshot.tc: 如有關乎先前客戶的交易不符合金錢服務經營者對該客戶的資金來源的認知，金錢服務經營者須執行客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: A transaction that is not consistent with the MSO's knowledge of a pre-existing customer's business or risk profile is an occasion on which the MSO must carry out CDD measures.
snapshot.tc: 如有關乎先前客戶的交易不符合金錢服務經營者對該客戶的業務或風險狀況的認知，金錢服務經營者須執行客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: Where it cannot comply with the requirement to carry out CDD measures on a pre-existing customer, the MSO must end the business relationship with that customer as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如未能遵從就先前客戶執行客戶盡職審查的規定，金錢服務經營者須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快結束與該客戶的業務關係。

evidence.covers: 账户重大变化、休眠重启与持续监察

snapshot.en: Trigger events for performing CDD on a pre-existing customer may include the re-activation of a dormant account or a change in the beneficial ownership or control of the account.
snapshot.tc: 就須對先前客戶執行盡職審查措施的情況而言，觸發事件可包括把不動戶口重新活躍起來，或某戶口的實益擁有權或控制權有變。

snapshot.en: The MSO must perform the CDD measures in Schedule 2 and the Guideline on a pre-existing customer when a change occurs in the way in which the customer's account is operated.
snapshot.tc: 如先前客戶的戶口的操作模式出現轉變，金錢服務經營者必須對該客戶執行附表2及指引所指明的盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: Besides the CDD measures it must perform on a pre-existing customer when triggered, the MSO should note that the requirements for ongoing monitoring also apply to such customers.
snapshot.tc: 除在觸發情況下須對先前客戶執行盡職審查措施外，金錢服務經營者亦須注意，持續監察的規定同樣適用於先前客戶。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。
topics.notes: 遵循 E33、E41；先前客户2012-04-01界线为历史背景，不为此单独强行补题。

topics.topic: 非面对面身份核实的附加措施与例外
covered_aspects: 附加于一般CDD和监察
至少一项：额外来源、补充核实、首笔付款
本人银行账户及对等地区银行条件
认可数字识别免附加措施

evidence.covers: 附加要求的范围与选择

snapshot.en: The MSO must carry out at least one of the measures listed for this case, so it need not carry out every one of the listed measures.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須執行就此情況所列的最少一項措施，因此並無需要執行所列的每一項措施。

snapshot.en: One listed measure is further verifying the customer's identity on documents, data or information of the kind used for CDD, but not previously used for that verification.
snapshot.tc: 所列措施之一，是以客戶盡職審查所用類別、但未曾用於核實身分的文件、數據或資料，進一步核實該客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: One listed measure is taking supplementary measures to verify information relating to the customer that the MSO has already obtained.
snapshot.tc: 所列措施之一，是採取增補措施，以核實金錢服務經營者已經取得的、關乎該客戶的資料。

snapshot.en: One listed measure is having the first payment for the customer's account carried out through an account in the customer's name with an authorized institution.
snapshot.tc: 所列措施之一，是確保就該客戶的戶口作出的第一次付款，是經由以該客戶的名義在認可機構開設的戶口進行。

snapshot.en: The special requirements for this case apply in addition to the requirements to carry out CDD measures and to continuously monitor the business relationship.
snapshot.tc: 有關特別規定是在執行客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察業務關係的規定以外，金錢服務經營者亦須遵守的規定。

evidence.covers: 境外银行监管者及本人账户

snapshot.en: An institution in an equivalent jurisdiction may be used for the first payment of a customer not physically present if, among other conditions, authorities there with functions like the Commissioner's supervise it.
snapshot.tc: 對等司法管轄區的機構如要供不曾為身分識別目的而現身的客戶作第一次付款，條件之一是受到當地職能與關長的職能相類似的主管當局監管。

snapshot.en: For a customer not physically present, one measure is to have the first payment go through the customer's account with an institution set up in an equivalent jurisdiction that meets the conditions laid down.
snapshot.tc: 客戶不曾為身分識別而現身時，措施之一是確保第一次付款經由以其名義在某機構開設的戶口進行，而該機構在對等司法管轄區成立為法團或設立並符合所訂條件。

snapshot.en: No additional measure is required if the MSO verified the customer's identity on data or information from a digital identification system recognised by the CCE as a reliable and independent source.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者若以關長認可為可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統所提供的數據或資料為基礎核實客戶身分，便毋須執行任何額外措施。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。
topics.notes: E17：首笔付款，不以“存款”限定。

topics.topic: 政治人物及其他高风险的加强措施
covered_aspects: 政治人物须高管批准及资金/财富来源
既有客户成为政治人物不可自动终止
前政治人物不因卸任自动豁免
其他高风险建立/持续关系与偶发交易不同
资金来源或额外措施选项

evidence.covers: PEP中央义务及卸任非自动豁免

snapshot.en: Before establishing a business relationship with the customer, the MSO must obtain approval from its money laundering reporting officer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在與該客戶建立業務關係之前，須取得其洗錢報告主任的批准。

snapshot.en: Before establishing a business relationship, the MSO must take reasonable measures to establish the customer's source of wealth and of the funds involved.
snapshot.tc: 建立業務關係前，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立該客戶的財富及所涉資金的來源。

snapshot.en: Where an existing customer has become a politically exposed person, the MSO must terminate its business relationship with that customer.
snapshot.tc: 如現有客戶已成為政治人物，金錢服務經營者須結束與該客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: The same requirements apply where it is a beneficial owner of the customer, and not the customer itself, who is the politically exposed person.
snapshot.tc: 如屬政治人物的並非客戶本身，而是客戶的實益擁有人，同樣的規定亦適用。

snapshot.en: The requirements cease to apply as soon as the person's prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong comes to an end.
snapshot.tc: 一旦有關人士在香港以外地方擔任的重要公職結束，有關規定即告停止適用。

snapshot.en: The requirements apply in a situation the Commissioner specifies in a written notice to the MSO, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於關長藉給予金錢服務經營者的書面通知所指明的情況，及任何其他以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship is to be established with the customer concerned, the MSO must obtain approval from its senior management to establish it.
snapshot.tc: 如將要與有關客戶建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須取得其高級管理層的批准，以建立該業務關係。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship is to be established, the MSO must either take reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and funds, or take additional measures to mitigate the risk.
snapshot.tc: 如將要建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship has been established and there is a beneficial owner, the MSO must take reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity.
snapshot.tc: 如已建立業務關係，而就有關客戶而言有某實益擁有人，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施，以核實該實益擁有人的身分。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the MSO must take additional measures to mitigate the risk; senior management approval is not required.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者須採取額外措施以減低所涉風險，而無須取得高級管理層的批准。

evidence.covers: 已知PEP触发及持续关系审批

snapshot.en: The requirements for politically exposed persons apply where the MSO knows, from publicly known information or information in its possession, that a customer or its beneficial owner is such a person.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者從公眾知悉的資料或其本身管有的資料中，知悉客戶或客戶的實益擁有人屬政治人物，有關政治人物的特別規定即適用。

snapshot.en: In a situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, continuing an established business relationship needs the approval of the senior management.
snapshot.tc: 在任何以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況下，如要繼續已建立的業務關係，須取得有關高級管理層的批准。

topics.notes: B17、B32；停止前政治人物EDD的正面风险评估与高管批准条件仍可深化，由第6单元审核统筹，不能把“非自动豁免”当成全部停止条件。

topics.topic: 电传转账适用、门槛及资料替代
covered_aspects: 机构自营转账排除
卡交易排除部分条件
国内电传须全部机构在港
汇款人以出款账户持有人为先
8000元以下仍须收款人姓名及双方信息
missing_aspects: 地址、客户识别编号/识别文件编号、出生日期及地点可择一的明确正面测试
m3-261第3句把地址误写成8000元以上的绝对必要资料，应先修正

snapshot.en: The wire transfer requirements do not apply to a wire transfer between two financial institutions, or between a financial institution and a foreign institution, if each acts on its own behalf.
snapshot.tc: 在兩間金融機構之間，或在一間金融機構與一間外地機構之間的電傳轉賬，如每間機構均只代表本身行事，電傳轉賬的特別規定即不適用。

snapshot.en: For the wire transfer requirements, an institution outside Hong Kong that carries on a business similar to a financial institution's counts as a foreign institution.
snapshot.tc: 就電傳轉賬的特別規定而言，位於香港以外地方而所經營的業務與金融機構所經營者相類似的機構，即屬外地機構。

snapshot.en: A wire transfer is a domestic wire transfer where its ordering and beneficiary institutions are financial institutions located in Hong Kong, even if an intermediary institution involved is located elsewhere.
snapshot.tc: 如電傳轉賬的匯款機構及收款機構均為位於香港的金融機構，即使所涉的中介機構位於其他地方，該項轉賬亦屬本地電傳轉賬。

snapshot.en: Where the money for a wire transfer is paid from an account with the ordering institution, the originator is the person who gives the transfer instruction, even if someone else holds that account.
snapshot.tc: 如電傳轉賬所涉金錢是自在匯款機構開立的戶口轉賬的，匯款人即為發出轉賬指示的人，即使該戶口由另一人持有亦然。

snapshot.en: For the exclusion of wire transfers arising from card transactions to apply, one condition is that the card's number, or an equivalent unique identifier, is included in the accompanying message or payment form.
snapshot.tc: 因使用信用咭、扣賬咭或預付咭的交易而引致的電傳轉賬要獲豁除，條件之一是附隨的信息或付款表格已包括該咭的號碼或等同的獨特標識。

evidence.covers: 8000元以下资料；明确不采纳第3句错误覆盖

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the originator's address before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄匯款人的地址。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the recipient's name before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the message or payment form accompanying it need include only the originator's details.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，附隨該項轉賬的信息或付款表格只須包括匯款人的資料。

evidence.covers: 可追踪号码及核实边界

snapshot.en: Any unique reference number that the ordering institution or the beneficiary institution assigns in place of an account number should permit traceability of the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構或收款機構在沒有戶口號碼時所編配的獨特參考編號，應可用作追蹤有關的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: A customer identification number for the originator must refer to a record held by the beneficiary institution containing at least one of: the customer address, identification document number, or date and place of birth.
snapshot.tc: 匯款人的客戶識別號碼，必須參照由收款機構持有、最少載有客戶地址、識別文件號碼或出生日期及地點其中一項的紀錄。

snapshot.en: The ordering institution must ensure that the required originator information accompanying a wire transfer is accurate, whatever the amount of money that the transfer involves.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構必須確保附隨於電傳轉帳的所需匯款人資料準確，而這項規定適用於任何款額的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: The required originator information is deemed to be accurate if the originator's identity has been verified in compliance with the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人的身分已根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢指引》的規定核實，所需的匯款人資料便視為準確。

snapshot.en: No further verification of the originator information is normally required, although an ordering institution may exercise its discretion to verify it further in individual cases.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，匯款機構無需再進一步核實匯款人資料，但仍可運用酌情權，就個別個案作進一步核實。

snapshot.en: Verifying the originator of an occasional wire transfer below $8,000 is in general not required; one exception is where several transactions appear to be linked and together reach $8,000 or more.
snapshot.tc: 8,000元以下的非經常電傳轉帳一般無需核實匯款人，例外情況之一是數項交易似有關連並合共達8,000元或以上。

source_quotes.text: the originator’s address, the originator’s customer identification number or identification document number or, if the originator is an individual, the originator’s date and place of birth;

匯款人的地址、匯款人的客戶識別號碼或識別文件
號碼或( 如匯款人屬一名個人) 匯款人的出生日期及
地方；

covered_aspects: 无账户时由对应汇出/收款机构编配号码
本地可只传汇款人账户/号码
要求后3个营业日补资料
同一汇款人批量跨境传送条件

evidence.covers: 号码归属与国内/批量例外

snapshot.en: Where the originator has no account with the MSO from which the money for the transfer is paid, the MSO must record a unique reference number that it assigns to the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人並無在該金錢服務經營者開立作為電傳轉賬所付金錢來源的戶口，該經營者須記錄由其本身編配予該電傳轉賬的獨特參考編號。

snapshot.en: Where the recipient has no account with the beneficiary institution to which the money is paid, the MSO must record a unique reference number that the MSO itself assigns to the transfer.
snapshot.tc: 如收款人並無在收款機構開立作為電傳轉賬所付金錢對象的戶口，該金錢服務經營者須記錄由其本身編配予該電傳轉賬的獨特參考編號。

snapshot.en: For a domestic wire transfer, the MSO may include in the accompanying message or payment form only the originator's account number, or the unique reference number recorded in its place.
snapshot.tc: 就本地電傳轉賬而言，該金錢服務經營者可在附隨的信息或付款表格內，只包括匯款人的戶口號碼或代替該號碼記錄的獨特參考編號。

snapshot.en: Where a domestic wire transfer carries the originator's account or reference number instead of full details, the MSO must give the other originator details within 3 business days after the transfer, if the relevant authority or receiving institution asks.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉賬以匯款人的戶口號碼或參考編號代替完整資料，該經營者須在有關當局或收取其轉賬指示的機構要求下，於轉賬後3個營業日內提供所記錄的其他匯款人資料。

snapshot.en: Wire transfers from one originator batched for recipients outside Hong Kong need not each carry all required information if each carries the originator's account or reference number and the batch file holds the recorded information.
snapshot.tc: 來自單一匯款人、集合在群組檔案中傳遞予香港以外地方收款人的電傳轉賬，如每項均附隨匯款人戶口號碼或參考編號，而群組檔案載有所記錄資料，便無需每項附隨全部規定資料。

topics.topic: 电传：中介和收款机构处理缺资料
covered_aspects: 中介传递全部资料
本地先追缺失账户/参考号
跨境追全部资料
无法取得时考虑限/终止关系或减风险
无意义或不完整信息须减风险

evidence.covers: 各机构职责和两种处理路径

snapshot.en: Acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer, the MSO must transmit all of the information it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction.
snapshot.tc: 該金錢服務經營者如在電傳轉賬中以中介機構身分行事，須將其連同該項轉賬一併獲得的所有資料，傳遞予收取它的轉賬指示的機構。

snapshot.en: If a domestic wire transfer reaches it as beneficiary institution without the originator's account or reference number, the MSO must obtain that number from the instructing institution as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉賬送達作為收款機構的該經營者時沒有附隨匯款人戶口號碼或參考編號，該經營者須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉賬指示的機構取得該號碼。

snapshot.en: A beneficiary institution aware that accompanying information purporting to be the required information is incomplete or meaningless must, as soon as reasonably practicable, take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.
snapshot.tc: 收款機構如察覺附隨的看來是規定資料的資料並不完整或不具意義，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer that is not domestic, the MSO as an intermediary institution, like a beneficiary institution, must as soon as reasonably practicable obtain any missing required information from the instructing institution.
snapshot.tc: 就並非本地的電傳轉賬而言，作為中介機構的該經營者與收款機構一樣，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉賬指示的機構取得遺漏的規定資料。

snapshot.en: If missing information it is required to obtain cannot be obtained, the MSO must either consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with the instructing institution, or take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved.
snapshot.tc: 如未能取得其須取得的遺漏資料，該經營者須考慮限制或結束它與發出轉賬指示的機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

covered_aspects: 非电传且8000元或以上
汇款前识别及法定识别文件核实
记录姓名、地址、证件及旅行证件签发地
币种、金额、时间、收款方与方式
向境外发送的交易定义

snapshot.en: Before carrying out a remittance transaction involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, MSO must verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator’s identification document
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在進行涉及相等於$8,000或以上的款額的匯款交易前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。

snapshot.en: The special requirements for remittance transactions apply to a remittance, other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency, carried out by a licensed MSO.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易的特別規定，適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）而並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易。

evidence.covers: 完整记录及与电传不同

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's name and address, and the currency and amount involved.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的姓名及地址，以及所涉的貨幣及款額。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's identification document number and, for a travel document, its place of issue.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的識別文件的號碼，以及（如屬旅行證件）發出旅行證件的地方。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the recipient's name and address, the method of delivery, and the date and time it received the instructions.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄收款人的姓名及地址、送遞的方式，以及接獲指示的日期及時間。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's date and place of birth, where the originator is an individual.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的出生日期及地方（如匯款人屬一名個人）。

snapshot.en: For these requirements, a transaction is a remittance transaction if it is for sending money, or arranging for money to be sent, to a place outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 就有關規定而言，凡為將金錢送往香港以外地方或安排如此送交而進行的交易，即屬匯款交易。

topics.topic: 匿名账户禁止及有效程序和保障
covered_aspects: 禁止匿名或假名账户
各类客户、关系、产品、交易须有效CDD/监察程序
所有合理措施防止第2/3部违规并减低风险

snapshot.en: MSO must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者不得開立或維持匿名戶口。

snapshot.en: An MSO may open an account in a fictitious name for a customer, provided that it has first identified the customer and has verified the customer's true identity.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如已先識別客戶的身分，並已核實該客戶的真實身分，便可為該客戶以虛構的姓名或名稱開立戶口。

snapshot.en: For each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, an MSO must establish and maintain effective procedures, not inconsistent with the AMLO, for its CDD and monitoring duties.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須就每類客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，設立及維持不抵觸《打擊洗錢條例》的有效措施，以履行客戶盡職審查及監察的責任。

evidence.covers: 保障措施和风险为本制度

snapshot.en: An MSO must take such measures as the CCE directs in writing from time to time to ensure that proper safeguards do exist against ML/TF
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須採取關長以書面指示的措施，以確保設有保障措施防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集

snapshot.en: One purpose of the required safeguards is to mitigate the risks of money laundering and terrorist financing
snapshot.tc: 設有所需保障措施的目的之一，是減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集方面的風險

snapshot.en: The safeguards are also required to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2
snapshot.tc: 有關保障措施亦須用以防止違反附表2第2或3部所訂明的任何規定

snapshot.en: To ensure compliance with this requirement, the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA stated in paragraph 2.1
snapshot.tc: 為確保符合此項規定，金錢服務經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本的方法執行適當的內部制度

topics.topic: 中介人依赖：资格、取资料和保留责任
covered_aspects: 书面同意、无延误提供副本
立即取得资料、记录期间可索副本
MSO保留责任
本地专业人士及金融机构类别限制
境外同类机构注册、措施和监管

snapshot.en: The MSO may carry out a measure by means of the intermediary only if the intermediary consents in writing to be the MSO's intermediary.
snapshot.tc: 只有在中介人藉書面同意擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人的情況下，金錢服務經營者才可藉著該中介人執行措施。

snapshot.en: The MSO must be satisfied that, when asked, the intermediary will hand over without delay a copy or record of what it obtained in carrying out the measure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須信納，中介人在接到要求時，會毫不延誤地交出其在執行措施時取得的文件複本或數據資料紀錄。

snapshot.en: Using an intermediary does not relieve the MSO of liability under the AMLO for a failure to carry out the customer due diligence measure.
snapshot.tc: 藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施，並不免除金錢服務經營者根據《打擊洗錢條例》就未有執行措施所負的法律責任。

snapshot.en: Immediately after the intermediary carries out a measure, the MSO must obtain the data or information obtained, but need not get copies of documents at the same time.
snapshot.tc: 在中介人執行措施之後，金錢服務經營者須立刻取得中介人取得的數據或資料，但無需同時取得任何文件的複本。

snapshot.en: The MSO must ensure that the intermediary will, if asked within the record-keeping period, provide copies or records of what it obtained as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須確保，如在備存紀錄期間內提出要求，中介人會在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快提供其取得的文件複本或紀錄。

snapshot.en: A financial institution that is an authorized institution
snapshot.tc: 屬認可機構的金融機構

snapshot.en: A financial institution that is a licensed money service operator
snapshot.tc: 屬持牌金錢服務經營者的金融機構

snapshot.en: A financial institution that is a licensed corporation
snapshot.tc: 屬持牌法團的金融機構

snapshot.en: A financial institution that is an SVF licensee
snapshot.tc: 屬工具持牌人的金融機構

snapshot.en: A financial institution that is a licensed insurance broker company
snapshot.tc: 屬持牌保險經紀公司的金融機構

snapshot.en: An accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional or TCSP licensee can be the MSO's intermediary only if able to satisfy it that adequate procedures to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing are in place.
snapshot.tc: 會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士或信託或公司服務持牌人，須能令金錢服務經營者信納其有充分程序防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集，方可擔任該經營者的中介人。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, a lawyer, notary public, auditor or tax advisor practising in an equivalent jurisdiction must be supervised for compliance with the requirements by a relevant authority in Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區執業的律師、公證人、核數師或稅務顧問如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須在遵從有關規定方面受到香港的有關當局監管。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, a trust company carrying on trust business in an equivalent jurisdiction must be required by that jurisdiction's law to be registered or licensed, or be regulated under that law.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區經營信託業務的信託公司如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，該司法管轄區的法律須規定其註冊或領牌，或其須受該法律規管。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, an institution doing business in an equivalent jurisdiction similar to an authorized institution's must have measures to ensure compliance with requirements similar to the AMLO's due diligence and record-keeping ones.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區經營與認可機構相類似業務的機構如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須已有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定。

topics.topic: 相关外地金融机构作为中介人及迁册实体
covered_aspects: 同集团/本地机构境外分行可合资格
集团政策、集团层面监管及减风险
本地成立机构的分行关系
missing_aspects: 迁册实体须按本地成立机构处理；境外成立且非迁册机构的总办事处或其分行也可属相关机构

evidence.covers: 关联机构范围与集团控制

snapshot.en: An institution in the same group of companies as the MSO that carries on, outside Hong Kong, a business similar to an authorized institution's can be a related foreign financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 與金錢服務經營者屬同一公司集團、並在香港以外地方經營與認可機構所經營者相類似的業務的機構，可屬相關外地金融機構。

snapshot.en: For an MSO incorporated in Hong Kong, its own branch carrying on, outside Hong Kong, a business similar to an authorized institution's can be a related foreign financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 就在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者而言，其在香港以外地方經營與認可機構相類似業務的分行，可屬相關外地金融機構。

snapshot.en: To be relied on, a related foreign financial institution must be supervised at a group level by a relevant authority, or by an authority in an equivalent jurisdiction performing like functions for the MSO's holding company or head office.
snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須在集團層面受有關當局監管，或受對等司法管轄區就該經營者的控權公司或總行執行類似有關當局職能的主管當局監管。

snapshot.en: Where its intermediary is a related foreign financial institution, the MSO must take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved.
snapshot.tc: 如所藉的中介人屬相關外地金融機構，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施，以減低涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。

snapshot.en: To be relied on, a related foreign financial institution must be required by group policy to have measures for compliance with requirements like the AMLO's due diligence and record-keeping ones, and to run programmes against ML/TF.
snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須按集團政策設有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定，並須針對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集實施計劃。

source_quotes.text: if the financial institution is incorporated in Hong Kong or is a re-domiciled entity, it is a branch of the financial institution;

( 如該金融機構是在香港成立為法團的，或是
經遷冊實體) 該另一機構是該金融機構的分行；
source_quotes.locator: 附表2第18(7)條「相關外地金融機構」(b)(ii)

topics.question_brief: 补迁册与非迁册总行/分行三个情境，避免再重复集团政策和监管。

topics.topic: 记录内容、保存形式和延长通知
covered_aspects: 每项交易、客户身份、账户及往来记录
原件可留，副本须微缩或计算机数据库
数据亦须微缩或数据库
书面延长期可因调查或其他指定用途

snapshot.en: For each transaction, the MSO must keep the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained for it under the CDD requirements.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須就每項交易，備存按客戶盡職審查規定就該交易取得的文件正本或複本，及數據及資料紀錄。

snapshot.en: For each customer, the MSO must keep the original or a copy of its business correspondence with the customer and with any beneficial owner of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者與客戶及客戶的任何實益擁有人之間的業務通訊檔案，須就每名客戶備存正本或複本。

snapshot.en: Where a record consists of a document, any copy of it that the MSO keeps must be kept on paper, on microfilm or in the database of a computer.
snapshot.tc: 如紀錄包含文件而備存其複本，金錢服務經營者須以紙本、微縮影片或電腦數據庫的方式備存該複本。

snapshot.en: Any data or information the MSO is required to keep must be recorded either on microfilm or in the database of a computer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須備存的數據或資料，其紀錄須以微縮影片或電腦數據庫的方式備存。

snapshot.en: For a record in the form of a document, retaining the original document meets the AMLO's rule on the manner in which records are kept.
snapshot.tc: 如紀錄屬文件，保留文件的正本即符合《打擊洗錢條例》有關紀錄備存形式的規定。

snapshot.en: A written notice requiring records to be kept for longer than the usual period need not rest on an investigation: it may rest on their relevance to any other purposes the notice specifies.
snapshot.tc: 要求在較一般為長的期間內備存紀錄的書面通知，不一定須以調查為理由，亦可基於該等紀錄攸關該通知所指明的任何其他目的。

snapshot.en: An MSO given a notice in writing to keep records relating to a specified transaction for a longer period must keep those records for the period that the notice specifies.
snapshot.tc: 獲發給書面通知、須在較長期間內備存關乎某指明交易的紀錄的金錢服務經營者，須在該通知指明的期間備存有關紀錄。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。

topics.topic: 记录保存的三个五年起点
covered_aspects: 交易完成日起至少5年
关系期间及结束后至少5年
非经常交易CDD记录从该交易完成起计

snapshot.en: CDD documents and records should be kept throughout the business relationship and for at least five years after it ends.
snapshot.tc: 盡職審查的文件及紀錄應在業務關係繼續期間備存，並在業務關係終止後備存至少5年。

snapshot.en: For an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or more, the CDD records should be kept for at least five years after its date.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及8,000元或以上的非經常電傳轉帳而言，盡職審查紀錄應由交易當日起計備存至少5年。

snapshot.en: Transaction records should be kept for at least five years after the transaction, even if the business relationship ends sooner.
snapshot.tc: 交易紀錄應在交易完成後備存至少5年，不論業務關係是否在該段期間內終止。

snapshot.en: The CCE may, by written notice, require records on a specified customer to be kept for longer than these periods.
snapshot.tc: 關長可藉書面通知，要求金錢服務經營者把指定客戶的紀錄備存一段較長的期間。

topics.topic: 海外分支和附属企业的法定义务
covered_aspects: 在港成立及迁册实体均适用
分行及经营同类金融业务附属企业
以当地法律允许为限
不允许执行时报告当局
分行不因称为代理机构而排除
当地法律不许执行时采取额外措施减低风险

snapshot.en: These duties bind an MSO that is incorporated in Hong Kong, and they bind in exactly the same way an MSO that is a re-domiciled entity, as the Ordinance defines that term.
snapshot.tc: 在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者須負上該等責任，屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的經遷冊實體的金錢服務經營者亦同樣須負上該等責任。

snapshot.en: The MSO must ensure its branches have procedures to ensure compliance, so far as the law of their place permits, with requirements similar to the Schedule 2 CDD and record-keeping requirements that apply to it.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須確保其分行設有程序，確保與附表2中適用於該經營者的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定，在分行所在地方法律准許的範圍內獲遵守。

snapshot.en: The duty to ensure procedures for complying with requirements similar to Schedule 2's extends to the MSO's subsidiary undertakings outside Hong Kong that carry on a business other than that of a financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 確保設有程序以遵從與附表2相類似規定的責任，亦延及金錢服務經營者在香港以外地方經營金融機構業務以外的業務的附屬企業。

snapshot.en: A branch outside Hong Kong carrying on business similar to the MSO's is covered even if the laws or regulations of its place limit its business, or it is referred to there as an agency.
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方經營與金錢服務經營者相類似業務的分行，即使其業務受當地法律或規例所限制，或在當地被稱為代理人，仍屬該等責任所涵蓋的分行。

snapshot.en: If the law of the place where a branch carries on business does not permit procedures for complying with requirements similar to Schedule 2's, the MSO must inform the relevant authority accordingly.
snapshot.tc: 如分行經營業務所在地方的法律不准許實行關乎與附表2相類似規定的程序，金錢服務經營者須將此情況通知有關當局。

evidence.covers: 当地法不许执行时须额外减低风险

snapshot.en: The requirement applies where the laws of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於在香港成立為法團的經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，因所在地法律不准許而未能執行較嚴格規定的情況

snapshot.en: The MSO should take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result of its inability to comply with the requirements
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應採取額外措施，以有效地減低分行或附屬企業因不能遵從該等規定而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

covered_aspects: 发牌3810元及额外处所2440元
续期基本费与发牌不同
发牌及负责人批准每人945元
核证及非核证副本按不同单位
新增处所费用
missing_aspects: 续牌时每一名须判定适当人选者也须再缴945元，非只初次发牌一次缴付

evidence.covers: 发牌/续牌/负责人/副本费用

snapshot.en: An application for the grant of a licence carries a fee of $3,810, with $2,440 added for each additional business premises.
snapshot.tc: 申請批給牌照的費用為$3,810，並須就每多一個營業處所另加$2,440。

snapshot.en: A renewal application carries the same basic fee as a grant application, $3,810, plus $410 for each additional business premises.
snapshot.tc: 申請牌照續期的基本費用與批給牌照相同，為$3,810，每多一個營業處所另加$410。

snapshot.en: An application for the grant of a licence also carries $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 申請批給牌照時，亦須就每一個須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945。

snapshot.en: An application for approval to become a licensee's director carries a fee of $945 for each application that is made.
snapshot.tc: 申請要求批准擔任持牌人董事的費用，為每宗提出的申請$945。

snapshot.en: For each person in relation to whom approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner or partner is sought, the fee is $945.
snapshot.tc: 就申請批准擔任持牌人最終擁有人或合夥人而言，申請所關乎的每一人須繳費$945。

snapshot.en: An uncertified copy of an entry in the register of licensees costs $160 per copy, the same as a certified copy.
snapshot.tc: 提供登記冊內記項的未經核證複本，費用為每份$160，與核證複本相同。

snapshot.en: An application to add new business premises carries a fee of HK$945 for each new business premises to be added to the licence.
snapshot.tc: 申請要求加入新的業務處所時，須就每一新的業務處所繳付港幣945元的費用。

source_quotes.text: for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test
申請牌照續期

topics.topic: 審裁處主席任期、辞职和免职
covered_aspects: 任期最多3年可再任
辞职生效日
丧失资格、无行为能力、破产、失职、利益冲突、失当
已开始覆核可继续至完结

snapshot.en: A person may be appointed as chairperson for a term of up to 5 years, and a chairperson whose term has expired may be reappointed.
snapshot.tc: 一名人士獲委任為審裁處主席的任期最長可達5年，而任期屆滿的主席可獲再度委任。

snapshot.en: The chairperson may resign by notice in writing to the Secretary, the resignation taking effect when the Secretary receives it or on any later date it specifies.
snapshot.tc: 主席可藉向局長發出書面通知而辭職，辭職在局長接獲通知的日期生效，或在通知所指明的較後日期生效。

snapshot.en: The Secretary may, by notice in writing, remove the chairperson from office if he or she is no longer qualified for appointment as chairperson.
snapshot.tc: 如主席不再具有獲委任為審裁處主席的資格，局長可藉書面通知將該名主席免任。

snapshot.en: Incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest and misconduct are each a ground on which the Secretary may, by notice in writing, remove the chairperson.
snapshot.tc: 喪失履行職務能力、破產、疏於職守、有利益衝突及行為失當，均是局長可藉書面通知將主席免任的理由。

snapshot.en: If the chairperson's term expires after proceedings for a review have begun, he or she may continue as chairperson for that review until it is determined.
snapshot.tc: 如主席任期在覆核法律程序展開後屆滿，該人可繼續為該覆核的目的擔任主席，直至覆核獲裁定為止。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。

topics.topic: 審裁處委员及普通成员
covered_aspects: 委员非公职人员及任期
主席推荐2名
按特定覆核委任
退出委员即失普通成员资格
成员变化须各方同意才续审

snapshot.en: The panel from which the Tribunal's ordinary members are appointed must be made up of persons who are not public officers.
snapshot.tc: 審裁處的普通成員從局長委出的委員團的委員中委任，而委員團須由並非公職人員的人組成。

snapshot.en: Subject to the provisions on resignation and removal, a panel member may be appointed for any term that the Secretary considers appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 在不抵觸關於辭職及免任的條文下，委員的任期為局長認為適當的任何期間。

snapshot.en: For each review, the Secretary must appoint 2 panel members as ordinary members of the Tribunal, on the recommendation of the Chief Justice.
snapshot.tc: 為裁定每項覆核，局長須按終審法院首席法官的建議，委任2名委員為審裁處的普通成員。

snapshot.en: A panel member appointed as an ordinary member is appointed to act in relation to a specified review, and may be reappointed when that term expires.
snapshot.tc: 獲委任為普通成員的委員，獲委任就指明的覆核行事，並可在該任期屆滿後獲再度委任。

snapshot.en: An ordinary member who ceases to be a member of the panel ceases, by that fact, to be an ordinary member of the Tribunal.
snapshot.tc: 普通成員如停任局長所委出的委員團的委員，即因此停任審裁處的普通成員。

snapshot.en: If the membership of the Tribunal changes during the proceedings for a review, the proceedings must be discontinued, although they may begin anew.
snapshot.tc: 如在覆核法律程序進行期間審裁處的成員有所變動，該法律程序即須終止，但可重新開始。

topics.priority_reason: 已测核心内容或仅供边界参考，不建议机械补题。

topics.topic: 審裁處开庭、表决、代表及公开
covered_aspects: 主席及2成员、法律问题主席决定
律师代表无需许可
记录必须制作
公开原则、私人审讯须司法公正
海关代表
与民事程序相同特权

snapshot.en: The chairperson must convene sittings of the Tribunal as often as is necessary to enable the Tribunal to determine a review.
snapshot.tc: 主席須按為使審裁處能裁定覆核而需要的頻密程度，召開審裁處的聆訊。

snapshot.en: Every sitting of the Tribunal is presided over by the chairperson, and 2 ordinary members must also be present at it.
snapshot.tc: 審裁處每次聆訊均由主席主持，而在任何聆訊中，除主席外亦須有2名普通成員出席。

snapshot.en: A question of law is decided by the chairperson alone; any other question goes by a majority of the votes of the chairperson and ordinary members.
snapshot.tc: 法律問題由主席單獨裁定；其他問題則由主席及普通成員所投的過半數票數裁定。

snapshot.en: A party to a review needs the leave of the Tribunal to be heard at a sitting through a solicitor or counsel.
snapshot.tc: 覆核的任何一方均須先獲審裁處許可，方可在審裁處的聆訊中透過律師或大律師陳詞。

snapshot.en: A party that is a corporation is entitled to be heard through an officer or employee, and one that is a partnership through a partner.
snapshot.tc: 屬法團的一方有權透過其高級人員或僱員陳詞，屬合夥的一方則有權透過一名合夥人陳詞。

snapshot.en: The chairperson may prepare a record of the proceedings of a sitting, containing the particulars that he or she considers appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 主席可為審裁處的聆訊擬備研訊程序的紀錄，載有主席認為適當的關乎該程序的詳情。

snapshot.en: Subject to the provisions allowing a sitting to be held in private, every sitting of the Tribunal relating to a review must be held in public.
snapshot.tc: 除關於容許閉門進行聆訊的條文另有規定外，審裁處就覆核進行的每次聆訊均須公開進行。

snapshot.en: The Tribunal may hold a sitting, or a part of one, in private if the parties to the review consent to its being held in private.
snapshot.tc: 如覆核的各方均同意閉門進行，審裁處即可閉門進行某次聆訊或該次聆訊的任何部分。

snapshot.en: Where any party to a review applies for a sitting to be held in private, any hearing of that application must itself be held in private.
snapshot.tc: 如覆核的任何一方申請以閉門形式進行聆訊，則就該項申請進行的聆訊亦須閉門進行。

snapshot.en: When the Commissioner is a party to a review as the specified authority, the Commissioner may speak at a sitting through any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department.
snapshot.tc: 關長以指明當局身分作為覆核的一方時，可透過任何受僱任職於香港海關的公職人員在審裁處的聆訊中陳詞。

snapshot.en: Except as the AMLO otherwise provides, the Tribunal, the parties and any witness in a review have the same privileges and immunities as in civil proceedings in the Court of First Instance.
snapshot.tc: 除《打擊洗錢條例》另有規定外，審裁處、覆核各方及證人就覆核享有的特權和豁免權，與原訟法庭民事法律程序中的一樣。

topics.topic: 初步会议、同意令和主席独任
covered_aspects: 初步会议须各方同意
主席主持、促协议和报告
全条款同意令
覆核可事前同意主席独任
延期/暂缓可独任及须报告
替代法官由终审法院首席法官委任

snapshot.en: Once an application for review is received, the chairperson may direct that a preliminary conference be held, but only if the parties agree to the giving of that direction.
snapshot.tc: 在接獲覆核申請後，主席只可在覆核各方均同意主席作出該指示的情況下，指示舉行初步會議。

snapshot.en: The chairperson presides at a preliminary conference, and may there try to get the parties to make all the agreements they ought reasonably to make about the review.
snapshot.tc: 初步會議由主席主持，主席可在會議上設法促使覆核各方達成他們按理應就該項覆核達成的協議。

snapshot.en: After a preliminary conference held on the chairperson's direction, the chairperson must report to the Tribunal on any matters relating to it that he or she considers appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 按照主席的指示舉行初步會議後，主席須向審裁處報告其認為適當的、關乎該會議的任何事宜。

snapshot.en: If the parties request and agree to it and consent to all its terms, the Tribunal or the chairperson may make an order it is entitled to make, whether or not other requirements are met.
snapshot.tc: 如覆核各方要求並同意作出命令，且同意其所有條款，審裁處或主席可作出其有權作出的命令，不論其他規定是否已獲符合。

snapshot.en: A consent order is regarded for all purposes as made under the provision in question, and as complying with the requirements otherwise applicable to making it.
snapshot.tc: 同意令就所有目的而言，須視為根據有關條文作出的命令，並視為符合在其他方面適用於作出該命令的規定。

snapshot.en: Before any sitting is held to determine a review, the parties may inform the Tribunal by notice in writing that they agree to the chairperson deciding it alone, and the chairperson may then do so.
snapshot.tc: 在審裁處舉行聆訊以裁定覆核前，如各方藉書面通知告知審裁處同意由主席單獨裁定，主席即可單獨裁定該項覆核。

snapshot.en: An application to extend the time for applying for a review, or for a stay of execution of a specified decision, may be determined by the chairperson sitting alone.
snapshot.tc: 要求延展提出覆核申請限期的申請，或要求暫緩執行某指明決定的申請，可由主席作為審裁處唯一成員裁定。

snapshot.en: A Tribunal made up of the chairperson as its sole member is regarded for all purposes as a Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members.
snapshot.tc: 由主席作為唯一成員構成的審裁處，就所有目的而言，須視為連同2名普通成員構成的審裁處。

snapshot.en: Once the chairperson has alone decided an application for a stay of execution, he or she must report that determination, and the reasons for it, to the Tribunal.
snapshot.tc: 主席單獨裁定要求暫緩執行指明決定的申請後，須向審裁處報告其所作的裁定及作出該裁定的理由。

snapshot.en: If illness prevents the chairperson acting on an application for a stay of execution, a judge or deputy judge of the Court of First Instance appointed by the Chief Executive decides it.
snapshot.tc: 如主席因傷病而不能就暫緩執行的申請執行其職能，該申請由獲行政長官委任的原訟法庭法官或暫委法官裁定。

snapshot.en: The Guideline is issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise (CCE), and compliance with the Guideline is enforced through the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 本指引由海關關長（關長）公布，而本指引的遵行情況會按照《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》強制執行。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT standards set out in the Guideline are ones that MSOs may adopt at their discretion in order to comply with the statutory requirements under the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 本指引所載的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集準則，是金錢服務經營者為履行《打擊洗錢條例》的法定規定而可酌情採用的準則。

snapshot.en: Disciplinary and other actions under the AMLO may be taken against an MSO that fails to comply with the Guideline, for non-compliance with the relevant requirements.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》採取的紀律行動及其他行動，或會因沒有遵守相關規定而施加於未有遵守本指引的金錢服務經營者。

snapshot.en: Where applicable, an MSO's failure to comply with the Guideline may also reflect adversely on whether its sole proprietor, partner, director and ultimate owner are fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 如適用的話，金錢服務經營者不遵從本指引，將對其獨資經營者、合夥人、董事和最終擁有人是否適當人選帶有負面影響。

evidence.covers: 适用对象、法律依据和风险调整

snapshot.en: Intended for use by MSOs and their officers and staff, the Guideline also gives a general background on ML/TF, summarising the main provisions of the applicable AML/CFT legislation in Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 本指引供金錢服務經營者及其主管人員和職員使用，並概述洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的背景及適用於香港的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集法例主要條文。

snapshot.en: The Guideline offers MSOs and their senior management practical guidance on designing and implementing their own policies, procedures and controls in the relevant operational areas.
snapshot.tc: 本指引提供實際導引，以助金錢服務經營者及其高級管理層制訂及執行其相關經營領域的政策、程序及管控措施。

snapshot.en: The Guideline will assist MSOs to meet their legal and regulatory obligations when each MSO applies it in exactly the same way, whatever its particular business risk profile.
snapshot.tc: 不論各金錢服務經營者的特定業務風險狀況如何，只要它們均以完全相同的方式應用本指引，本指引便有助它們履行本身的法律及監管責任。

snapshot.en: The Guideline is published under section 7 of the AMLO, and the guidance it provides relates to the operation of the provisions in Schedule 2 to the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 本指引是根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條公布的，而其所提供的導引，是就《打擊洗錢條例》附表2條文的施行而提供。

evidence.covers: 强制用语与非穷尽性质

snapshot.en: Where the Guideline uses “should” in relation to an action, consideration or measure, it indicates a mandatory requirement, as it does when it uses “must”.
snapshot.tc: 本指引提及行動、考慮或措施時採用「應／應該」字詞，與採用「須／必須」一樣，均表示該項屬強制規定。

snapshot.en: No single set of implementation measures applies universally, because MSOs differ significantly in organisational and legal structure and in the nature and scope of their business.
snapshot.tc: 由於金錢服務經營者之間的組織及法律結構及業務性質與範疇差異重大，並不存在一套普遍適用的執行措施。

snapshot.en: The Guideline does not set out to list exhaustively every means by which MSOs can meet the relevant statutory and regulatory requirements.
snapshot.tc: 本指引的內容無意把金錢服務經營者符合相關法定及監管規定的所有途徑無遺地包羅在內。

topics.topic: 洗钱、恐怖分子资金筹集的定义与三阶段
covered_aspects: 洗钱意图、可公诉罪行及境外行为；三阶段；恐怖资金可来自合法来源；恐怖融资定义的意图/知悉/罔顾区分

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering covers property that represents the proceeds of an indictable offence in part, or indirectly, as well as property that is itself such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的財產，除本身屬可公訴罪行收益的財產外，亦包括部分或間接代表該等收益的財產。

snapshot.en: Proceeds of conduct that would constitute an indictable offence under Hong Kong law, had it occurred in Hong Kong, can be the subject of money laundering as defined.
snapshot.tc: 作出假使在香港發生即屬犯香港法律所訂可公訴罪行的作為而獲取的收益，亦屬「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的收益。

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering extends to the proceeds of any offence under the laws of Hong Kong, summary offences as well as indictable ones.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」的定義涵蓋干犯香港法律所訂任何罪行而獲取的收益，簡易程序罪行與可公訴罪行同樣在內。

snapshot.en: Under the AMLO, money laundering means any act that has the effect of making the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」指具有使可公訴罪行收益看似並非該等收益的效果的任何行為。

evidence.covers: 三阶段和恐怖资金来源

snapshot.en: Of the three common stages of money laundering, placement is the one at which cash proceeds derived from illegal activities are disposed of into the financial system.
snapshot.tc: 在洗錢的3個常見階段中，「存放」是處置來自非法活動的現金得益並將其注入金融體系的階段。

snapshot.en: Of the three common stages of money laundering, layering is the one at which the impression of apparent legitimacy is created for criminally derived wealth.
snapshot.tc: 在洗錢的3個常見階段中，為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性的，是「分層交易」這一階段。

snapshot.en: In layering, complex layers of financial transactions separate illicit proceeds from their source, so as to disguise where the money came from, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity.
snapshot.tc: 在分層交易中，複雜多層的金融交易把非法得益與其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索及隱藏擁有人身分。

snapshot.en: Where layering succeeds, integration schemes return the laundered proceeds to the general financial system, where they appear connected to legitimate business activities.
snapshot.tc: 當分層交易的過程成功，整合計劃便把經清洗的得益回流到一般金融體系，令人以為有關收益來自或涉及合法的商業活動。

snapshot.en: Whether their funds are from a legitimate or an illegitimate source, terrorist groups must similarly find ways to launder them, to use them unnoticed by the authorities.
snapshot.tc: 不論資金來源是否合法，恐怖分子集團同樣必須尋找清洗資金的途徑，以便在不被當局發現的情況下使用資金。

snapshot.en: Collecting property knowing that it will be used, in whole or in part, to commit a terrorist act is terrorist financing, whether or not it is actually so used.
snapshot.tc: 知道財產的全部或部分將會用於作出恐怖主義行為而籌集該財產，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集，不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。

snapshot.en: Providing property by any means, while being reckless as to whether it will be used to commit one or more terrorist acts, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 以任何方法提供財產，而罔顧該財產是否會用於作出一項或多於一項恐怖主義行為，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Soliciting financial (or related) services for the benefit of a person, being reckless as to whether the person is a terrorist associate, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 罔顧某人是否與恐怖分子有聯繫者，而為該人的利益尋求金融（或有關的）服務，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Making property available to a person known to be a terrorist is terrorist financing, provided that the property is then used to commit a terrorist act.
snapshot.tc: 明知某人是恐怖分子而向該人提供財產，須該財產其後被用於作出恐怖主義行為，方屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Dealing with any property, knowing that it is terrorist property, is one of the acts that the definition of terrorist financing covers.
snapshot.tc: 在知道任何財產屬恐怖分子財產的情況下處理該財產，屬於恐怖分子資金籌集的法定定義所涵蓋的行為之一。

snapshot.en: The meanings of terrorist, terrorist act and terrorist associate in this definition are those given to the terms by the UNATMO.
snapshot.tc: 此定義中的恐怖分子、恐怖主義行為及與恐怖分子有聯繫者，其涵義取自《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》。

source_quotes.text: the focus of TF is on the destination or use of property

topics.topic: FATF 的角色及香港义务
covered_aspects: 标准制定、评估跟进、高风险地区、香港实施最新建议

evidence.covers: FATF 职能、评估与香港义务

snapshot.en: Formed in 1989, the FATF is an inter-governmental body whose objectives are to set standards and promote effective implementation of measures for combating ML, TF and PF.
snapshot.tc: 在1989年成立的特別組織屬跨政府組織，宗旨是制訂標準及推動有效執行打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的措施。

snapshot.en: Recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF, the FATF Recommendations also help ensure a level playing field.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織建議有助營造公平競爭的環境，並獲承認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準。

snapshot.en: To ensure full and effective implementation of its standards, the FATF conducts evaluations on jurisdictions and undertakes stringent follow-up after them.
snapshot.tc: 為確保其標準在全球全面而有效地執行，特別組織會透過評核來監察各司法管轄區的合規情況，並在評核後進行嚴格的跟進程序。

snapshot.en: Jurisdictions it identifies as high-risk could be subject to enhanced scrutiny by the FATF or counter-measures by its members and the international community.
snapshot.tc: 被識別為高度風險的司法管轄區，可能會受到特別組織加強審查，或受到特別組織成員及國際社會採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations, which can be found on the FATF website.
snapshot.tc: 作為特別組織的成員，香港有責任實施最新的特別組織建議，而特別組織建議可在特別組織的網站查閱。

source_quotes.text: Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations

topics.topic: 主要法例及调查、冻结、没收权
covered_aspects: 主要六法、DTROP 调查冻结没收、OSCO 调查主体和法院权力、UNATMO 目的
missing_aspects: OSCO 允许法院考虑罪犯及罪行资料以决定是否加重刑罚

evidence.covers: 法例范围、DTROP 及 OSCO 主体

snapshot.en: The Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance is one of these main pieces of legislation.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》是指引所列的其中一項主要法例。

snapshot.en: The Cross-boundary Movement of Physical Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments Ordinance is one of these main pieces of legislation.
snapshot.tc: 《實體貨幣及不記名可轉讓票據跨境流動條例》是指引所列的其中一項主要法例。

snapshot.en: The DTROP provides for the freezing of assets on arrest and the confiscation of the proceeds of drug trafficking activities upon conviction.
snapshot.tc: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》載有在逮捕涉嫌罪犯時將資產凍結，以及在定罪後沒收販毒得益的條文。

snapshot.en: The OSCO empowers officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Independent Commission Against Corruption to investigate organized crime and triad activities.
snapshot.tc: 調查有組織罪行及三合會活動的權力，由《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予香港警方及廉政公署人員。

snapshot.en: MSOs and their officers and staff each have responsibilities under these different laws, and it is very important that they understand them fully.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者及它們的主管人員和職員均須充分了解他們在這些法例之下的各種責任，這點至為重要。

evidence.covers: 限制令押记令和调查没收

snapshot.en: The OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to issue restraint orders and charging orders over the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，就被控觸犯該條例所指罪行的被告人的財產發出限制令及押記令。

snapshot.en: Under the OSCO, the Courts are given jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes, among other matters.
snapshot.tc: 除其他事項外，《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，沒收來自有組織及嚴重罪行的得益。

snapshot.en: One of the offences that the OSCO creates is an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》所增訂的罪行之一，是一項有關來自可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行。

snapshot.en: Assets that are suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities may be investigated under provisions that the DTROP contains.
snapshot.tc: 涉嫌從販毒活動所得的資產，可根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》所載的條文進行調查。

snapshot.en: The UNATMO is principally directed towards implementing UNSCR decisions that seek to prevent the financing of terrorist acts and to combat the threat of foreign terrorist fighters.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在實施安理會的相關決定，以防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金，並減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員的威脅。

snapshot.en: What the UNATMO implements is not limited to the mandatory elements of the relevant UNSCRs; it includes the more pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations specifically related to TF.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》所實施的並不限於安理會相關決議中的強制性措施，特別組織建議中明確與恐怖分子資金籌集有關且較具逼切性的部分亦在其內。

source_quotes.text: to determine whether the imposition of a greater sentence is appropriate

topics.priority_reason: 背景或较低影响的边界细节，可在较重要缺口后补充。
topics.question_brief: 可在综合法例功能题加入 OSCO 加重判刑用途；不重复章节号记忆题。

topics.topic: AMLO 的 CDD、保障及刑事和纪律责任
covered_aspects: CDD/纪录监管主体、保障义务、明知违反的 2 年刑期、欺诈意图犯罪与纪律处罚上限
missing_aspects: 出于欺诈意图违反指定条文，在公诉定罪时最高 7 年监禁及 100 万元；m2-320 第 2 句仅测试简易定罪的 1 年上限，不能以别项调查罪的 7 年作替代。

snapshot.en: The AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs, and gives the JFIU powers to supervise compliance with these and the AMLO's other requirements.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》向金錢服務經營者施加盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定，並賦予財富情報組權力監督該等及其他規定的合規情況。

evidence.covers: 合理保障及附表 2 第 2/3 部

snapshot.en: An MSO must take such measures as the CCE directs in writing from time to time to ensure that proper safeguards do exist against ML/TF
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須採取關長以書面指示的措施，以確保設有保障措施防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集

snapshot.en: One purpose of the required safeguards is to mitigate the risks of money laundering and terrorist financing
snapshot.tc: 設有所需保障措施的目的之一，是減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集方面的風險

snapshot.en: The safeguards are also required to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2
snapshot.tc: 有關保障措施亦須用以防止違反附表2第2或3部所訂明的任何規定

snapshot.en: To ensure compliance with this requirement, the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA stated in paragraph 2.1
snapshot.tc: 為確保符合此項規定，金錢服務經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本的方法執行適當的內部制度

evidence.covers: 附表指定条文的犯罪与防御

snapshot.en: A financial institution that knowingly contravenes a specified provision is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.
snapshot.tc: 金融機構明知而違反指明的條文，一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。

snapshot.en: A financial institution that, with intent to defraud any relevant authority, contravenes a specified provision is liable on summary conviction to a $500,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment.
snapshot.tc: 金融機構出於詐騙任何有關當局的意圖而違反指明的條文，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處罰款$500,000及監禁6個月。

snapshot.en: A person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution, causes it to contravene a specified provision commits an offence.
snapshot.tc: 關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該機構的意圖而致使該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪。

snapshot.en: An employee charged with causing the institution, with intent to defraud, to contravene a specified provision has a defence if he or she proves following its compliance policies and procedures.
snapshot.tc: 僱員被控出於詐騙意圖而致使金融機構違反指明的條文，如證明其作為是按照該機構為確保遵從而設立的政策及程序，即可作免責辯護。

snapshot.en: A pecuniary penalty of up to $10,000,000 may be ordered or, if it is greater, up to 3 times the profit the institution gained or the costs it avoided through the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 罰款以$10,000,000與該機構因違反而獲取的利潤或避免的開支的3倍兩者中的較大者為上限。

snapshot.en: Subject to the requirements on procedure and penalty guidelines, the Commissioner may use any one or more of the powers, which include a public reprimand and an order to take remedial action by a set date.
snapshot.tc: 在符合程序及指引的規定下，關長可行使一項或多於一項權力，包括公開譴責該經營者及命令其在指明日期或之前採取糾正行動。

source_quotes.text: a maximum term of imprisonment of 7 years and a fine of $1 million
最高可被判監禁7年及罰款一百萬元。

topics.notes: 主要证据在单元 2/5；单元 1 尚无完整刑责对照题。

topics.topic: 处理犯罪得益、未披露与通风报信的罪责
covered_aspects: 处理得益、UNATMO、未披露、通风报信的核心行为/刑罚；知悉或怀疑与尽快报告

snapshot.en: Failing to disclose a suspicion of the proceeds of an indictable offence as soon as reasonable is punishable by up to 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine.
snapshot.tc: 未能在合理範圍內盡快披露其懷疑某財產屬可公訴罪行的得益，最高可被判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元。

snapshot.en: Tipping off, which prejudices an investigation following a disclosure, is punishable by up to 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine.
snapshot.tc: 通風報訊（披露相當可能損害為跟進披露而進行的調查的事宜），最高可被判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元。

snapshot.en: Dealing with property known, or reasonably believed, to represent the proceeds of an indictable offence is punishable by up to 14 years' imprisonment and a $500,000 fine.
snapshot.tc: 知道或有合理理由相信某財產代表可公訴罪行的得益而仍處理該財產，最高可被判監禁14年及罰款五十萬元。

snapshot.en: Making property or financial services available to a terrorist is punishable under the UNATMO by up to 14 years' imprisonment and a fine.
snapshot.tc: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，向恐怖分子提供任何財產或金融服務，最高可被判監禁14年及罰款。

snapshot.en: Once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an STR should be filed even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 知悉或懷疑一旦確立，即使沒有交易由或透過金錢服務經營者進行，也應提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: The STR must be made as soon as reasonably practical after the transaction giving rise to the suspicion has been completed.
snapshot.tc: 可疑交易報告必須在引起懷疑的該項交易完成後，在切實可行範圍內盡快提交。

snapshot.en: The obligation to report suspicions of ML/TF applies irrespective of the amount involved, and also covers attempted transactions.
snapshot.tc: 舉報懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的責任不論所涉金額均適用，並涵蓋試圖進行的交易。

snapshot.en: A person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must, as soon as reasonable, file an STR with the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑任何財產是恐怖分子財產，須在合理範圍內盡快向關長提交可疑交易報告。

evidence.covers: 内外披露均涉通风报信

snapshot.en: Telling a customer that a report has been made would prejudice the investigation, and an offence would be committed.
snapshot.tc: 如有人告知客戶已作出報告，這會影響調查工作，因而已屬犯罪。

snapshot.en: The tipping-off provision covers a suspicion raised internally within an MSO that has not yet been reported to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 通風報訊的條文包括已於金錢服務經營者內部提出懷疑，但尚未報告財富情報組的情況。

source_quotes.text: The maximum penalty for the offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 3 years and a fine.

topics.topic: 联合国制裁及大规模毁灭武器服务管制
covered_aspects: UNSO 实施决议、PF 全球/国家两层路径、合理相信或怀疑可能涉及 PF 的服务及金融协助

snapshot.en: In Hong Kong, it is under the UNSO that most of the United Nations Security Council Resolutions (UNSCRs) are implemented.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國制裁條例》是香港實施大部分聯合國安全理事會（安理會）決議所依據的條例。

snapshot.en: The UNSO provides for the imposition of sanctions arising from Chapter 7 of the Charter of the United Nations.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國制裁條例》訂定條文，就施加因《聯合國憲章》第七章所引起的制裁作出規定。

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist in developing, producing, acquiring or stockpiling weapons of mass destruction fall under the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 將會或可能協助發展、生產、取得或貯存大規模毀滅武器的服務，受《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制。

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist the means of delivery of weapons capable of causing mass destruction are also within the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》亦管制將會或可能協助可造成大規模毀滅的武器的投射工具的服務。

snapshot.en: Under the WMD(CPS)O, the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance is included in the provision of services, which is widely defined.
snapshot.tc: 根據《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》，提供服務的定義廣泛，借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助亦包括在內。

evidence.covers: PF 决议义务与服务禁制

snapshot.en: UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions form the basis of the UNSC's global approach to combating PF.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會遏止擴散資金籌集的全球層面方針，以安理會第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議為依據。

snapshot.en: UNSCR 1718 (2006) and its successor resolutions form the basis of the UNSC's country-specific approach against Iran.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會針對伊朗遏止擴散資金籌集的國家層面方針，以安理會第1718 (2006)號決議及其後續決議為依據。

snapshot.en: The UNSC resolutions combating PF, made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, are recommendations that UN member states may adopt.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會根據《聯合國憲章》第七章通過以遏止擴散資金籌集的決議，屬成員國可自行採納的建議。

snapshot.en: Hong Kong's counter proliferation financing regime includes the regulations made under the UNSO which are specific to the DPRK and Iran.
snapshot.tc: 香港根據法例實施的打擊擴散資金籌集制度，包括根據《聯合國制裁條例》針對朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例。

snapshot.en: The WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing any services where the provider believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that they may be connected to PF.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》禁止任何人提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務。

source_quotes.text: The provision of services is widely defined and includes the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance.

topics.topic: 风险为本方法与机构风险评估步骤
covered_aspects: 识别评估理解/减低风险、资源分配、机构范围、定量定性记录、高层批准、更新及向关长提供

snapshot.en: An RBA means that jurisdictions, competent authorities and MSOs are expected to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks to which they are exposed
snapshot.tc: 採用風險為本的方法，意指預期司法管轄區、主管當局及金錢服務經營者要識別、評估和了解本身面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: Under an RBA, an MSO takes AML/CFT measures commensurate with its ML/TF risks in order to manage and mitigate those risks effectively
snapshot.tc: 在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者採取與其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，以有效管理和減低該等風險

snapshot.en: An RBA allows an MSO to allocate its resources more effectively and to apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of the risks
snapshot.tc: 風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者能夠更有效地分配資源，並採取與有關風險的性質及水平相稱的預防措施

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt an RBA in the implementation of its AML/CFT Systems, the design of those Systems following the CCE's standard template
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在執行其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度時採用風險為本的方法，而該等制度的制訂則按關長的範本進行

snapshot.en: The institutional ML/TF risk assessment is an optional supplement to the RBA rather than the basis on which the RBA is built
snapshot.tc: 機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估屬風險為本方法的可有可無的補充，而非風險為本方法賴以建立的基礎

snapshot.en: The assessment enables an MSO to understand how, and to what extent, its own business is vulnerable to ML/TF
snapshot.tc: 該評估讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響，以及所受影響的程度

snapshot.en: The assessment should identify, assess and understand the MSO's ML/TF risks in relation to its customers and the jurisdictions its customers are from or in
snapshot.tc: 該評估應識別、評估和了解該經營者與其客戶，以及其客戶所屬或所在的國家或司法管轄區有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The assessment should identify, assess and understand the MSO's ML/TF risks in relation to the countries or jurisdictions the MSO has operations in
snapshot.tc: 該評估應識別、評估和了解該經營者與其業務所在的國家或司法管轄區有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The assessment covers the MSO's products, services, transactions and delivery channels once the CCE has confirmed the scope of the assessment in writing
snapshot.tc: 該評估須待關長書面確認評估範圍後，才涵蓋該經營者的產品、服務、交易及交付渠道

snapshot.en: Documenting the risk assessment process on the basis of quantitative analysis alone, without any qualitative analysis at all
snapshot.tc: 記錄風險評估程序時以定量分析為基礎，而不進行定質方面的分析

snapshot.en: Considering all the relevant risk factors before determining the level of overall risk and the appropriate level and type of mitigation
snapshot.tc: 在釐定整體風險水平及減低風險措施的適當程度及類別前，考慮所有相關的風險因素

snapshot.en: Obtaining the approval of the MSO's own senior management on the results of the risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 就該項風險評估的結果，取得該經營者本身高級管理層的審批

snapshot.en: Having mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the JFIU, rather than to the CCE, when required to do so
snapshot.tc: 設有適當機制，在被要求時向財富情報組（而非海關關長）提供該風險評估

snapshot.en: having a process that keeps the institutional ML/TF risk assessment up-to-date
snapshot.tc: 設有程序，確保機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估反映現況

evidence.covers: RBA 的设计实施、相称预防、管理减低而非消除风险及机构评估基础

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt an RBA in both the design and the implementation of its AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者制訂和執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施時，均應採用風險為本的方法。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT measures an RBA expects an MSO to take are commensurate with its ML/TF risks and are meant to eliminate those risks.
snapshot.tc: 風險為本的方法預期金錢服務經營者採取與有關風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，旨在消除有關風險。

snapshot.en: An RBA lets an MSO apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of risks, so as to focus its AML/CFT efforts most effectively.
snapshot.tc: 風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者採取與風險性質及水平相稱的預防措施，以最有效的方式着力於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集工作。

snapshot.en: Jurisdictions, competent authorities, MSOs and their agents are all expected, under an RBA, to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks they face.
snapshot.tc: 按風險為本的方法，預期要識別、評估和了解本身所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險者，包括司法管轄區、主管當局、金錢服務經營者及其代理人。

snapshot.en: The institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA, enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF.
snapshot.tc: 機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎，讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響及所受影響的程度。

source_quotes.text: The institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 机构风险因素：客户、国家、产品、渠道及其他因素
covered_aspects: 客户比例、国别犯罪和执法/监管/透明度、业务规模复杂度、匿名性、第三方渠道及员工审计等因素
missing_aspects: 现有技术使用程度及该等渠道受滥用程度作为产品/服务/交易风险因素，未被直接测试

snapshot.en: Customer risk factors are among the range of factors that an MSO should holistically consider in conducting its institutional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 客戶風險因素屬經營者進行機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時應全面考慮的因素之一

snapshot.en: The MSO's own target market and its own customer segments are given as an example of such a customer risk factor
snapshot.tc: 該經營者本身的目標市場及客戶類別，是本指引所舉客戶風險因素的例子之一

snapshot.en: The Guideline refers to the number of customers identified as high risk, but not to their proportion, as a customer risk factor
snapshot.tc: 本指引只提及識別為高風險的客戶數目作為客戶風險因素，而沒有提及其比例

snapshot.en: The customer risk factors listed in the Guideline are examples, so the factors an MSO considers are not confined to those listed
snapshot.tc: 本指引所列的客戶風險因素只是一些例子，故該經營者所考慮的因素並不限於本指引所列者

snapshot.en: The country risk factors concern the countries or jurisdictions the MSO is exposed to, either through its own activities or through the activities of its customers
snapshot.tc: 國家風險因素關乎該經營者所面對的國家或司法管轄區，不論是透過其本身的活動抑或客戶的活動

snapshot.en: Particular attention is given to countries or jurisdictions with greater vulnerability identified by credible sources due to contextual and other risk factors
snapshot.tc: 尤其須注意由可靠消息來源識別為因環境性及其他風險因素而具有較大漏洞的國家或司法管轄區

snapshot.en: The prevalence of corruption, organised crime or TF in a jurisdiction is not among the contextual risk factors that the paragraph lists
snapshot.tc: 某司法管轄區貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度，並非該段所列的環境性風險因素之一

snapshot.en: The general level and quality of a jurisdiction's law enforcement efforts related to AML/CFT is listed as a customer risk factor rather than a country risk factor
snapshot.tc: 某司法管轄區就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集所採取執法工作的水平及質素，被列為客戶風險因素而非國家風險因素

snapshot.en: The transparency of beneficial ownership in a jurisdiction is among the contextual risk factors that the paragraph lists
snapshot.tc: 某司法管轄區在實益擁有權方面的透明程度，亦屬該段所列的其中一項環境性風險因素

snapshot.en: The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the business that is carried on by the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該經營者所經營的業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度

snapshot.en: The characteristics of the products and services offered, and the extent to which they are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
snapshot.tc: 所提供產品及服務的特點及其所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度

snapshot.en: Whether the volume and size of the MSO's transactions are in line with its usual activity and the profile of its customers
snapshot.tc: 該經營者的交易量及交易規模是否與其慣常活動及其客戶概況一致

snapshot.en: Whether the products or services offered by the MSO may inherently favour anonymity
snapshot.tc: 該經營者所提供的產品或服務是否本身可能有利於以匿名行事

snapshot.en: These factors concern the delivery and distribution channels through which the MSO distributes its own products or services
snapshot.tc: 該等有關因素關乎該經營者藉以分銷其本身的產品或服務的有關交付及分銷渠道

snapshot.en: The extent to which the MSO deals directly with the customer, and the extent to which it relies on a third party to conduct CDD, are listed among the factors
snapshot.tc: 該經營者直接與客戶往來的程度，以及其依賴第三者進行客戶盡職審查的程度，均列為該等因素

snapshot.en: The extent to which agent or counterpart networks are used is listed as a product, service or transaction risk factor rather than a delivery channel risk factor
snapshot.tc: 該經營者代理人或交易對手網絡的使用程度，列為產品、服務或交易風險因素，而非交付或分銷渠道風險因素

snapshot.en: The complexity of the payment chain, and of the settlement systems used among operators in the payment chain, is listed among the factors
snapshot.tc: 支付鏈的複雜程度，以及支付鏈中各經營者之間使用的交收系統的複雜程度，列為該等因素

snapshot.en: The results of internal or external audits are excluded from the other risk factors, audit findings being reported directly to the CCE instead
snapshot.tc: 內部或外部審計的有關結果並不屬其他風險因素，有關的審計發現會直接向關長匯報

snapshot.en: The nature, scale and quality of the ML/TF risk management resources available to the MSO are given as an example of the other risk factors
snapshot.tc: 該經營者可供運用的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理資源的性質、規模及質素，是本指引所舉其他風險因素的例子

snapshot.en: The availability of appropriately qualified staff with access to ongoing AML/CFT training and development forms part of the risk management resources considered
snapshot.tc: 是否具備可持續接受打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓並具合適資格的員工，屬所考慮的風險管理資源的一部分

snapshot.en: Any compliance and regulatory findings that relate to the MSO itself are also given as an example of these other risk factors
snapshot.tc: 有關該經營者的合規及監管方面的各項發現，亦是本指引所舉其他風險因素的例子

evidence.covers: 监管成效、偶发交易和可靠来源

snapshot.en: The effectiveness of a jurisdiction's AML/CFT regulatory regimes and controls is among the contextual and other risk factors that can give it greater vulnerability
snapshot.tc: 某司法管轄區打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集監管制度和管控措施的成效，屬可令其具有較大漏洞的環境性及其他風險因素之一

snapshot.en: The extent of conducting occasional transactions is given as an example of how far the MSO's products and services are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse
snapshot.tc: 進行非經常交易的程度，被列為該經營者所提供產品及服務面對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度的例子

snapshot.en: The credible sources that identify jurisdictions of greater vulnerability may include the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group
snapshot.tc: 用以識別具有較大漏洞的司法管轄區的可靠消息來源，可包括國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織

source_quotes.text: the extent to which the MSO uses technology, and the extent to which these channels are vulnerable to ML/TF abuse

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 可与其他机构风险遗漏合为一题；区别既有技术暴露与新技术上线前评估。

topics.topic: 机构评估规模、资料来源及集团评估依赖
covered_aspects: 按规模复杂度调整；内外定量定性资料；本地成立机构集团评估；依赖集团评估须反映本地风险

snapshot.en: The scale and scope of the assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's own business
snapshot.tc: 有關評估的規模和範圍應與金錢服務經營者本身各項業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱

snapshot.en: Every MSO must adopt an equally sophisticated risk assessment process, whatever the size or complexity of its own business
snapshot.tc: 不論業務的規模或複雜程度如何，每一金錢服務經營者均須採用同樣精密的風險評估程序

snapshot.en: For an MSO whose range of products and services is very limited, or whose customers have a homogeneous risk profile, a simpler risk assessment approach might suffice
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者所提供的產品和服務種類非常有限，或其客戶的風險狀況相若，較簡單的風險評估方法可能已足夠

snapshot.en: Where an MSO's products and services are more varied and complex, or its customers have more diverse risk profiles, a more sophisticated risk assessment process will be required
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者的產品和服務較為多樣及複雜，或其客戶的風險狀況差異較大，便須進行較為精密的風險評估程序

evidence.covers: 资料来源及海关通知风险

snapshot.en: The assessment should consider information from the MSO's own internal sources, external information being considered at the customer level instead
snapshot.tc: 評估應考慮該經營者本身內部來源的資料，外部來源的資料則在客戶層面考慮

snapshot.en: The assessment should consider both quantitative and qualitative information in order to identify, manage and mitigate the risks
snapshot.tc: 評估應考慮數量及質量兩方面的分析資料，以識別、管理及減低有關風險

snapshot.en: The assessment may take into account relevant risk assessments and guidance issued by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities
snapshot.tc: 評估可考慮財務行動特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局發出的相關風險評估及導引

snapshot.en: The assessment may take into account Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and should take into account any higher risks notified to MSOs by the CCE
snapshot.tc: 評估可考慮香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並應顧及關長通報的任何較高風險

snapshot.en: An MSO with branches or subsidiaries should perform a group-wide ML/TF risk assessment even if it is incorporated outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 設有分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，即使在香港以外成立為法團，亦應進行集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。

snapshot.en: An MSO that is part of a financial group may refer to or rely on a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment once one has been conducted.
snapshot.tc: 屬金融集團成員的金錢服務經營者，可參考或依賴在集團或地區層面已進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。

snapshot.en: It applies for the purposes of both the institutional ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.2 and the group-wide ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.7
snapshot.tc: 該項依賴為施行第2.2及2.7段（機構層面及集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）而適用

snapshot.en: It applies where the MSO is part of a financial group and a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment has been conducted
snapshot.tc: 該項依賴適用於該經營者屬某金融集團的成員，而在集團或地區層面已進行有關風險評估的情況

snapshot.en: The MSO may make reference to, or place reliance on, the financial group’s group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可參考或依賴所屬金融集團在集團或地區層面所進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估

snapshot.en: Such reliance is permitted only where the assessment adequately reflects the ML/TF risks that are posed to the MSO in the local context
snapshot.tc: 惟有關評估須充分反映該經營者在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，方可如此依賴

source_quotes.text: adequately reflect ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context

topics.topic: 机构评估更新时点与留档
covered_aspects: 每两年及重大触发事件；新渠道/产品/客户及重大业务变化；高层批准；留存因素、来源和系统评估

snapshot.en: The assessment should be conducted every two years, and also upon trigger events which are material to the MSO's business and risk exposure
snapshot.tc: 評估應每兩年進行一次，而當會顯著影響該經營者業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後亦應覆核其評估

snapshot.en: A significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems is given as an example of a trigger event for such a review
snapshot.tc: 嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，是本指引所舉觸發覆核的事件例子

snapshot.en: The launch of new products and services by the MSO is not regarded as a trigger event for such a review
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者推出新的產品及服務，並不視為觸發有關覆核的事件之一

snapshot.en: The results of the review should be documented and approved by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
snapshot.tc: 覆核的結果應記錄在案，並由海關關長（而非該經營者的高級管理層）審批

snapshot.en: Significant changes of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts are given as examples of trigger events
snapshot.tc: 該經營者的營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有重大改變，是本指引所舉觸發事件的例子

snapshot.en: Reviewing the institutional risk assessment after acquiring a delivery channel that materially affects the MSO's business and risk exposure
snapshot.tc: 收購新交付渠道顯著影響業務及風險後，覆核機構層面的風險評估

evidence.covers: 记录内容及不得批准后丢弃

snapshot.en: The records should cover the risk factors that were identified and assessed in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 紀錄應涵蓋在進行該項風險評估時已識別及評估的各項風險因素

snapshot.en: The records should cover the information sources that were taken into account in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 紀錄應涵蓋在進行該項風險評估時已加以考慮的各項資料來源

snapshot.en: The records should cover the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 紀錄應涵蓋就該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的充分性及適當性所作的評估

snapshot.en: The records and relevant documents may be discarded once senior management has approved the results of the assessment
snapshot.tc: 有關的評估結果經高級管理層批准後，該等紀錄及相關的所有文件便可予以棄置

evidence.covers: 两年周期、重大触发事件、新客户群及风险因素/资料/系统充足性记录

snapshot.en: An MSO should conduct the assessment every three years and upon trigger events which are material to its business and risk exposure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應每三年進行一次評估，並在發生會顯著影響其業務及所面對風險的觸發事件後覆核評估。

snapshot.en: Trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems or the acquisition of new customer segments.
snapshot.tc: 觸發事件可包括嚴重違反金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，或收購新的客戶類別。

snapshot.en: Trigger events may include any change of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts.
snapshot.tc: 觸發事件可包括金錢服務經營者的營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手出現的任何改變。
