snapshot.en: Records of the assessment should include the risk factors identified and assessed, and the information sources taken into account.
snapshot.tc: 評估的紀錄和相關文件應包括所識別及評估的風險因素，以及所考慮的資料來源。

snapshot.en: The records kept should include the evaluation made on whether the MSO's AML/CFT Systems are adequate and appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 評估的紀錄應包括就金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度是否充分和適當而作出的評估。

source_quotes.text: every two years and upon trigger events which are material to the MSO’s business and risk exposure

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 新产品、业务模式和技术上线前评估
covered_aspects: 新及既有产品的新技术、新交付机制；上线前评估；管理减低已识别风险

snapshot.en: Developing new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms, is one of the matters whose ML/TF risks an MSO should identify and assess.
snapshot.tc: 開發新經營方法（包括新的交付機制）可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者應加以識別和評估。

snapshot.en: The ML/TF risks of a new or developing technology should be assessed even where it is used only for the MSO's pre-existing products.
snapshot.tc: 即使嶄新或開發中的科技只用於既有產品，金錢服務經營者亦應評估使用這類科技的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: An MSO should carry out the risk assessment before it launches the new products or business practices, or starts to use the technologies.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應在推出新產品、新經營方法或使用嶄新或開發中的科技前，事先進行風險評估。

snapshot.en: The MSO should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the ML/TF risks that its prior risk assessment identifies.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施，管理和減低事先進行的風險評估所識別的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

evidence.covers: 新产品/业务模式、既有产品新技术；上线前评估及减低已识别风险

snapshot.en: An MSO should identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms
snapshot.tc: 經營者應識別和評估因開發新產品及新經營方法（包括新交付機制）而可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: An MSO should identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise from the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products
snapshot.tc: 經營者應識別和評估因新產品及既有產品使用嶄新或開發中科技而可能產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The risk assessment should be undertaken prior to the launch of the new products or new business practices, or the use of the new or developing technologies
snapshot.tc: 風險評估應在推出新產品或新經營方法，或使用嶄新或開發中的科技之前進行

snapshot.en: The MSO should then take appropriate measures to manage and to mitigate all of the risks that the assessment has in fact identified
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者其後應採取適當的措施，以管理和減低評估所識別出的各項風險

source_quotes.text: prior to the launch of the new products, new business practices, or the use of new or developing technologies

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 客户风险评估、持续更新与框架记录
covered_aspects: CDD 强度、完成后决定持续监察及关系存续、定期/持续更新、机构评估导出框架、为个别客户风险保留依据

snapshot.en: The assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determines whether any statutory CDD measures need to be applied, rather than the extent of the measures to be applied
snapshot.tc: 在客戶盡職審查程序初期所作的評估，決定的是是否需要採取任何盡職審查措施，而非需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施

snapshot.en: The assessment is of no assistance in differentiating between the risks of individual customers and business relationships, since the same CDD measures are applied to every relationship
snapshot.tc: 該評估無助於分辨個別客戶與業務關係所涉的風險，因為每項業務關係均採取相同的盡職審查措施

snapshot.en: An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, an exercise usually referred to as a customer risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應評估與客戶或擬開展的業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，這類評估一般稱為客戶風險評估

snapshot.en: Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher, the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased
snapshot.tc: 如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹的方式核實資料

snapshot.en: Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower, the information obtained and the extent of its verification may be simplified
snapshot.tc: 如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低，金錢服務經營者則可簡化審查程序

snapshot.en: The customer risk assessment should be finalised on the basis of a holistic view of all of the information that is obtained in applying CDD measures
snapshot.tc: 客戶風險評估應基於在採取客戶盡職審查措施過程中所取得資料的整體看法而敲定

snapshot.en: The finalised assessment determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring, including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring
snapshot.tc: 敲定的評估決定持續監察的程度及類別，包括持續的盡職審查及交易監察

snapshot.en: The finalised assessment plays no part in the MSO's decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship
snapshot.tc: 敲定的評估與該經營者就是否建立、繼續或終止業務關係所作的決定無關

snapshot.en: As the customer risk profile will change over time, the MSO should review and update the assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring
snapshot.tc: 由於客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，該經營者應不時（尤其在持續監察期間）覆核及更新該評估

snapshot.en: The MSO should use an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework, whose complexity should be proportionate to the nature and size of its business.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採用風險為本的方法制訂客戶風險評估框架，而框架的複雜程度應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。

snapshot.en: The results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should form the basis on which the framework is designed.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應以其機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果為依據，制訂客戶風險評估框架。

snapshot.en: In general, the framework will include customer, country, and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，框架會包含客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素。

snapshot.en: The MSO should keep the records so that it can demonstrate to the JFIU how it assesses a customer's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 有關紀錄應讓金錢服務經營者能夠向聯合財富情報組證明它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring for a customer is appropriate to the customer's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 有關紀錄應能證明，基於個別客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。

evidence.covers: 通常仍须所有 CDD 和持续监察

snapshot.en: Except in certain situations the Guideline specifies, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers.
snapshot.tc: 除指引指明的若干情況外，金錢服務經營者應時刻執行所有盡職審查措施，並持續監察其客戶。

evidence.covers: 客户风险框架设计与实施、复杂度、机构评估基础及完整风险因素

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt a risk-based approach in both the design and in the implementation of its own customer risk assessment framework
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者制訂及執行其客戶風險評估框架時，均應採用風險為本的方法

snapshot.en: The complexity of the framework should be commensurate with the nature and the size of the MSO's business
snapshot.tc: 該框架的複雜程度應與金錢服務經營者所經營的各項業務的性質和規模相稱

snapshot.en: The framework should be designed based on the results of the MSO's own institutional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 該框架應根據金錢服務經營者機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的有關結果制訂

snapshot.en: The framework will in general include customer and country risk factors, product and channel factors being left to the institutional assessment
snapshot.tc: 該框架一般包含客戶及國家風險因素，產品及交付渠道因素則由機構層面評估處理

evidence.covers: 客户评估记录、向关长证明及按个别客户风险确定 CDD/监察程度

snapshot.en: An MSO should keep records and relevant documents of all the customer risk assessments that it conducts
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者均應就其所進行的每一項客戶風險評估備存有關的紀錄及相關的所有文件

snapshot.en: The records should enable the MSO to demonstrate to the CCE, among others, how it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks
snapshot.tc: 該等紀錄應使該經營者能向海關關長證明（其中包括）它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 該等紀錄應證明客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是否合適，並以機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估為基準

snapshot.en: The appropriateness of the CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is to be demonstrated by reference to that particular customer's ML/TF risks
snapshot.tc: 客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是否合適，須以個別客戶本身的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險為基準證明

source_quotes.text: the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on that customer’s ML/TF risks

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: AML/CFT 系统组成、批准及简化条件
covered_aspects: 合理保障、高层批准和实施监控、较高风险增强、低风险简化的条件/不得有怀疑、合规审计筛选培训四要素

snapshot.en: The purpose of the AML/CFT Systems is to enable the MSO to effectively manage and mitigate the risks that are relevant to the MSO
snapshot.tc: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的目的，是確保經營者能有效管理和減低與其相關的風險

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT Systems should be submitted to the CCE for approval before they are implemented by the MSO
snapshot.tc: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應在該經營者推行前，呈交海關關長審批

snapshot.en: The MSO should monitor the implementation of those AML/CFT Systems and enhance them if necessary
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應監察該等制度的推行情況，並在有需要時優化有關的制度

snapshot.en: The MSO should take enhanced measures to manage and to mitigate those risks where any higher risks are identified
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應在識別出較高風險時採取更為嚴格的措施，以管理和減低該等有關風險

snapshot.en: The MSO must comply with the statutory requirements in Schedule 2 to the AMLO and those in paragraphs 2.2, 2.3 and 3.2 of the Guideline
snapshot.tc: 該經營者須遵從《打擊洗錢條例》附表2所訂的法定規定，以及《指引》第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定

snapshot.en: The lower ML/TF risks relied on may be assumed from the MSO's small size, without being identified through any risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，可從該經營者規模較小推定，而無須透過任何風險評估識別

snapshot.en: The simplified AML/CFT Systems must be approved by senior management and be subject to review from time to time
snapshot.tc: 簡化了的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須經高級管理層審批，並須不時接受覆核

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT Systems are never permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML or TF
snapshot.tc: 凡有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，一律不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度

snapshot.en: The Systems should be implemented having regard to the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from them
snapshot.tc: 推行該等制度時，應顧及該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及所引致的風險

snapshot.en: The Systems should also include appropriate compliance management arrangements and an independent audit function of the MSO's own
snapshot.tc: 該等制度亦應包括適當的合規管理方面的安排，以及其本身的獨立審核職能

snapshot.en: The Systems should include procedures for the screening of the MSO's employees before their appointment
snapshot.tc: 該等制度應包括在委任之前甄選該經營者各名僱員的相關程序

snapshot.en: An ongoing employee training programme is not one of the elements that the AML/CFT Systems should include
snapshot.tc: 持續的僱員培訓計劃，並非該等制度應予包括的其中一項要素

snapshot.en: Compliance management arrangements should include, as a minimum, senior management oversight and the appointment of both a CO and an MLRO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排最低限度應涵蓋高級管理層的監督，以及合規主任和洗錢報告主任各一名的委任。

snapshot.en: Subject to the size of the MSO, the CO function and the MLRO function need not be performed by two different people.
snapshot.tc: 視乎金錢服務經營者的規模，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能無須由不同人士執行。

evidence.covers: 合规管理目的、最低监督/任命及按规模兼任 CO 和 MLRO

snapshot.en: The arrangements should facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with its relevant legal and regulatory obligations
snapshot.tc: 該等安排應便利該經營者推行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以履行其相關法律及監管責任

snapshot.en: The arrangements should also facilitate the MSO in managing its own ML/TF risks in an effective way and manner
snapshot.tc: 該等安排亦應便利該經營者有效管理其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: At a minimum, the arrangements should include oversight by the MSO's senior management and the appointment of a CO and an MLRO
snapshot.tc: 該等安排最低限度應包括由該經營者的高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任

snapshot.en: Depending on the size of the MSO, the functions of the CO and the MLRO may be performed by the same person
snapshot.tc: 視乎該經營者的規模，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行

evidence.covers: 简化为许可、适当低风险评估、高层批准及定期复核、怀疑时不得简化

snapshot.en: Where lower ML/TF risks have been identified, the MSO must simplify the nature, scale and complexity of its AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 如已識別出較低的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，便須簡化有關制度的性質、規模及複雜程度。

snapshot.en: The lower ML/TF risks on which a simplification is based must have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment.
snapshot.tc: 作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，須是基於適當的風險評估而識別出來的。

snapshot.en: Simplified AML/CFT Systems need the approval of senior management and must be reviewed from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 簡化的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須經高級管理層審批，並須由金錢服務經營者不時覆核。

snapshot.en: AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF, even if the conditions are otherwise met.
snapshot.tc: 即使符合其他條件，如懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，亦不准簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: A simplification requires the MSO to comply with Schedule 2 to the AMLO and to notify the CCE of the simplification in advance.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須符合《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的法定規定，並事先把簡化安排通知關長，方可簡化有關制度。

source_quotes.text: AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 高层监督及 CO、MLRO 职责
covered_aspects: 董事/高层理解风险、管理资料及时完整准确易懂、CO 系统统筹、MLRO 内部报告/决定 STR/记录/防通风报信

snapshot.en: Both senior management and the board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, should clearly understand the MSO's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層，以及董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用），均應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Management information on ML/TF risks should reach senior management in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner.
snapshot.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層。

snapshot.en: Senior management is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems that can adequately manage the ML/TF risks identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以妥善管理已識別的風險。

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint the MLRO at the management level, with overall responsibility for establishing and maintaining the AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的洗錢報告主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: Acting as the focal point for the oversight of all activities relating to the prevention and detection of ML/TF
snapshot.tc: 作為金錢服務經營者的中心點，監督一切防止及偵察洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的活動

snapshot.en: Continuously reviewing the AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide Systems of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to keep them up-to-date
snapshot.tc: 持續覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度（在香港成為法團者包括集團層面的制度），確保制度反映現況

snapshot.en: Overseeing every aspect of the AML/CFT Systems, which includes monitoring how effective they are and enhancing controls where necessary
snapshot.tc: 全方位監督打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控

snapshot.en: Communicating every AML/CFT issue that arises to senior management, the minor issues as well as the key ones
snapshot.tc: 就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的每一個問題（包括輕微的問題）與高級管理層進行溝通

snapshot.en: Making sure that the AML/CFT training of the MSO's staff is adequate, appropriate and effective
snapshot.tc: 確保為職員提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓是充足、適當而且有效的

snapshot.en: Besides law enforcement agencies, the MLRO is the MSO's main point of contact with the Joint Financial Information Unit.
snapshot.tc: 除執法機構外，洗錢報告主任亦是金錢服務經營者與聯合財務情報組聯繫的主要聯絡點。

snapshot.en: The MLRO's principal functions should include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的主要職能應包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告。

snapshot.en: The MLRO should play an active role in the identification, as well as the reporting, of suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任應在識別及報告可疑交易方面擔當積極的角色。

snapshot.en: Keeping all records related to the internal reviews of disclosures is among the matters the MLRO should oversee.
snapshot.tc: 備存內部覆核的所有紀錄，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。

snapshot.en: Among the functions the MLRO should oversee is the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 提供有關如何避免通風報訊的導引，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。

evidence.covers: 高层实施责任、CO 管理层级与统筹职责、MLRO 报告中枢

snapshot.en: Responsibility for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems rests with the CCE rather than with the MSO's own senior management
snapshot.tc: 推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的責任，在於海關關長而非該經營者的高級管理層

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint a Compliance Officer at the management level within the MSO itself
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名屬該經營者管理層的人員，出任其合規主任一職

snapshot.en: The CO has the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 合規主任全面負責建立及維持該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint a senior staff member as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點

evidence.covers: MLRO 联络、内部披露决定、记录及防通风报信指导；区别 CO

snapshot.en: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點

snapshot.en: The MLRO's functions include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向財富情報組報告

snapshot.en: Oversight of the records of internal reviews of disclosures and exception reports is the Compliance Officer's responsibility
snapshot.tc: 監督備存內部披露及例外情況報告的覆核紀錄，屬合規主任的主要職能

snapshot.en: The MLRO's principal functions include oversight of the provision of guidance on how to avoid “tipping off”
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引

evidence.covers: 治理安排、高层理解及管理风险、管理资料及时完整准确

snapshot.en: Effective management of ML/TF risk requires adequate governance arrangements to be put in place within the MSO
snapshot.tc: 要有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者必須在其機構內作出適當的管治安排

snapshot.en: The board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, and the senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的董事會（或獲其授權的委員會，如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解該經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The board, or its delegated committee, and senior management should ensure the MSO's ML/TF risks are adequately managed
snapshot.tc: 董事會或獲其授權的委員會及高級管理層應確保已妥善管理金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: Management information on ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to senior management in a timely, complete and accurate manner
snapshot.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整及準確方式通知高級管理層

source_quotes.text: act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 管理资料收件人按 E29；已用双方共同适用范围。

topics.topic: CO/MLRO 的地位、独立性、资料和资源保障
covered_aspects: 资格、依规模独立、通常驻港、资历权限、直接接触高层、及时取得内外资料及副手任命主体
missing_aspects: 充分熟悉本机构法律监管要求及业务风险；充足人员和缺勤替补资源未完整测试；副手同等地位的语言差异不得制成单一双语真假陷阱

evidence.covers: 资格独立性驻地资料及副手主体

snapshot.en: They should be appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge to discharge their responsibilities properly
snapshot.tc: 他們應擁有合適資格，並具備足夠的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識以履行職責

snapshot.en: They should be placed within, rather than independent of, the MSO's own operational and business functions, regardless of the MSO's size
snapshot.tc: 不論該經營者的規模如何，他們均應置於該經營者的營運及業務職能之內，而非獨立於該等職能

snapshot.en: They should normally be based in Hong Kong and be of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO
snapshot.tc: 他們通常應長駐香港，並在該金錢服務經營者具有一定的資歷及權力

snapshot.en: They should be capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available internal information such as CDD records and external sources such as CCE circulars
snapshot.tc: 他們應能及時取得一切可得資料，包括客戶盡職審查紀錄等內部來源及關長通函等外部來源

snapshot.en: They should be provided with an alternate or deputy who is appointed by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
snapshot.tc: 他們應獲配替補人選，而該替補人選由關長而非由高級管理層委任

snapshot.en: They are appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge.
snapshot.tc: 擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識。

snapshot.en: They are independent of all operational and business functions.
snapshot.tc: 獨立於金錢服務經營者的所有營運及業務職能。

snapshot.en: They are of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 在金錢服務經營者內部具有一定的資歷及權力。

snapshot.en: They have regular contact with senior management and, when required, direct access.
snapshot.tc: 與高級管理層保持定期聯絡，並在有需要時能直接聯絡高級管理層。

source_quotes.text: equipped with sufficient resources, including staff and appropriate cover for the absence of the CO and MLRO

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 补职责所需资源、法律风险知识和替补；用双方共同支持的表述，不考 E28 分歧。
topics.notes: E28 对 where practicable 的限定对象不同；需要在命题简报标明已决定的语言规则。

topics.topic: 独立审计的路径、范围及频率
covered_aspects: 直接向高层沟通、资源专业知识、四项审查范围、频率匹配业务风险及适当时外部审查

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑

snapshot.en: The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責

snapshot.en: The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報

snapshot.en: The review should cover the adequacy of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, its ML/TF risk assessment framework and its application of the RBA
snapshot.tc: 覆核應涵蓋打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用情況是否合適

snapshot.en: The review covers the effectiveness of the MSO's suspicious transaction reporting systems every third year rather than at each review
snapshot.tc: 該項覆核每三年才涵蓋金錢服務經營者報告可疑交易的制度的有關成效，而非每次覆核均涵蓋

snapshot.en: The review should also cover the effectiveness of the compliance function operating within the MSO
snapshot.tc: 審核職能的覆核亦應涵蓋金錢服務經營者內部所運作的合規職能是否有效

snapshot.en: The review should cover the level of awareness of the MSO's staff who have AML/CFT responsibilities of their own
snapshot.tc: 覆核應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平

snapshot.en: The frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business
snapshot.tc: 有關覆核的頻密程度及範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱

snapshot.en: The frequency and extent of the review should also be commensurate with the ML/TF risks that arise from the MSO's own businesses
snapshot.tc: 覆核的頻密程度及範圍亦應與金錢服務經營者的業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱

snapshot.en: The review must be carried out by external parties whenever the MSO's own audit function has been in place for less than three years
snapshot.tc: 凡金錢服務經營者本身的審核職能設立不足三年，有關的覆核均須由外界人士進行，而非由內部職能進行

snapshot.en: Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review of its own AML/CFT Systems from any external parties
snapshot.tc: 在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度進行覆核

evidence.covers: 独立审计范围、员工意识及适当时外部审查，不等于每次强制外审

snapshot.en: The audit function's regular review should cover the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, ML/TF risk assessment framework and use of the RBA.
snapshot.tc: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度及風險評估框架是否合適，以及風險為本方法的應用，均屬定期覆核應涵蓋的事項。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover how effective the MSO's compliance function is.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的合規職能是否有效。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover the accuracy of the MSO's financial statements.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的財務報表是否準確。

snapshot.en: In addition to the audit function's own review, the MSO should seek a review of its AML/CFT Systems from external parties.
snapshot.tc: 除審核職能本身的覆核外，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界覆核其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

source_quotes.text: Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review from external parties.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 员工意识用语按 E36，各语言不以分歧判错。

topics.topic: 海外集团系统及信息共享
covered_aspects: 适用海外业务、同等 CDD/纪录、保密/防通风报信前提、必要信息和双向分享、较高标准、当地不准时通知关长及加措施

evidence.covers: CDD 及记录与当地法前提

snapshot.en: The duty applies to a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and is discharged through its own group-wide AML/CFT Systems in place
snapshot.tc: 該責任適用於在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者，並透過其集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度履行

snapshot.en: It covers all of the MSO's overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings which carry on the same business as an FI as that term is defined in the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該責任涵蓋該經營者經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的外地分行及附屬企業

snapshot.en: Those branches and subsidiaries should have procedures for CDD and record-keeping rules similar to Schedule 2 Parts 2–3, as far as local law permits
snapshot.tc: 該等分行及附屬企業應設程序，在當地法律准許範圍內遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定

snapshot.en: Those procedures must be applied in full regardless of what the laws and regulations of the place concerned permit
snapshot.tc: 不論有關所在地方的法律及規例是否有所准許，該等有關的程序均須全面地予以貫徹實施

snapshot.en: The measures are required only to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions that are involved in the matter
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者透過集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度實施資料共用措施，以所涉司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限

snapshot.en: The measures are subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of the information being shared, including safeguards to prevent tipping off
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者實施集團層面的資料共用措施，須妥善保障共用資料的保密需要及用途，包括設有防止通風報訊的保障

snapshot.en: The measures should provide for the sharing of information required for the purposes of CDD and ML/TF risk management within the group
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的集團層面資料共用措施，應涵蓋為客戶盡職審查及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理目的所需的資料

snapshot.en: The group-level compliance, audit or AML/CFT functions should receive customer, account and transaction information from overseas branches when necessary for AML/CFT purposes
snapshot.tc: 集團合規、審核或打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職能應按打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集需要獲提供外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料

evidence.covers: 异常分析、STR 和双向信息

snapshot.en: The information should include information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, where such analysis was done
snapshot.tc: 該等資料應包括似乎異常的交易或活動的相關資料及分析（如已作這類分析）

snapshot.en: A suspicious transaction report, or the fact that one has been submitted, may be provided to group-level functions only after the JFIU gives its consent
snapshot.tc: 可疑交易報告或已提交報告一事，須先取得財富情報組的同意，才可交予集團層面的職能

snapshot.en: The information could also include the underlying information that lies behind any such suspicious transaction report itself
snapshot.tc: 該等資料亦可以包括任何有關可疑交易報告背後所依據的相關資料

snapshot.en: Branches and subsidiary undertakings should likewise receive such information from the group-level functions when relevant and appropriate to risk management
snapshot.tc: 在與風險管理有關及適用的情況下，分支機構及附屬企業亦應從該等集團層面職能取得這類資料

evidence.covers: 不准适用较高标准时处理

snapshot.en: The requirement applies where the laws of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於在香港成立為法團的經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，因所在地法律不准許而未能執行較嚴格規定的情況

snapshot.en: The MSO informs the CCE of the failure in its next routine filing, having first recorded the failure and its causes in its own internal records
snapshot.tc: 該經營者會在下一次例行提交資料時將該情況通知關長，並先在其內部記錄該情況及其成因

snapshot.en: The requirements of particular concern are the CDD and record-keeping requirements that are imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2
snapshot.tc: 尤其受關注的規定，是根據附表2第2及3部所施加的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定

snapshot.en: The MSO should take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result of its inability to comply with the requirements
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應採取額外措施，以有效地減低分行或附屬企業因不能遵從該等規定而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: These duties bind an MSO that is incorporated in Hong Kong, and they bind in exactly the same way an MSO that is a re-domiciled entity, as the Ordinance defines that term.
snapshot.tc: 在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者須負上該等責任，屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的經遷冊實體的金錢服務經營者亦同樣須負上該等責任。

evidence.covers: 集团要求适用主体/金融业务范围、海外相关规定及较高标准

snapshot.en: The requirement applies to every MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings, whether or not the MSO is incorporated in Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 該規定適用於所有設有外地分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，不論該經營者是否在香港成立為法團

snapshot.en: It applies where the overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該規定適用於外地分行或附屬企業經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的情況

snapshot.en: Subject to host laws and regulations, group-wide Systems should apply the Guideline's relevant and applicable requirements to all overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings in the financial group
snapshot.tc: 在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內，集團層面制度應向金融集團所有外地分行及附屬企業執行相關及適用的指引規定

snapshot.en: Where a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should require the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets, so far as host laws permit
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，須規定分行或附屬企業在當地法律准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定

evidence.covers: 所在地司法管辖区及当地法律容许下适用较高标准，不可任择较低标准

snapshot.en: The position concerns the overseas branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and the jurisdiction in which it is located, referred to as the host jurisdiction
snapshot.tc: 該情況關乎在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，以及其位處的司法管轄區（即所在的司法管轄區）

snapshot.en: Where requirements differ, the MSO should require its branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher standard to the extent permitted by host laws and regulations
snapshot.tc: 如兩套規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定外地分行或附屬企業在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格的規定

snapshot.en: The branch or the subsidiary undertaking is required to apply the higher requirements to the extent that the host jurisdiction's own laws and regulations permit
snapshot.tc: 外地分行或附屬企業執行兩套規定中較嚴格的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定，以所在司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限

snapshot.en: Where the host jurisdiction's requirements are the less stringent of the two, the branch or subsidiary undertaking may choose to follow them instead
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的有關規定是兩套規定中較為寬鬆者，外地分行或附屬企業可選擇改為遵從該套較寬鬆的規定

evidence.covers: 海外相关要求、STR 共享、不能采用较高标准时通知及按必要性共享信息

snapshot.en: Through the group-wide Systems, the MSO should apply the Guideline's requirements to every overseas branch and subsidiary undertaking in its financial group, wherever relevant and applicable.
snapshot.tc: 集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，應在本指引的規定關乎及適用時，對所有屬其金融集團的外地分行及附屬企業執行相關規定。

snapshot.en: The information provided to the MSO's group-level functions could include a suspicious transaction report or the fact that one has been submitted.
snapshot.tc: 交予集團層面的合規及審核等職能的資料，亦可以包括可疑交易報告或已提交可疑交易報告一事。

snapshot.en: The MSO should inform the CCE whenever the AML/CFT requirements of a host jurisdiction differ from those set out in the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定與本指引有差異，金錢服務經營者便應通知關長。

snapshot.en: If a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should have the branch or subsidiary apply whichever set is higher, to the extent the host's laws and regulations permit.
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定分行或附屬企業於當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格者。

snapshot.en: Subject to the laws involved and to safeguards, group-level functions should receive the overseas branches' customer, account and transaction information monthly.
snapshot.tc: 在法律准許及設有妥善保障的情況下，集團層面的職能應每月收取外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料。

source_quotes.text: take additional measures to effectively mitigate ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 迁册公司遵 B40。

topics.topic: CDD 基本措施、客户与第三方的界定
covered_aspects: 可靠独立来源核实、实益拥有人、关系目的和代理权限等基础规则已有分散题句
missing_aspects: 汇出电汇受款人如与汇款机构没有其他关系，不因此成为该机构的客户；区分客户 CDD 与电汇受款人资料义务。

evidence.covers: 身份核实来源、实益拥有人和关系目的

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system, a source the AMLO names.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據認可數碼識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，該系統屬《打擊洗錢條例》所列的來源之一。

snapshot.en: For any beneficial owner of the customer, the CDD measures call for identifying it and for reasonable measures to verify its identity, so that the MSO is satisfied it knows who that owner is.
snapshot.tc: 就客戶的任何實益擁有人，客戶盡職審查措施規定須識別該實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，使金錢服務經營者信納知道其為何人。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the CDD measures include obtaining information on the purpose and intended nature of the transaction, unless they are obvious.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，客戶盡職審查措施包括取得關於該交易的目的及擬具有的性質的資料，但如有關目的及性質屬顯而易見則除外。

snapshot.en: The MSO must understand the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship; in some instances this is self-evident, but in many cases it may have to obtain information.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者必須了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質；這在某些情況下不言而喻，但在許多情況下或須取得這方面的資料。

snapshot.en: The information the MSO obtains to understand the purpose and intended nature should be commensurate with the customer's risk profile and the nature of the business relationship.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者為了解目的及擬具有的性質而取得的資料，應與客戶的風險狀況及業務關係的性質相稱。

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

evidence.covers: 一般第三方定义已有；不等于已测试电汇受款人的客户身份

snapshot.en: A third party means any person other than the customer, and an MSO should exercise care if it suspects that a customer may be effecting a transaction on behalf of one.
snapshot.tc: 「第三方」指客戶以外的任何人；如懷疑客戶可能正為第三方進行交易，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

source_quotes.text: This generally excludes the third parties of a transaction.
這通常並不包括某一交易的第三方。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 用一笔汇出款说明客户、第三方、受款人、代理的不同角色，避免把受款人的筛查义务误作客户 CDD。
topics.notes: 交叉复核：一般第三方与客户不同已有 m1-138#3；尚未考汇出款受款人无其他关系时不是汇款机构客户。

topics.topic: CDD 触发时点、业务关系和关联偶发交易
covered_aspects: 12 万偶发交易、8 千电汇、怀疑和资料疑点、关系持续性、多个关联交易累计、旧客户事件

evidence.covers: 金额和不受金额限制的触发

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before a transaction of $120,000 or more for a customer who has no business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 為與金錢服務經營者沒有業務關係的客戶執行涉及$120,000或以上款額的交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 為客戶執行屬電傳轉賬、涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required before an occasional currency exchange of $8,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 為客戶執行涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）、屬貨幣兌換的非經常交易之前，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required when the MSO suspects the customer or its account of money laundering or terrorist financing, whatever the amount involved.
snapshot.tc: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑客戶或客戶的戶口涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，不論所涉款額多少，均須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained to identify or verify the customer.
snapshot.tc: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑過往為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: A professional or commercial relationship between a person and the MSO, as much as a business one, is a business relationship if it has an element of duration.
snapshot.tc: 某人與金錢服務經營者之間的專業或商業關係，與業務上的關係一樣，如延續一段時間是該關係的元素，即屬業務關係。

snapshot.en: A relationship between a person and the MSO is a business relationship if the person, when first contacting the MSO as a potential customer, expects it to have an element of duration.
snapshot.tc: 某人與金錢服務經營者之間的關係，如該人在首次以準客戶身分接觸金錢服務經營者時期望延續一段時間是該關係的元素，該關係即屬業務關係。

snapshot.en: An occasional transaction carried out in several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked calls for CDD measures beforehand if it involves $120,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 以金錢服務經營者覺得有關連的若干次操作執行、涉及$120,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易，須事先執行客戶盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: A transaction that falls outside the scope of a customer's existing business relationship with the MSO is, for that reason, an occasional transaction of that customer.
snapshot.tc: 如某項交易超出客戶與金錢服務經營者之間現有業務關係的範圍，該交易即因此屬該客戶與金錢服務經營者之間的非經常交易。

evidence.covers: 偶发种类及判断关联因素

snapshot.en: Occasional transactions may include, for example, wire transfers, virtual asset transfers, remittance services, currency exchanges and purchases of cashier orders.
snapshot.tc: 舉例來說，金錢服務經營者為客戶執行的非經常交易，可包括電傳轉帳、虛擬資產轉帳、匯款服務、貨幣兌換及購買銀行本票。

snapshot.en: In deciding whether occasional transactions are in fact linked, an MSO should consider the factors inherent in their characteristics against the timeframe within which they are conducted.
snapshot.tc: 在決定非經常交易事實上是否有關連時，金錢服務經營者應將交易本身特徵所顯示的有關連因素，與進行交易的時間一併加以考慮。

evidence.covers: 仅测试虚拟资产纪录门槛

snapshot.en: For the five-year retention of records on occasional transactions, virtual asset transfers share the $120,000 CDD threshold that applies to other types of transactions.
snapshot.tc: 就非經常交易的紀錄應備存至少5年的規定而言，虛擬資產轉帳與其他類別的交易一樣，適用120,000元的盡職審查門檻。

source_quotes.text: when the MSO suspects that the customer or the customer’s account is involved in ML/TF

topics.priority_reason: MSO 主要 CDD 触发规则已实际测试；单凭合并条文含虚拟资产转移，不扩成专门业务补题任务。
topics.notes: 虚拟资产转移 8 千 CDD 门槛在 ¶4.2.1 出现但未直接测试，仅作适用边界参考；已有 m7-183 第 5 句测记录门槛。本次不据此扩大 MSO 题库范围。

topics.topic: 非账户授权人进行大额第三方现金交易
missing_aspects: 达到或超过 120,000 的现金交易由姓名不在账户委托书者进行时，索取其身份证明并保存副本供持续监察。

source_quotes.text: When a cash transaction involving an amount equal to or exceeding $120,000 is undertaken by a person whose name does not appear on the mandate of an account
而該人的姓名不在帳戶委託書上

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 给定现金金额和来人是否在授权名单，测试索取及留存副本；与一般第三方付款风险控制分清。
topics.notes: m6-356/382/383 的第三方付款政策没有测试该特定金额及身份证明副本要求。 交叉复核：全库未找到非账户授权人现金交易达到 12 万时索取证件并保留副本的特定组合义务。一般第三方风险控制不等于该固定触发条件。

topics.topic: 自然人客户的识别及核实资料
covered_aspects: 识别与核实字段不同、国籍不必核实、住址收集与核实区分、照片例外、合法可靠来源

evidence.covers: 自然人字段和照片例外

snapshot.en: The MSO should obtain at least the customer's full name, date of birth, nationality, and identity number and document type.
snapshot.tc: 最低限度應收集客戶的全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件類別。

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the customer's nationality, along with the name and date of birth, against a reliable and independent source.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據可靠及獨立來源，核實客戶的國籍、姓名及出生日期。

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the customer's residential address by reference to a proof of address.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應參考住址證明文件，核實屬自然人的客戶的住址資料。

snapshot.en: An identification document without a photograph may be accepted in exceptional circumstances, once the risks are assessed and mitigated.
snapshot.tc: 如情況特殊，經妥善評估和減低所涉及的風險後，可以接納沒有照片的身分證明文件。

snapshot.en: The MSO should obtain the customer's occupation as part of the minimum identification information.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集客戶的職業，作為識別資料的一部分。

evidence.covers: 可靠来源及获认可数码系统

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system, a source the AMLO names.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據認可數碼識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，該系統屬《打擊洗錢條例》所列的來源之一。

snapshot.en: For an MSO, a recognized digital identification system is a digital identification system recognized as a reliable and independent source by the relevant regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 就金錢服務經營者而言，認可數碼識別系統指獲有關監管機構認可的、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統。

source_quotes.text: full name;

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 证件适用身份/所在地见附录行；住址如另因集团等规定须核实的沟通细节不是此行核心。

topics.topic: 法人识别字段与存在/约束权力核实
covered_aspects: 成立日期地点/主要营业地、公司注册证不证现存、合伙文书及组织合法目的
missing_aspects: 法人的完整最低资料：全名、独特识辨号码与文件种类、注册办事处地址；一般核实须覆盖现有存在及规管约束法人的权力，尚欠完整辨识

evidence.covers: 部分最低字段及非必要公司秘书

snapshot.en: Date of incorporation, establishment or registration
snapshot.tc: 註冊、成立或登記的日期

snapshot.en: Place of incorporation, establishment or registration
snapshot.tc: 註冊、成立或登記的地點

snapshot.en: Company Secretary
snapshot.tc: 公司秘書

snapshot.en: Principal place of business
snapshot.tc: 主要營業地點

snapshot.en: The identity of a customer that is a partnership can be verified by reference to a record of registration, or to a partnership agreement or deed.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可參考合夥的註冊記錄，或其合夥協議或契約，以核實屬合夥的客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: Where the customer or the circumstances are not deemed to present a high ML/TF risk, an extract or redacted version of the partnership agreement or deed may be accepted.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶或情況並非被視為會造成高度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，可接納合夥協議或契約的摘錄或刪節本。

snapshot.en: Even where a record of registration is obtained, an additional document may be required to understand the powers that regulate and bind the partnership.
snapshot.tc: 即使已取得合夥的註冊記錄，金錢服務經營者可能仍需額外文件，才能了解規管和約束合夥的權力。

snapshot.en: Confirming a partnership's membership of a relevant professional or trade association is likely to suffice to verify its identity if it is a well-known, reputable organisation with a long industry history.
snapshot.tc: 如合夥為眾所周知、有信譽及在業內歷史悠久的組織，確認其具有相關專業或行業協會會員身分便可能足以核實其身分。

snapshot.en: For an association, club, society, charity or religious body, the MSO should satisfy itself as to the legitimate purpose of the organisation, for example by requesting sight of its constitution.
snapshot.tc: 就協會、會所、社團、慈善組織或宗教組織而言，金錢服務經營者應令其信納該等機構的合法目的，例如要求閱覽組織章程。

evidence.covers: 注册证、住址与注册地查册

snapshot.en: A certificate of incorporation can, in most circumstances, verify only a legal person's name and legal form; it cannot serve as proof that the legal person currently exists.
snapshot.tc: 公司註冊證明書在大部分情況下僅能核實法人的名稱及法定形式，但不能作為該法人現時仍然存在的證明。

snapshot.en: A document from a reliable and independent source that includes the registered office address, such as a certificate of incumbency, may be accepted as evidence of it unless the MSO knows it is out of date.
snapshot.tc: 載有註冊辦事處地址的可靠及獨立來源文件（例如職權證明書）可作該地址的證據，除非金錢服務經營者知悉地址不能反映現況。

snapshot.en: An MSO may identify and verify a corporate customer by a company registry search in the place where the customer mainly operates, obtaining a full company search report there.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可於公司客戶主要營運所在地的公司註冊處查冊並取得完整的公司查冊報告，以識別及核實其身分。

source_quotes.text: unique identification number (e.g. incorporation number or business registration number) and document type;

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 完整字段与核实目标各列一个可判断命题，并与自然人资料区分；可与 PPTA 法人字段共用新题。

topics.topic: 信托作为客户、最低资料及核实文件
covered_aspects: 受托人可同为客户、集团信托公司确认有条件、特殊情况可留遮盖信托契据
missing_aspects: 信托最低资料：名称、设立/财产授予日期、管辖法律、若有的识别号码/文件及注册办事处；可靠登记册/专业受托人/审阅契据律师的书面确认等核实依据

evidence.covers: 受托人、集团确认条件、遮盖契据

snapshot.en: If the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust, the MSO should also regard the trustee as its customer, and identify and verify the trustee's identity.
snapshot.tc: 如受託人代表信託建立業務關係或執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者應把受託人視作客戶，並識別和核實其身分。

snapshot.en: A written confirmation from a trust company within the same financial group as the MSO is among the examples of documents for verifying the trust's identity.
snapshot.tc: 由與金錢服務經營者同屬一個金融集團的信託公司所簽發的書面確認書，是可用以核實信託身分的文件例子之一。

snapshot.en: In verifying the trust's identity, the MSO may, under exceptional circumstance, choose to retain a redacted copy of the trust deed or similar instrument.
snapshot.tc: 在核實屬信託的客戶的身分時，如情況特殊，金錢服務經營者可選擇保存信託契據或類似文書的刪節本。

source_quotes.text: the jurisdiction whose laws govern the trust or legal arrangement;

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 补信托识别字段及可接受核实来源；不靠引用长信托条文算覆盖。
topics.notes: 关于规管约束信托的权力依 E24，不将繁中误称法人当作命题。

topics.topic: 文件可靠性、原件、有效性及外文
covered_aspects: 不用核实每个收集字段、风险相称反伪造、无法提供原件时保障、外文可靠翻译
missing_aspects: 资料/文件在取得时须为现行有效；面对面一般由员工看原件并留副本（现题主要考无法提供原件的例外）

evidence.covers: 可靠性和外文/电子文件例外

snapshot.en: In verifying a customer's identity, an MSO need not establish the accuracy of every piece of identification information it has collected under the Guideline to identify the customer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者核實客戶的身分時，無需確立其按指引規定為識別客戶而收集到的各項身分識別資料均屬準確。

snapshot.en: There is no requirement that a foreign-language document be translated by a professional third party; the MSO may obtain a translation from a reliable source, such as commonly used translation tools.
snapshot.tc: 現時並無規定以外語書寫的文件須由專業第三方翻譯；金錢服務經營者可透過可靠來源（包括常用的翻譯工具）取得譯本。

snapshot.en: Where the MSO itself downloads a document from a reliable source, such as the Hong Kong Companies Registry's website, instead of receiving a print copy, no corroboration is required.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者自行從可靠的來源（例如香港公司註冊處的網頁）下載文件，而非收取其印刷本，便無須進行核對。

snapshot.en: If a customer cannot produce an original identification document, for example because it is in electronic form, the MSO should take appropriate measures to ensure the reliability of the documents obtained.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶無法出示識別文件的正本（例如正本為電子版本），金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施確保取得的識別文件屬可靠。

snapshot.en: Since some document types are easier to forge than others or can be reported lost or stolen, an MSO should consider applying anti-fraud procedures commensurate with the risk profile of the person verified.
snapshot.tc: 由於若干文件較易偽造或已被報稱遺失或被竊，金錢服務經營者應考慮採取與正接受身分核實的人的風險狀況相稱的防止詐騙程序。

source_quotes.text: is current at the time they are provided to or obtained by the MSO.

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 比较取得时有效与已核实文件日后届满无需自动再核实；补员工看原件并留副本基线。

topics.topic: 关连人士：识别姓名与另有身份时的义务
covered_aspects: 只收集关连人士姓名不自动核实、公司董事与其他实体高层的范围
missing_aspects: 合伙的合伙人、信托受托人属于关连人士；若同时是客户/实益拥有人/PPTA 须按该身份识别核实

evidence.covers: 公司及其他实体范围、只识别不自动核实

snapshot.en: For a customer that is a legal person, the MSO should identify all of the customer's connected parties by obtaining their names and by verifying their identities.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法人的客戶而言，金錢服務經營者應為識別該客戶的所有有關連者，收集其姓名並核實他們的身分。

snapshot.en: For a customer that is a corporation, the connected parties that the MSO should identify by obtaining their names are the customer's directors and its shareholders.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的客戶而言，金錢服務經營者應收集其姓名以作識別的有關連者，是該客戶的董事及股東。

snapshot.en: For a legal person customer that is neither a corporation nor a partnership, a connected party means a natural person holding a senior management position or executive authority in it.
snapshot.tc: 就既非法團亦非合夥的法人客戶而言，有關連者指任何為該客戶擔任高級管理職位或掌握執行權力的自然人。

source_quotes.text: if a connected party also satisfies the definition of a customer, a beneficial owner of the customer or a person purporting to act on behalf of the customer

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 可与信托/PPTA 一题合写，考同一人不同角色导致核实标准改变。

topics.topic: 实益拥有人识别核实、法人与信托阈值
covered_aspects: 超过 25%、最终控制、找不到自然人时高级管理人员、风险相称核实、信托各角色和类别受益人、复杂结构合理原因
missing_aspects: 法团、合伙或其他人代表另一人行事时，另一人可成为 BO；不能绝对声称 BO 只能为自然人。
非法团组织的最终拥有／控制及适用的 BO 范围。

snapshot.en: An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of a corporation's issued share capital is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地擁有或控制（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）法團已發行股本的25%以上的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 10% of the voting rights at a corporation's general meetings is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地有權行使在法團的成員大會上的投票權的10%以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is entitled to or controls, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of a partnership is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地有權攤分或控制合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人，是合夥的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: Where nothing obtained in the CDD process suggests that a person exercising ultimate control over the customer exists, there is no requirement to actively identify such a person.
snapshot.tc: 如在客戶盡職審查過程中所得資料並沒有顯示有人能對客戶行使最終控制權，則無要求積極地識別該人。

snapshot.en: Where no natural person meets the beneficial owner definition, the MSO should instead identify, and take reasonable measures to verify, the natural persons holding senior managing official positions.
snapshot.tc: 如沒有自然人符合實益擁有人的定義，金錢服務經營者便應改為識別擔任高級管理人員的自然人，並採取合理措施核實其身分。

evidence.covers: 核实方式和公开登记册

snapshot.en: When identifying a beneficial owner, an MSO should endeavour to obtain, as far as possible, the same identification information as it obtains for a customer that is a natural person.
snapshot.tc: 當識別實益擁有人時，金錢服務經營者應盡量設法索取與屬自然人的客戶所需資料相同的識別身分資料。

snapshot.en: The AMLO's verification requirements differ for a customer and a beneficial owner, and the reasonable measures to verify a beneficial owner should take due account of the ML/TF risks the customer and relationship pose.
snapshot.tc: 客戶與實益擁有人的身分核實規定並不相同；核實實益擁有人身分的合理措施，應顧及客戶及業務關係引致的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: In an exceptionally low ML/TF risk situation, such as a charitable trust, it may be reasonable to confirm a beneficial owner's identity on information provided by the customer.
snapshot.tc: 在洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險極低的情況下（例如慈善信託），根據客戶提供的資料確認實益擁有人的身分，亦可能是合理做法。

snapshot.en: Where a customer's ownership structure involves different types of legal persons or arrangements, the MSO should note who has ultimate ownership or control, or is its controlling mind and management.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶的擁有權結構涉及不同種類的法人或法律安排，金錢服務經營者應留意誰是最終擁有或控制客戶的人，或誰是控制及管理客戶的主腦。

snapshot.en: Where a register of beneficial owners, such as the significant controllers register in Hong Kong, is not made publicly available, the MSO may obtain the record directly from its customer.
snapshot.tc: 如實益擁有人登記冊（例如香港的重要控制人登記冊）並非公開資料，金錢服務經營者可直接向其客戶索取有關紀錄。

snapshot.en: An individual with ultimate control over a trust, as well as the trust's settlor, its trustee and any protector or enforcer of it
snapshot.tc: 對信託擁有最終的控制權的個人，以及該信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人或執行人

snapshot.en: For a trust, a beneficiary or class of beneficiaries entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, in possession or in remainder or reversion
snapshot.tc: 就信託而言，有權享有信託財產的既得權益的受益人或某類別受益人，不論是享有管有權、剩餘權或復歸權

evidence.covers: 信托角色与受益人识别时点

snapshot.en: The MSO should identify the settlor, the trustee, any protector or enforcer, the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control over the trust.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應識別信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人或執行人（如有）、受益人或某類別受益人，及任何行使最終控制權的自然人。

snapshot.en: For a beneficiary designated by characteristics or by class, the MSO should obtain enough information to establish the beneficiary's identity when the business relationship is established.
snapshot.tc: 如信託以特徵或類別方式指定受益人，金錢服務經營者應就受益人索取足夠資料，以便在建立業務關係時確立受益人的身分。

snapshot.en: Obtaining an ownership chart from the customer is the most convenient way of understanding its ownership and control structure, but there is no strict requirement to obtain one.
snapshot.tc: 向客戶索取擁有權架構表雖是了解其擁有權及控制權結構最方便的方法，但金錢服務經營者並無強制規定要索取。

snapshot.en: Although an MSO needs to identify any intermediate layers, it need not, as a matter of routine, verify the details of the intermediate companies in the ownership structure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者雖然需要識別任何中介層，但不必把核實擁有權結構內中介層公司的細節列作例行事項。

snapshot.en: Where a customer has a complex ownership or control structure, the MSO should obtain sufficient information to satisfy itself that there is a legitimate reason behind that structure.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶的擁有權或控制權結構複雜，金錢服務經營者應索取足夠資料，從而使本身信納採用該結構具有合法理由。

source_quotes.text: if the partnership is acting on behalf of another person, means the other person.
如該合夥是代表另一人行事，指該另一人。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 针对客户替另一人行事以及非法团组织各设命题；按照 B14 法定定义，不能预设实益拥有人必为个人。
topics.notes: B14；不要重写同一 25% 门槛题。 交叉复核：BO 的客户代另一人行事分支及其他／非法团人的范围尚未直接测。与 S032 重叠；L047 的无股权实际控制是相关扩展，并非同一规则。 不把 m2-341 的牌照定义当作第 6 单元客户 BO 已测。

topics.topic: 自然人客户通常就是实益拥有人
missing_aspects: 自然人客户通常就是 BO，无须主动搜寻；有不是为自己行事迹象时应适当查询。

source_quotes.text: the MSO should make appropriate enquiries where there are indications that the customer is not acting on his own behalf.
但如有跡象顯示該客戶並非代表其本身行事，則須進行適當查詢。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 给自然人交易场景，比较一般默认与有代人迹象的查询义务。
topics.notes: 交叉复核：m6-342#4 的无须主动搜寻限于题干的法团／合伙控制情况；m1-138#3 只要求格外留心。两者没有测试自然人默认就是 BO 及出现代人迹象的查询规则。 可与 G027 合并成一道边界题，不必为每个来源行另编一题。

topics.topic: 持票人股份和权证的保管与持续核实
covered_aspects: 独立证明保管、未存托股份开户前及每年声明、权证同样适用
missing_aspects: 持续定期复核须取得证据确认保管人；客户须即时通知股份拥有权变动

evidence.covers: 独立保管证据、每年声明、权证

snapshot.en: Where bearer shares are deposited with an authorised or registered custodian, the MSO should seek a confirmation from the customer itself that the custodian holds the shares.
snapshot.tc: 如持票人股份已存放於認可╱註冊保管人，金錢服務經營者應尋求客戶本身發出的確認書，證明保管人持有該等股份。

snapshot.en: For bearer shares held outside an authorised or registered custodian, the MSO should obtain declarations from each beneficial owner before account opening and every two years thereafter.
snapshot.tc: 就存放於認可╱註冊保管人以外的持票人股份，金錢服務經營者應在開立戶口前及其後每兩年向每名實益擁有人索取聲明。

snapshot.en: The controls an MSO applies to bearer shares, to establish the identities of their beneficial owners and learn of any change of owner, should be applied to bearer share warrants too.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者為確立持票人股份的實益擁有人並獲知會其變動而採取的措施，亦適用於不記名認股權證。

source_quotes.text: The MSO should also require the customer to notify it immediately of any changes in the ownership of the shares.

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 补持票人股份变更通知和持续核实，不重复周年频率陷阱。

topics.topic: 代名股东须穿透识别
missing_aspects: 识别代名股东、其代表的人，并了解安排以确定 BO。

source_quotes.text: the identities of the nominees, and the persons on whose behalf they are acting
代名人及代名人所代表行事的人士的身分的證據

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 通过代名股东结构判断应识别谁及取得什么资料；区别持票人股份。
topics.notes: 交叉复核：全库题句无 nominee／代名股东命题；现有持票人股份与穿透中间层题不测代名安排的两方身份及安排详情。 与 BO 主线共同安排；不把代名和持票股份混为一项。

topics.topic: PPTA 的界定、资料及授权核实
covered_aspects: 按角色活动风险界定、不是所有签署人皆 PPTA、书面授权证据、低风险可用独立部门确认名单
missing_aspects: PPTA 属自然人或法人时对应取得哪些最低身份资料，按相应客户识别核实要求处理。

evidence.covers: PPTA 范围和低风险名单例外

snapshot.en: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
snapshot.tc: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Although FATF Recommendation 10 and the AMLO require any PPTA to be identified and verified, neither the FATF Recommendations nor the AMLO defines the scope of a PPTA.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織第10項建議及《打擊洗錢條例》雖要求識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，但兩者均沒有界定其涵蓋範圍。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk, the MSO could verify the PPTAs' identities by reference to a list of PPTAs confirmed by an independent department of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 如業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險被評為屬於高，金錢服務經營者可根據經客戶內部獨立部門核實的清單，核實看似代表客戶行事的人的身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO is not required to identify and verify every authorized signatory of a customer: signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are PPTAs.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者無須識別及核實客戶的所有獲授權簽署人；僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。

snapshot.en: As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

evidence.covers: 书面授权与不必为董事/BO

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

snapshot.en: The Guideline does not mandate that the natural person be a director or a beneficial owner of the customer, so long as that person has been properly authorised to act on the customer's behalf.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》並沒有強制規定該自然人須為客戶的董事或實益擁有人，只要該自然人已妥善地獲授權代表客戶行事。

source_quotes.text: in line with the identification and verification requirements for a customer that is a natural person or a legal person
應遵守識別及核實屬自然人或法人客戶的規定（如適用）。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 以自然人和法人 PPTA 对比所需资料，测试核实身分与核实授权是两项不同工作；与 13 附录(3)合并补题。
topics.notes: 依 B29 保留低风险名单例外；m6-341 是客户资料，不能自动当 PPTA 字段已测。 交叉复核：PPTA 必须识别核实身份、另核授权已分别测过。缺的是自然人／法人 PPTA 对应的最低资料及适用客户标准，而不是基础双重义务全部缺失。 G031 + L049 + C008 合为一个编题任务；按 B29 保留低风险名单例外。

topics.topic: 业务关系目的及预期性质
covered_aspects: 目的可能自明，否则取资料；资料程度按风险与关系；非自然人另了解业务性质

evidence.covers: 目的、风险相称、法人业务及误导处理

snapshot.en: The MSO must understand the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship; in some instances this is self-evident, but in many cases it may have to obtain information.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者必須了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質；這在某些情況下不言而喻，但在許多情況下或須取得這方面的資料。

snapshot.en: The information the MSO obtains to understand the purpose and intended nature should be commensurate with the customer's risk profile and the nature of the business relationship.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者為了解目的及擬具有的性質而取得的資料，應與客戶的風險狀況及業務關係的性質相稱。

snapshot.en: Where the customer is a natural person, the MSO should also understand the nature of the customer's business, in addition to the purpose and intended nature of the relationship.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶屬自然人，金錢服務經營者除了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質外，亦應了解客戶的業務性質。

snapshot.en: As an SDD measure, the MSO may infer the purpose and intended nature from the type of transactions or business relationship established, without collecting specific information.
snapshot.tc: 作為簡化盡職審查措施，金錢服務經營者可不收集特定資料，僅按交易的類別或建立的業務關係推斷目的及擬具有的性質。

snapshot.en: Where the MSO ascertains that a customer has misled it about the purpose and intended nature, it should take prompt action to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如確定客戶就業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質誤導了它，應迅速採取行動，以識別是否有理由作出懷疑。

source_quotes.text: understand the nature of the customer’s business.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 延后身份核实的条件、限制和失败处理
covered_aspects: 仅业务关系可例外延期、有效控险不阻正常业务、尽快完成、交易限额和期限、定期通知高层、失败终止及考虑 STR
missing_aspects: 未完成核实时原则不得向第三方支付；例外还需无怀疑、批准时考虑客户业务性质、受款人不匹配恐怖嫌疑及 PEP 观察名单。
核实失败终止关系时，尽量按原形退回资金／资产的处理。

snapshot.en: An MSO that verifies identity after establishing a business relationship must complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable afterwards.
snapshot.tc: 在建立業務關係之後才核實身分的金錢服務經營者，須在該關係建立之後，在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快完成核實。

snapshot.en: An MSO may verify identity after an occasional transaction of $120,000 or more if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
snapshot.tc: 如為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理，便可在$120,000或以上的非經常交易之後才核實客戶身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO that cannot carry out the required CDD measures for a customer must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with that customer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如不能夠就某客戶執行所需的客戶盡職審查措施，不可與該客戶建立業務關係，亦不可與該客戶執行任何非經常交易。

snapshot.en: An MSO with an existing business relationship that is unable to complete deferred verification must consider restricting or terminating that relationship.
snapshot.tc: 已與客戶建立業務關係的金錢服務經營者，如未能完成延後進行的身分核實，須考慮限制或結束與該客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: Verification may be put off until after a business relationship is established only if needed to avoid interrupting normal business and any money laundering or terrorist financing risk is effectively managed.
snapshot.tc: 只有在為免干擾正常業務而必需，且洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險已獲有效管理時，才可延至建立業務關係之後核實身分。

snapshot.en: A reasonable timeframe for completing the identity verification measures, and the follow-up actions if it is exceeded, such as suspending or terminating the relationship, should form part of its policies.
snapshot.tc: 完成身分核實措施的合理時限，以及逾期而未能完成時的跟進行動（例如暫停或終止業務關係），應納入其政策及程序之中。

snapshot.en: Until verification is completed, the number, types and/or amount of transactions that the customer can perform through the relationship should be subject to appropriate limits.
snapshot.tc: 在完成身分核實之前，客戶可透過有關業務關係進行的交易次數、類別及／或金額，應受到適當的限制。

snapshot.en: As one of the risk management procedures it adopts, cases in which verification is still pending completion should be reported to the CCE periodically, keeping it informed.
snapshot.tc: 作為所採取的風險管理程序之一，尚待完成身分核實的個案應定期向關長報告，讓關長知悉有關情況。

snapshot.en: Exceptions allowing payments to a third party are subject to conditions that include the risk being assessed as low and the transaction being approved by senior management.
snapshot.tc: 支付資金予第三者的例外安排須符合多項條件，其中包括有關風險評定屬於低度，以及交易經高級管理層批准。

snapshot.en: If verification is not completed within the timeframe, the MSO should consider an STR, particularly if the customer asks without a justifiable reason for funds to go to a third party or be transformed.
snapshot.tc: 如未能在時限內完成核實，金錢服務經營者應考慮提交可疑交易報告，尤其是客戶在無充分理由下要求將資金轉移給第三者或「轉變」資金。

source_quotes.text: ensuring that funds are not paid out to any third party.
確保不支付資金予任何第三者。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 补第三方付款例外的完整必要条件和终止时资金处理；m6-363 第 4 句仅列其中两项。
topics.notes: 核实时点依 B16；¶4.7.2 证券/寿险例子只作背景。 交叉复核：m6-363#4 已考低风险和高层批准（题句明确只是条件包括这两项），不能再称完整第三方付款例外全部未测。剩下必要条件及原形退回未测。 不要把非穷尽监察举例逐项当成 P1；该项聚焦支付闸门和资金退回。

topics.topic: SDD 的风险基础、可用措施及停止条件
covered_aspects: 低风险可而非必须简化、充分分析、风险变化停止、怀疑时不准、持续监察仍须做、减少更新和监控/推断目的
missing_aspects: 资料真实性或充分性有疑问时不得开始或继续 SDD。

evidence.covers: 风险基础与部分低风险因素

snapshot.en: Because the extent of CDD measures should be commensurate with the ML/TF risks of a business relationship, an MSO must apply SDD measures in a low risk situation.
snapshot.tc: 盡職審查措施的程度應與洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱，因此在低風險的情況下，金錢服務經營者必須採取簡化盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: An MSO's assessment that a business relationship or transaction presents low risks should be supported by an adequate analysis of the ML/TF risks by the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如將業務關係或交易的風險評為低，應輔以其對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的適當分析。

snapshot.en: Once a change in its risk assessment means that the MSO no longer considers there to be a low degree of ML/TF risk, it should not continue to apply SDD measures.
snapshot.tc: 風險評估改變後，如金錢服務經營者判斷洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險已不屬於低，便應停止執行簡化盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: A financial institution incorporated or established in an equivalent jurisdiction is among the examples the Guideline gives of potentially lower risk customer factors.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區成立或設立為法團的金融機構，屬指引所列潛在較低風險的客戶風險因素例子之一。

snapshot.en: Countries or jurisdictions that credible sources identify as having a lower level of corruption or other criminal activity are an example of a potentially lower country risk factor.
snapshot.tc: 可靠消息來源識別為貪污或其他犯罪活動較少的國家或司法管轄區，屬指引所列潛在較低風險的國家風險因素例子之一。

snapshot.en: For a customer in a potentially lower risk customer category, accepting other documents, such as proof of an FI's licence or listed status, is an example of a possible SDD measure.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶屬潛在較低風險的客戶類別，接納其他文件（例如金融機構牌照或上市地位的證明）是可能執行的簡化盡職審查措施的例子。

evidence.covers: 持续监察和可减少强度

snapshot.en: When an MSO applies SDD measures, it is still required to continuously monitor its business relationship in accordance with Schedule 2, through ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者即使執行簡化盡職審查措施，仍須按照附表2持續監察其業務關係，即持續進行盡職審查及監察交易。

snapshot.en: Examples of possible SDD measures include reducing the frequency of updates of customer identification information, and reducing the degree of ongoing monitoring based on a reasonable monetary threshold.
snapshot.tc: 可能執行的簡化盡職審查措施的例子，包括下調更新客戶識別資料的頻密程度，以及下調持續監察和審查合理的金額門檻下的交易的程度。

snapshot.en: An MSO may carry out simplified CDD for a listed customer even when it suspects the customer of involvement in money laundering or terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 即使金錢服務經營者懷疑某名所列客戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集，仍可就該客戶執行簡化客戶盡職審查。

evidence.covers: 资料真实性/充分性存疑触发CDD已测；与停止SDD的连接尚待补

snapshot.en: CDD measures are required when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained to identify or verify the customer.
snapshot.tc: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑過往為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分時，須執行客戶盡職審查措施。

source_quotes.text: where there are doubts about the veracity or accuracy of documents or information previously obtained
對過往為識別或核實身分而取得的資料是否真實或充分存疑。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 把低风险客户出现资料疑点的场景写入停止 SDD 条件题，依 E23 使用真实性或充分性。
topics.notes: E23 已裁定按法例和繁中真实性/充分性共同规则。低风险例子为非穷尽，本行不要求再把所有退休/保险例子复制。 交叉复核：资料真实性／充分性存疑须执行 CDD 已由 m3-262#5 直接测试；SDD 的风险上升和怀疑停止条件也已有。尚缺的是将该已知触发点明确用于停止 SDD 的连接，适合扩充现题。 依 E23；不删除缺口，但不应与全未测核心条件同列 P1。

topics.topic: 豁免实益拥有人核实的客户、产品及所有权链
covered_aspects: 合资格金融机构/上市公司/政府/投资工具、所有权链余下 BO、退休金及保费门槛
missing_aspects: P1：上市公司使用 BO 简化审查时，评估适用披露要求是否确保 BO 充分透明度。
P2 顺带扩展：雇员另与 MSO 建关系时自身 CDD；单次保费不超过 20,000 的另一产品条件。

snapshot.en: The customer is a corporation listed on any stock exchange, whether the exchange is in Hong Kong or elsewhere.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是在任何證券市場上市的法團，不論該證券市場位於香港或其他地方。

snapshot.en: The customer is another licensed money service operator, which the AMLO counts as a financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是另一持牌金錢服務經營者，即《打擊洗錢條例》所指的金融機構。

snapshot.en: The customer is the government of any jurisdiction outside Hong Kong, whether an equivalent jurisdiction or otherwise.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是香港以外任何司法管轄區的政府，包括對等司法管轄區以外的司法管轄區。

snapshot.en: The product is a pension scheme insurance policy that contains no surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral.
snapshot.tc: 產品是為退休金計劃的目的而購買、不載有退回條款及不可用作抵押品的保險單。

snapshot.en: The product is a life insurance policy for which an annual premium of up to $20,000 is payable.
snapshot.tc: 產品是須繳付的每年保費在$20,000或以下的人壽保險單。

snapshot.en: The customer is a body in an equivalent jurisdiction that performs functions similar to those of a public body.
snapshot.tc: 客戶是在對等司法管轄區執行與公共機構的職能相類似的職能的機構。

evidence.covers: 投资工具政府退休产品

snapshot.en: An investment vehicle is such a customer where a financial institution is the person responsible for carrying out measures similar to CDD measures in relation to all of its investors.
snapshot.tc: 如負責就某投資公司的所有投資者執行與客戶盡職審查措施相類似的措施的人屬金融機構，該投資公司即屬可執行簡化客戶盡職審查的此類客戶。

snapshot.en: The Government is such a customer, and any public body in Hong Kong is one as well, so a customer does not have to be a financial institution in order to qualify.
snapshot.tc: 政府屬此類客戶，任何香港的公共機構亦屬此類客戶，因此客戶即使並非金融機構，亦可屬可執行簡化客戶盡職審查的客戶。

snapshot.en: A scheme providing employees with retirement benefits, however it is described and funded by deductions from employment income, is such a product where its rules allow a member to assign his or her interest under it.
snapshot.tc: 向僱員提供退休福利的計劃（不論實際如何稱述），如供款是從受僱工作獲得的入息中扣減，且計劃規則准許成員轉讓其在計劃下的利益，即屬此類產品。

snapshot.en: Simplified CDD can rest on the product as well as the customer: in the same circumstances as for a listed customer, it may be carried out on reasonable grounds to believe the product related to the transaction is of a listed kind.
snapshot.tc: 簡化客戶盡職審查除可基於客戶外，亦可基於產品：在與所列客戶相同的情況中，如金錢服務經營者有合理理由相信與交易有關的產品屬所列的產品，便可執行該等審查。

snapshot.en: An institution set up in an equivalent jurisdiction and doing business similar to a financial institution's is such a customer if it also has measures to comply with requirements like Schedule 2's and is supervised for compliance there.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區成立為法團或設立、經營與金融機構相類似業務的機構，如亦設有措施確保類似附表2的規定獲遵從，並就其遵從情況受到當地主管當局監管，即屬此類客戶。

snapshot.en: Where a corporation listed on any stock exchange is in a customer's ownership chain, the MSO should still identify, and take reasonable measures to verify, beneficial owners in the chain not connected with it.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶的擁有權鏈狀架構中有在任何證券市場上市的法團，金錢服務經營者仍須識別與該法團無關連的實益擁有人，並採取合理措施核實其身分。

snapshot.en: For a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme that qualifies, the MSO may generally treat the employer as the customer and choose not to identify or verify the employees.
snapshot.tc: 就符合資格的公積金計劃、退休金計劃、退休計劃或離職金計劃而言，金錢服務經營者一般可視僱主為客戶，並選擇不去識別或核實僱員。

source_quotes.text: the MSO should assess whether the customer is subject to any disclosure requirements
這類規定確保客戶的實益擁有權具充分透明度。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 优先补 B31 上市公司透明度条件，再合并退休和保险边界；不要从任何上市公司都可豁免推成不用评估。
topics.notes: B31；其他法定客户类别已有单元 3 实测。 交叉复核：法例题已覆盖上市公司资格及多数客户／产品；但题干明确以 AMLO 为准，未测试指引额外要求评估披露是否保障 BO 透明度（B31）。其他两点仍是未测细节，但不应与此核心条件一律列为独立 P1。 与 S038 已覆盖的法定 SDD 类别是来源边界，不应因同主题而删除本项。可扩充现有 SDD 练习。

topics.topic: 投资工具、代名账户及所委机构的 SDD 条件
covered_aspects: 不合资格时识别超过 25% 投资者；接受身份书面陈述需留档并定期审查
missing_aspects: 代名公司/投资工具账户的金融机构须已做相关 CDD 且有合约授权；委托机构合资格并不能替代确认可靠系统对所有投资者 CDD 的条件

snapshot.en: If neither an investment vehicle nor its appointed institution falls within the categories of institution specified in Schedule 2, the MSO should identify any investor owning or controlling more than a 25% interest in it.
snapshot.tc: 如投資公司或獲委任機構均不屬附表2指明的機構類別，金錢服務經營者應識別任何擁有或控制該投資公司25%以上權益的投資者的身分。

snapshot.en: Where an MSO accepts a written representation on the identities of an investment vehicle's investors owning or controlling more than 25%, it should be documented, retained and periodically reviewed.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者接納就擁有或控制投資公司25%以上權益的投資者身分發出的書面陳述，有關情況須記錄、保存及定期覆核。

evidence.covers: 投资工具合资格负责机构

snapshot.en: An investment vehicle is such a customer where a financial institution is the person responsible for carrying out measures similar to CDD measures in relation to all of its investors.
snapshot.tc: 如負責就某投資公司的所有投資者執行與客戶盡職審查措施相類似的措施的人屬金融機構，該投資公司即屬可執行簡化客戶盡職審查的此類客戶。

source_quotes.text: is authorised to operate the account as evidenced by contractual document or agreement.

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 用一题比较 FI 代名账户/投资工具/受托 CDD 的条件，测试谁已做 CDD 及谁有权操作。

topics.topic: 律师客户账户的混合资金条件与单一客户例外
covered_aspects: 账户须以律师名义；单一客户账户须识别该客户
missing_aspects: 混合客户金钱或证券且律师作为代理管理的完整条件；各独立子账户未混合也须识别底层客户

snapshot.en: One of the criteria allowing an MSO to apply SDD to the beneficial owners of a solicitor's client account is that the account is kept in the names of the solicitor's clients.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可就律師的當事人戶口執行有關實益擁有人的簡化客戶盡職審查的準則之一，是該戶口以律師的當事人的名義開設。

snapshot.en: If a solicitor's client account is opened on behalf of a single client, the MSO should establish the identity of that underlying client in addition to that of the solicitor opening it.
snapshot.tc: 如律師的當事人戶口是代表單一客戶開設，金錢服務經營者除了核實開設戶口的律師的身分外，亦應識別相關當事人的身分。

source_quotes.text: there are sub-accounts for each individual client where funds are not co-mingled at the MSO

topics.priority_reason: 核心框架已有题，但缺少有用的适用条件或执行细节。
topics.question_brief: 用混合资金与独立子账户两个场景测试 SDD 边界；并入 SDD 综合补题可减少题数。
topics.notes: 依 E22 取金钱或证券，不制造中英文 and/or 陷阱。

topics.topic: 一般高风险情形、EDD 比例及残余风险
covered_aspects: 高风险/关长书面指定触发、批准关系、EDD 相称/不必所有例子、强化监察及补充信息
missing_aspects: EDD 未能充分减低已识别风险时仍应采取其他措施减低剩余风险；交易限额或功能限制是可用例子，不是所有情况必须同时采用。

snapshot.en: The requirements apply in a situation the Commissioner specifies in a written notice to the MSO, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於關長藉給予金錢服務經營者的書面通知所指明的情況，及任何其他以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship is to be established with the customer concerned, the MSO must obtain approval from its senior management to establish it.
snapshot.tc: 如將要與有關客戶建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須取得其高級管理層的批准，以建立該業務關係。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship is to be established, the MSO must either take reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and funds, or take additional measures to mitigate the risk.
snapshot.tc: 如將要建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship has been established and there is a beneficial owner, the MSO must take reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity.
snapshot.tc: 如已建立業務關係，而就有關客戶而言有某實益擁有人，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施，以核實該實益擁有人的身分。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the MSO must take additional measures to mitigate the risk; senior management approval is not required.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者須採取額外措施以減低所涉風險，而無須取得高級管理層的批准。

evidence.covers: 相称程度、信息和增强监察

snapshot.en: EDD measures should be applied to an extent that is proportionate, appropriate and discriminating, and that the MSO is able to justify to the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 更嚴格的盡職審查措施的執行程度應合乎比例、適當及因情況而異，金錢服務經營者並應能夠就此向關長提供理據。

snapshot.en: Obtaining information on the reasons for intended or performed transactions, and additional information on the intended nature of the business relationship, are examples of possible EDD measures.
snapshot.tc: 就擬進行或已進行交易的理由索取額外資料，以及就業務關係擬具有的性質索取額外資料，均屬可能執行的更嚴格的盡職審查措施的例子。

snapshot.en: Ways of enhancing the ongoing monitoring of such a relationship include, for example, raising the number and timing of the controls applied and selecting transaction patterns needing further examination.
snapshot.tc: 對這類業務關係執行更嚴格的持續監察的方法，例如包括增加執行管控措施的次數及時間，以及篩選需要進一步查驗的交易模式。

snapshot.en: Possible EDD measures include obtaining additional information on the customer, such as occupation or volume of assets, and updating more regularly the identification data of the customer and its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 可能執行的更嚴格盡職審查措施包括就客戶索取額外資料（例如職業、資產量），以及更頻密地定期更新客戶及實益擁有人的身分證明數據。

snapshot.en: For each business relationship presenting a high risk, an MSO is not expected to carry out every one of the examples of possible EDD measures that the Guideline gives.
snapshot.tc: 就每項可引致高度風險的業務關係而言，金錢服務經營者按期望無需執行指引所列所有可能執行的更嚴格的盡職審查措施的例子。

evidence.covers: 风险特征的部分交叉题句

snapshot.en: Account activity or transaction volume that is not commensurate with the customer's known profile, such as age, occupation or income
snapshot.tc: 客戶的帳戶活動或交易量，與已知的客戶狀況（例如年齡、職業、收入）不相稱

snapshot.en: Transactions with jurisdictions or entities reported to be associated with terrorist activities, or with persons designated as terrorists
snapshot.tc: 交易涉及的司法管轄區或實體，據稱與恐怖主義活動或被指認為恐怖分子的人有關連

source_quotes.text: Where the applicable EDD measures cannot fully mitigate the ML/TF risks identified, the MSO should take other measures to mitigate the residual risks
採取其他措施減低剩餘風險

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 先补 EDD 后残余风险仍须控制；其他风险例子可用于同题场景，不再以题数平均分配。
topics.notes: 一般高风险与 PEP 的来源要求按 B17，不偷换为所有情况必须一刀切。 交叉复核：残余风险义务未测，但“未测全所有高风险例子”不是充分缺口理由。m6-366 已直接测相称、举例非全数适用和多种 EDD；新增应聚焦 EDD 不足后的行动。 删除未测全非穷尽例子这一笼统缺口；例子可用作场景，但无须逐项补题。

topics.topic: 非香港、香港与国际组织 PEP 的身份范围
covered_aspects: 重要公职与非中初级、家庭关系/密切业务关系、过去公职、国际组织定义、客户及 BO 均须识别

snapshot.en: An individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong as a senior executive of a state-owned corporation
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的國有企業高級行政人員

snapshot.en: An individual entrusted with a prominent public function in Hong Kong as a senior government or judicial official
snapshot.tc: 在香港擔任重要公職的高級政府或司法官員

snapshot.en: The spouse of a child of an individual entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人的子女的配偶

snapshot.en: A brother or sister of an individual entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人的兄弟姊妹

snapshot.en: An individual who has been, but is no longer, entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 曾在香港以外地方擔任重要公職、但目前已沒有擔任的個人

snapshot.en: An individual entrusted with a public function outside Hong Kong as a middle-ranking official of a government department
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方擔任政府部門中級官員的個人

evidence.covers: 伴侣/关系密切人士和前 PEP

snapshot.en: For the definition of politically exposed person, a person is an individual's partner if the law of the place where the two of them live together considers the person equivalent to the individual's spouse.
snapshot.tc: 就政治人物的定義而言，如根據某人與某名個人共同生活的地方的法律，該人被視為等同於該名個人的配偶，該人即屬該名個人的伴侶。

snapshot.en: An individual who has close social ties with an individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong, such as a close friend, is a close associate of that individual.
snapshot.tc: 與在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人有密切社交關係的個人（例如其密友），即屬與該名在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人關係密切的人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the benefit of an individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong is a close associate of that individual.
snapshot.tc: 屬某法人或信託的實益擁有人的個人，如該法人或信託是為在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人的利益而成立的，即屬與該名個人關係密切的人。

snapshot.en: A parent of an individual who, being a politically exposed person, has been but is not currently entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong is a former politically exposed person.
snapshot.tc: 身為政治人物、曾在香港以外地方擔任重要公職但目前沒有如此擔任重要公職的個人，其父母屬《打擊洗錢條例》所指的前政治人物。

snapshot.en: An individual who is a beneficial owner of a legal person or trust of which an individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong is also a beneficial owner is a close associate of the latter.
snapshot.tc: 如在香港以外地方擔任重要公職的個人屬某法人或信託的實益擁有人，同樣屬該法人或信託的實益擁有人的個人，即屬與該名個人關係密切的人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent function by an international organisation, such as a deputy director or a member of its board, is an international organisation PEP.
snapshot.tc: 在國際組織擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人，包括該組織的副總監或理事會成員等高級管理層成員，屬國際組織政治人物。

snapshot.en: Under the Guideline's definition, international organisations are recognised by law in their member countries and are not treated as resident institutional units of the countries where they are located.
snapshot.tc: 根據指引的界定，國際組織的地位獲成員國的法律認可，而且國際組織不會被視作其所處國家的常駐機構單位。

snapshot.en: If a customer holds a prominent function at an organisation that resembles but does not meet the definition of an international organisation, the MSO should consider whether this impacts the customer's risk profile.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶在與國際組織相似但不符合其定義的組織擔任重要公職，金錢服務經營者應考慮會否影響該客戶的風險狀況。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the International Maritime Organization, the Council of Europe, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and the World Trade Organization.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括國際海事組織、歐洲理事會、北大西洋公約組織及世界貿易組織。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, an economic organisation, and the International Olympic Committee.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括東南亞國家協會及國際奧林匹克委員會等國際組織。

evidence.covers: 识别香港及国际组织 PEP

snapshot.en: An MSO should take reasonable measures to determine whether a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer is a Hong Kong PEP or an international organisation PEP.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取合理措施，以斷定某客戶或某客戶的實益擁有人是否屬香港政治人物或國際組織政治人物。

source_quotes.text: but does not include a middle-ranking or more junior official

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 不是每个公职示例都各写一题；身份核心区分已实际测试。

topics.topic: PEP 的 EDD 触发与资金/财富来源
covered_aspects: 非香港 PEP 高层批准/来源、香港 PEP 须高风险、商业库不能替代 CDD、来源概念和不必所有客户都建立财富来源
missing_aspects: 继续既有香港／国际组织 PEP 关系而后来成为高风险，或既有高风险关系后来获知客户／BO 是该类 PEP 时，应应用 ¶4.9.10 措施。

evidence.covers: 非香港 PEP 关系条件

snapshot.en: Before establishing a business relationship with the customer, the MSO must obtain approval from its money laundering reporting officer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在與該客戶建立業務關係之前，須取得其洗錢報告主任的批准。

snapshot.en: Before establishing a business relationship, the MSO must take reasonable measures to establish the customer's source of wealth and of the funds involved.
snapshot.tc: 建立業務關係前，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施確立該客戶的財富及所涉資金的來源。

snapshot.en: Where an existing customer has become a politically exposed person, the MSO must terminate its business relationship with that customer.
snapshot.tc: 如現有客戶已成為政治人物，金錢服務經營者須結束與該客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: The same requirements apply where it is a beneficial owner of the customer, and not the customer itself, who is the politically exposed person.
snapshot.tc: 如屬政治人物的並非客戶本身，而是客戶的實益擁有人，同樣的規定亦適用。

evidence.covers: 香港 PEP 门槛及来源概念
