topics.topic: 中介人保存的记录、即时资料及终止移交
covered_aspects: 最终责任及全部标准、应要求尽快给副本、数据即时取得、结束中介服务须交所有文件

snapshot.en: Where the intermediary holds the customer identification and verification documents, the MSO remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements.
snapshot.tc: 如中介人持有客戶的識別及核實文件，金錢服務經營者仍有責任遵守所有備存紀錄的規定。

snapshot.en: The MSO should make sure the intermediary it relies on has systems to comply with every record-keeping requirement of the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人已設立系統，以遵從打擊洗錢條例及指引下所有備存紀錄的規定。

snapshot.en: The MSO should make sure the intermediary will provide documents and records as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the MSO's request.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人會在收到其要求後，盡快在合理地切實可行的範圍內提供文件及紀錄。

snapshot.en: The MSO should immediately obtain the data or information that the intermediary has obtained in the course of carrying out the CDD measure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應立刻取得中介人在執行盡職審查措施時取得的數據或資料。

snapshot.en: The MSO should ensure that the intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO upon termination of the intermediary's services.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人在終止提供服務後，會將文件及紀錄交回金錢服務經營者。

source_quotes.text: upon termination of the services provided by the intermediary.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 培训责任、频率与不同岗位内容
covered_aspects: 机构责任、初入职尽快/定期复训、按风险及岗位经验、法定后果与新趋势、前台后台管理层MLRO分工

snapshot.en: It is the MSO's responsibility to provide adequate training for its staff to implement its AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者有責任提供充分培訓，使職員足以執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: New staff should be required to attend initial training as soon as possible after being hired or appointed.
snapshot.tc: 新職員獲聘用或委任後，金錢服務經營者應要求他們盡快接受初步培訓。

snapshot.en: Apart from initial training, the MSO should also provide refresher training to its staff at least once a year.
snapshot.tc: 除安排初步培訓外，金錢服務經營者亦應最少每年為職員舉辦一次複修培訓。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of the possible consequences for their failure to report suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應促使職員留意他們因未能舉報可疑交易而可能需要承擔的後果。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of new and emerging ML/TF techniques and trends, to the extent needed for their particular roles.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員在其特定職責所需的範圍內，留意洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的嶄新及新興技巧及趨勢。

snapshot.en: The effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if the staff using the system are not adequately trained.
snapshot.tc: 如沒有為使用系統的職員提供充分培訓，則即使是一個設計精湛的內部監控系統，其成效也會受到影響。

snapshot.en: The scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the staff's job functions, responsibilities and experience.
snapshot.tc: 培訓的範疇及頻密程度應切合金錢服務經營者面對的特定風險，並應顧及有關職員的職能、職責及經驗。

snapshot.en: An MSO should implement a clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that its relevant staff receive adequate training on AML/CFT matters.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應實施清晰及明確的政策，確保在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面為有關職員提供充分培訓。

snapshot.en: Staff should know the possible consequences of failing to comply with the CDD and record-keeping requirements laid down in the DTROP, as well as their own and their MSO's statutory obligations.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員留意未能遵守《販毒（追討得益）條例》所訂的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定的可能後果，以及本身及金錢服務經營者的法定責任。

snapshot.en: All new staff, irrespective of seniority, may be trained on the need to report suspicious transactions to the MLRO and the offence of tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 所有新職員（不論資歷）可接受向洗錢報告主任舉報可疑交易的必要及「通風報訊」罪行的培訓。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained on the importance of their roles as the first point of contact with potential money launderers.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員，可接受有關其作為與潛在洗錢人第一個接觸點的重要性的培訓。

snapshot.en: Back-office staff, depending on their roles, may be trained on appropriate customer verification and relevant processing procedures.
snapshot.tc: 後勤職員可視乎他們的職責，接受有關客戶核實及相關處理程序的適當培訓。

snapshot.en: Managerial staff, including internal audit officers, may be given specific training on auditing the system and performing random checks.
snapshot.tc: 經理級人員（包括內部審計人員）可接受涵蓋系統審查及進行隨機抽查職責的特定培訓。

snapshot.en: MLROs may be given specific training on assessing the suspicious transaction reports submitted to them and reporting to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任可接受涵蓋評估所收到的可疑交易報告及向財富情報組報告的特定培訓。

snapshot.en: The ordinances under which staff should be made aware of statutory and regulatory obligations concerning their MSO and themselves, and of the possible consequences of breaches, include the WMD(CPS)O.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員留意與其本身及金錢服務經營者有關的法定及監管責任以及違反的可能後果，所涉條例包括《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT policies and procedures of the MSO, including those for identifying and reporting suspicious transactions, are among the matters of which staff should be made aware.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序（包括如何識別及舉報可疑交易），屬應促使職員留意的事項。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel, may be trained on the MSO's policies and procedures for the CDD and record-keeping requirements relevant to their job responsibilities.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）可接受培訓，認識金錢服務經營者在客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄方面與其職責相關的政策及程序。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion and in the relevant policies and procedures, such as lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員可就可能出現可疑交易的情況及相關政策及程序接受培訓，例如報告的流程及應何時提高額外警覺。

snapshot.en: The specific training that may be appropriate for managerial staff, including internal audit officers and COs, includes training on supervising or managing staff and on reporting suspicious transactions to the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 或適用於經理級人員（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）的特定培訓，包括涵蓋監督或管理職員及向關長舉報可疑交易的職責的培訓。

source_quotes.text: pitched according to the job functions, responsibilities and experience of the staff.

topics.topic: 培训方式、三年纪录及效果评估
covered_aspects: 多种方式和 FATF 案例、材料现行、谁何时何种培训留至少三年、测试认知、报告质量数量、缺席跟进

snapshot.en: Training records should show who has been trained, when, and the type of training, and be kept for at least 3 years.
snapshot.tc: 培訓紀錄應顯示誰人已接受培訓、何時接受培訓及培訓的類別，並最少保存3年。

snapshot.en: An MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of its training materials.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可考慮使用特別組織的文章及典型案件作為培訓材料。

snapshot.en: The quality and quantity of internal reports may be monitored so that further training needs may be identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可監察內部報告的質和量，藉此找出進一步的培訓需要。

snapshot.en: The MSO should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all training materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應能夠向關長證明所有培訓材料是最新的，並符合現行規定及標準。

snapshot.en: Following up with staff who miss training without reasonable cause is one way of monitoring training effectiveness.
snapshot.tc: 對沒有合理因由而缺席培訓的職員作出跟進，是監察培訓效用的方法之一。

snapshot.en: One way to monitor the effectiveness of training is to test staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 監察培訓效用的方法之一，是測試職員對金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策及程序的理解，以及他們辨認可疑交易的能力。

snapshot.en: The techniques and tools used to deliver training may include on-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos and paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals.
snapshot.tc: 提供培訓的技巧及工具可包括網上學習系統、課堂上的集思培訓、相關影片，以及紙張形式或以內聯網為本的程序手冊。

source_quotes.text: Records should be maintained for a minimum of 3 years.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 多种培训方式 encouraged/应考虑分歧依 E26，不命题必须采用某组合。

topics.topic: 电汇定义、机构角色与适用例外
covered_aspects: 同机构不同分行、电子途径、MSO 为本人汇款时例外、双方自营 FI、cover payment 适用、卡号必须随附
missing_aspects: 卡交易要获电汇规则豁免，卡不得作为支付系统执行人与人转账；卡号随附本身不足。

snapshot.en: An MSO should follow the relevant wire transfer requirements in the jurisdictions in which it operates, directly or through its agents, with regard to its role in a wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應就其在電傳轉帳中擔當的角色，在其直接營運或通過代理人營運的司法管轄區遵從相關的電傳轉帳規定。

snapshot.en: The beneficiary institution of a wire transfer may be the ordering institution itself, for example where the transfer is conducted between branches of the same MSO.
snapshot.tc: 電傳轉帳的收款機構可以是匯款機構本身，例如在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: An MSO that is itself the originator or the recipient of a wire transfer is not acting as an ordering, intermediary or beneficiary institution, so the wire transfer requirements do not bind it for that transaction.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者本身是電傳轉帳的匯款人或收款人時，並非以匯款機構、中介機構或收款機構的身分行事，因此無需就該交易遵守電傳轉帳規定。

snapshot.en: The wire transfer requirements of Schedule 2 and the Guideline also apply to wire transfers that use a cover payment mechanism, of which MT202COV payments are given as an example.
snapshot.tc: 附表2及指引的電傳轉帳規定，亦適用於採用直接撥付機制的電傳轉帳，以MT202COV付款即為其中一例。

snapshot.en: A remittance transaction differs from a wire transfer, and for a transaction that is a wire transfer the MSO should have regard to the Guideline's wire transfer chapter in meeting the special requirements for wire transfers.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易與電傳轉帳是不同的；如交易是電傳轉帳，金錢服務經營者在遵守電傳轉帳的特別規定時，應顧及指引第10章關於電傳轉帳的導引。

snapshot.en: A transaction that an institution carries out by electronic means on behalf of a person can be a wire transfer even where the money is to be made available to that same person at an institution.
snapshot.tc: 機構代表某人藉電子方式進行的交易，即使目的是將某筆金錢轉往某間機構以提供予該人本身而非另一人，仍可屬電傳轉賬。

snapshot.en: A transaction remains a wire transfer where one or more institutions other than the ordering and beneficiary institutions take part in completing the transfer of the money.
snapshot.tc: 即使有一間或多於一間匯款機構及收款機構以外的機構參與完成有關金錢轉賬，有關交易仍屬《打擊洗錢條例》所指的電傳轉賬。

evidence.covers: 机构自营和卡号、境内定义

snapshot.en: The wire transfer requirements do not apply to a wire transfer between two financial institutions, or between a financial institution and a foreign institution, if each acts on its own behalf.
snapshot.tc: 在兩間金融機構之間，或在一間金融機構與一間外地機構之間的電傳轉賬，如每間機構均只代表本身行事，電傳轉賬的特別規定即不適用。

snapshot.en: For the wire transfer requirements, an institution outside Hong Kong that carries on a business similar to a financial institution's counts as a foreign institution.
snapshot.tc: 就電傳轉賬的特別規定而言，位於香港以外地方而所經營的業務與金融機構所經營者相類似的機構，即屬外地機構。

snapshot.en: A wire transfer is a domestic wire transfer where its ordering and beneficiary institutions are financial institutions located in Hong Kong, even if an intermediary institution involved is located elsewhere.
snapshot.tc: 如電傳轉賬的匯款機構及收款機構均為位於香港的金融機構，即使所涉的中介機構位於其他地方，該項轉賬亦屬本地電傳轉賬。

snapshot.en: For the exclusion of wire transfers arising from card transactions to apply, one condition is that the card's number, or an equivalent unique identifier, is included in the accompanying message or payment form.
snapshot.tc: 因使用信用咭、扣賬咭或預付咭的交易而引致的電傳轉賬要獲豁除，條件之一是附隨的信息或付款表格已包括該咭的號碼或等同的獨特標識。

source_quotes.text: the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer;
並非用作一項支付系統以執行人對人之間轉帳

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 在卡消费与卡作为个人转账工具间作情景区别，测试豁免全部条件。
topics.notes: 交叉复核：m3-292#5 明说只是卡交易豁免的“条件之一”，只考随附卡号；没有卡不能用作人与人转账系统的条件。整个 m6-376 也未考卡的用途。 源 02 EN PDF67/TC PDF77 与源 10 Sch2s12(2)一致。S043 同章节不等于卡例外已覆盖。

topics.topic: 电汇随附资料、8 千门槛与身份核实
covered_aspects: 收款人姓名、账户或可追踪参考号、8 千以上来源资料须准确、已 CDD 通常无须再核实、小额关联累计
missing_aspects: 修正 m3-261#3，使答案与 Sch2s12(3)(c) 及 ¶10.5(c) 的地址／客户编号／证件号码／个人出生日期地点替代关系一致；同步题解、答案及组合选项。

evidence.covers: 小额资料范围，排除第 3 句

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the originator's address before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄匯款人的地址。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the recipient's name before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the message or payment form accompanying it need include only the originator's details.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，附隨該項轉賬的信息或付款表格只須包括匯款人的資料。

evidence.covers: 两端账户/参考号由谁分配

snapshot.en: Where the originator has no account with the MSO from which the money for the transfer is paid, the MSO must record a unique reference number that it assigns to the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人並無在該金錢服務經營者開立作為電傳轉賬所付金錢來源的戶口，該經營者須記錄由其本身編配予該電傳轉賬的獨特參考編號。

snapshot.en: Where the recipient has no account with the beneficiary institution to which the money is paid, the MSO must record a unique reference number that the MSO itself assigns to the transfer.
snapshot.tc: 如收款人並無在收款機構開立作為電傳轉賬所付金錢對象的戶口，該金錢服務經營者須記錄由其本身編配予該電傳轉賬的獨特參考編號。

evidence.covers: 可追踪、客户编号、准确核实

snapshot.en: Any unique reference number that the ordering institution or the beneficiary institution assigns in place of an account number should permit traceability of the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構或收款機構在沒有戶口號碼時所編配的獨特參考編號，應可用作追蹤有關的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: A customer identification number for the originator must refer to a record held by the beneficiary institution containing at least one of: the customer address, identification document number, or date and place of birth.
snapshot.tc: 匯款人的客戶識別號碼，必須參照由收款機構持有、最少載有客戶地址、識別文件號碼或出生日期及地點其中一項的紀錄。

snapshot.en: The ordering institution must ensure that the required originator information accompanying a wire transfer is accurate, whatever the amount of money that the transfer involves.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構必須確保附隨於電傳轉帳的所需匯款人資料準確，而這項規定適用於任何款額的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: The required originator information is deemed to be accurate if the originator's identity has been verified in compliance with the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人的身分已根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢指引》的規定核實，所需的匯款人資料便視為準確。

snapshot.en: No further verification of the originator information is normally required, although an ordering institution may exercise its discretion to verify it further in individual cases.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，匯款機構無需再進一步核實匯款人資料，但仍可運用酌情權，就個別個案作進一步核實。

snapshot.en: Verifying the originator of an occasional wire transfer below $8,000 is in general not required; one exception is where several transactions appear to be linked and together reach $8,000 or more.
snapshot.tc: 8,000元以下的非經常電傳轉帳一般無需核實匯款人，例外情況之一是數項交易似有關連並合共達8,000元或以上。

source_quotes.text: the originator’s address or, the originator’s customer identification number
匯款人的地址或、匯款人的客戶識別號碼

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 优先修 m3-261 第 3 句并补完整资料替代选择；补题和现题修正应列为一项任务。
topics.notes: 已向主审核指出现题质量问题。源 02 ¶10.5 同样明确可替代，不能以笔记或长引文掩盖题句错漏。 交叉复核：G068 与 S043／正确性发现 S-C01 是同一问题。当前 m3-261#3 错把地址列作必须随附，先修此句即可直接测试替代字段；不应再把它计为一整道新题。 建议新增题数 0、现题修正任务 1；复核 s12(5) 本地/批次例外，避免修后仍有绝对措辞。完整双语法例证据见 statute.json 的 S-C01。

topics.topic: 批量/境内电汇简化、补资料时限及汇款机构控制
covered_aspects: 同一汇款人批量文件完整可追踪、境内可只附账号/参考、收到请求后 3 工作天及执法即时、检测缺资料/风险政策/及时纠正

snapshot.en: For a domestic wire transfer, the MSO may include in the accompanying message or payment form only the originator's account number, or the unique reference number recorded in its place.
snapshot.tc: 就本地電傳轉賬而言，該金錢服務經營者可在附隨的信息或付款表格內，只包括匯款人的戶口號碼或代替該號碼記錄的獨特參考編號。

snapshot.en: Where a domestic wire transfer carries the originator's account or reference number instead of full details, the MSO must give the other originator details within 3 business days after the transfer, if the relevant authority or receiving institution asks.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉賬以匯款人的戶口號碼或參考編號代替完整資料，該經營者須在有關當局或收取其轉賬指示的機構要求下，於轉賬後3個營業日內提供所記錄的其他匯款人資料。

snapshot.en: Wire transfers from one originator batched for recipients outside Hong Kong need not each carry all required information if each carries the originator's account or reference number and the batch file holds the recorded information.
snapshot.tc: 來自單一匯款人、集合在群組檔案中傳遞予香港以外地方收款人的電傳轉賬，如每項均附隨匯款人戶口號碼或參考編號，而群組檔案載有所記錄資料，便無需每項附隨全部規定資料。

evidence.covers: 完整批量、执法即时和系统

snapshot.en: Where wire transfers from a single originator are batched for recipients outside Hong Kong, the batch file should hold required and accurate originator information, and required recipient information, fully traceable in the recipient country.
snapshot.tc: 集合來自單一匯款人的多項電傳轉帳、傳遞予香港以外地方收款人的群組檔案，應載有所需及準確的匯款人資料及所需收款人資料，並可在收款人的國家全面追查。

snapshot.en: Where a domestic wire transfer omits the complete required originator information, that information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon their request.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉帳略去部分所需匯款人資料，匯款機構亦需在執法機構提出要求時，立即向其提供全部所需匯款人資料。

snapshot.en: An ordering institution's procedures include reasonable measures, such as regular review or testing by internal control or audit, to identify domestic or cross-border wire transfers lacking required information.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構的程序包括採取合理措施（例如定期覆核或藉內部管控或審計職能進行測試，以評估系統功能），識辨本地或跨境電傳轉帳是否欠缺所需資料。

snapshot.en: An ordering institution's procedures also include risk-based policies and procedures for handling outgoing transfers that lack required information, and the timely rectifying of any control deficiencies identified.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構的程序亦包括設有風險為本的政策及程序，以處理欠缺所需資料的電傳轉帳，並適時糾正所識別的管控不足之處。

source_quotes.text: within 3 business days after the request is received.

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。

topics.topic: 中间与收款机构的资料传递、缺漏及核实
covered_aspects: 完整随附、技术限制留 5 年、直通处理/事后监控、执行拒绝暂停、追讨缺漏及风险/关系措施、8 千收款人未核实才核实
missing_aspects: 按指引，境内或跨境电汇欠缺所需汇款人／收款人资料时，收款机构须尽快从发出指示机构取得；与法例境内账号／参考号的较窄表述区分。

snapshot.en: Acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer, the MSO must transmit all of the information it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction.
snapshot.tc: 該金錢服務經營者如在電傳轉賬中以中介機構身分行事，須將其連同該項轉賬一併獲得的所有資料，傳遞予收取它的轉賬指示的機構。

snapshot.en: If a domestic wire transfer reaches it as beneficiary institution without the originator's account or reference number, the MSO must obtain that number from the instructing institution as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉賬送達作為收款機構的該經營者時沒有附隨匯款人戶口號碼或參考編號，該經營者須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉賬指示的機構取得該號碼。

snapshot.en: A beneficiary institution aware that accompanying information purporting to be the required information is incomplete or meaningless must, as soon as reasonably practicable, take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.
snapshot.tc: 收款機構如察覺附隨的看來是規定資料的資料並不完整或不具意義，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer that is not domestic, the MSO as an intermediary institution, like a beneficiary institution, must as soon as reasonably practicable obtain any missing required information from the instructing institution.
snapshot.tc: 就並非本地的電傳轉賬而言，作為中介機構的該經營者與收款機構一樣，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉賬指示的機構取得遺漏的規定資料。

snapshot.en: If missing information it is required to obtain cannot be obtained, the MSO must either consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with the instructing institution, or take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved.
snapshot.tc: 如未能取得其須取得的遺漏資料，該經營者須考慮限制或結束它與發出轉賬指示的機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

evidence.covers: 技术限制、不同机构监控及收款核实

snapshot.en: Where technical limitations prevent required information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer from remaining with a related domestic one, an intermediary institution should keep a record of all information received for at least seven years.
snapshot.tc: 如技術限制妨礙附隨於跨境電傳轉帳的所需匯款人或收款人資料保留於相關的本地電傳轉帳中，中介機構應將接收的所有資料存檔，為期至少7年。

snapshot.en: An intermediary institution should also keep a record of all the information received where technical limitations prevent required information accompanying a domestic wire transfer from staying with a related cross-border one.
snapshot.tc: 如技術限制妨礙附隨於本地電傳轉帳的所需匯款人或收款人資料保留於相關的跨境電傳轉帳中，中介機構亦應將接收的所有資料存檔。

snapshot.en: To spot incoming transfers lacking required originator or recipient information, an intermediary institution takes reasonable measures consistent with straight-through processing, for domestic and cross-border transfers alike.
snapshot.tc: 為識辨欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的匯入電傳轉帳，中介機構會採取與直通式處理程序一致的合理措施，本地及跨境電傳轉帳皆然。

snapshot.en: The procedures of intermediary and beneficiary institutions alike include risk-based policies for deciding when to execute, reject or suspend a wire transfer lacking required information, and the appropriate follow-up action.
snapshot.tc: 中介機構及收款機構的程序同樣包括設有風險為本的政策及程序，以斷定何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需資料的電傳轉帳，以及適當的跟進行動。

snapshot.en: A beneficiary institution's reasonable measures for identifying domestic or cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator or recipient information may include post-event monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 收款機構為識辨欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的本地或跨境電傳轉帳而採取的合理措施，可包括事後監察。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer of $8,000 or above, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, a beneficiary institution should verify the recipient's identity even where that identity has been verified previously.
snapshot.tc: 就款額相等於8,000元或以上（或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額）的電傳轉帳，即使收款人的身分已獲核實，收款機構仍應再加以核實。

source_quotes.text: if a domestic or cross-border wire transfer is not accompanied by the required originator information or required recipient information
如本地或跨境電傳轉帳並無附隨所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 补明指引及法例要求差别的具体情景；不要把 B20 差异当任一来源无效。
topics.notes: B20 已定两者都学；m3-294 第 2 句覆盖较窄法例，未覆盖指引的较广范围。 交叉复核：m3-294#2 是法例境内电汇的汇款人账号／参考号规则；指引要求境内及跨境两种均追讨所需汇款／收款资料，尚未明确测出此扩展。m6-379 的检测和风险政策不能替代缺漏资料范围。 遵从 B20 两者都学，不将现有法例真句错误标为需改。S045 的法例层覆盖不消除指引层差异。

topics.topic: 非电汇汇款定义、身份及交易记录
covered_aspects: 境外汇款区别电汇、8 千或以上先核实、姓名住址证件/签发地/币种金额/日期时间收款人交付方式、可提供关长
missing_aspects: 非电汇汇款汇款人定义：有账户取出者为账户本人；无账户则为指示者，现 m3-292 同类句仅限电汇

snapshot.en: A remittance transaction differs from a wire transfer, and for a transaction that is a wire transfer the MSO should have regard to the Guideline's wire transfer chapter in meeting the special requirements for wire transfers.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易與電傳轉帳是不同的；如交易是電傳轉帳，金錢服務經營者在遵守電傳轉帳的特別規定時，應顧及指引第10章關於電傳轉帳的導引。

snapshot.en: The special requirements for remittance transactions apply to a remittance, other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency, carried out by a licensed MSO.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易的特別規定，適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及$8,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）而並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's name and address, and the currency and amount involved.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的姓名及地址，以及所涉的貨幣及款額。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's identification document number and, for a travel document, its place of issue.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的識別文件的號碼，以及（如屬旅行證件）發出旅行證件的地方。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the recipient's name and address, the method of delivery, and the date and time it received the instructions.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄收款人的姓名及地址、送遞的方式，以及接獲指示的日期及時間。

snapshot.en: Before carrying it out, the MSO must record the originator's date and place of birth, where the originator is an individual.
snapshot.tc: 進行交易前，金錢服務經營者須記錄匯款人的出生日期及地方（如匯款人屬一名個人）。

snapshot.en: For these requirements, a transaction is a remittance transaction if it is for sending money, or arranging for money to be sent, to a place outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 就有關規定而言，凡為將金錢送往香港以外地方或安排如此送交而進行的交易，即屬匯款交易。

snapshot.en: Address information accompanying a wire transfer or remittance should identify clearly where the parties are, for sanctions screening and AML/CFT monitoring, so a PO box should be avoided unless no alternative exists.
snapshot.tc: 電傳轉帳及匯款交易附隨的地址資料應足以清楚識別各方位置，以便篩查受制裁名單及為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集而監察，故除非別無選擇，應避免以郵政信箱為地址。

snapshot.en: For a remittance, the MSO should be able to justify that it has taken steps under the record-keeping chapter to keep the record of the originator and the transaction, so as to make it available to the JFIU if needed.
snapshot.tc: 就匯款交易而言，金錢服務經營者應能證明已按照指引第8章的規定採取步驟保存匯款人的紀錄及相關交易的資料，以便有需要時向財富情報組提供該等資料。

source_quotes.text: in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the remittance transaction.

topics.question_brief: 可与电汇角色补题合并，跨两种汇款明确有账户/无账户主体。
topics.notes: B19 门槛相等也算，B36 保留官方样题表述；不是另补一轮数字题。

topics.topic: 附录 A：身份证件、地区和未成年人
covered_aspects: 港居民 HKID/身份证明书、若干旅行文件、国际驾驶证不可、海外无照片例外、未成年人监护者核实、公司成立地查册
missing_aspects: P1：非居民身在香港用有效旅行证件；未身在香港时才可按附录 A 的相应国家身份证／国家驾驶执照选择。
P1：香港出生未成年人没有有效旅行证件／HKID 时的香港出生证明途径。
P2 顺带：澳门永久居民身份证属于可接受旅行证件；与现题的澳门居民旅游证区分。

evidence.covers: 居民文件、部分旅行文件和少数例外

snapshot.en: An MSO should always identify and/or verify the identity of a Hong Kong resident by reference to the resident's Hong Kong identity card or document of identity.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應經常根據香港居民的香港身份證或簽證身分書，來識別及/或核實他們的身分。

snapshot.en: The Permit for residents of Macau issued by the Director of Immigration and the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents constitute travel documents for identity verification.
snapshot.tc: 由入境事務處處長簽發的澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證，均為可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件。

snapshot.en: For a non-resident who is not physically present in Hong Kong, an international driving permit bearing the individual's photograph is acceptable for verifying identity.
snapshot.tc: 至於沒有現身香港的非香港居民，金錢服務經營者可接納附有其照片的國際駕駛許可證，用以核實其身分。

snapshot.en: Whenever establishing relations with a minor, the MSO should also record and verify the identity of the minor's parent or guardian representing or accompanying the minor.
snapshot.tc: 每當與未成年人建立業務關係時，應同時記錄及核實該未成年人士的父母或代表或陪同該未成年人士的監護人的身分。

snapshot.en: Where a jurisdiction has no national ID cards and the customer has no photographic travel document or driving licence, any other document accepted as evidence must bear a photograph.
snapshot.tc: 對於沒有國民身分證的司法管轄區的客戶，金錢服務經營者破例接受作身分證據的其他文件，必須附有其照片。

snapshot.en: An MSO may identify and verify a corporate customer by a company registry search in the place where the customer mainly operates, obtaining a full company search report there.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可於公司客戶主要營運所在地的公司註冊處查冊並取得完整的公司查冊報告，以識別及核實其身分。

source_quotes.text: For non-resident individuals who are not physically present in Hong Kong
非居民的身分則應根據他們的有效旅遊證件作出核實。

topics.priority_reason: 缺少实务上直接影响合规义务、例外或决定的命题；不代表官方出题频率。
topics.question_brief: 用非居民身在/不在香港及无证件未成年人场景，优先测试地理条件；澳门卡可合写。
topics.notes: 依 B4、B15、W4；其他旅行文件列表仅背景，不逐张强制补题。 交叉复核：地理条件和无证件香港出生未成年人确未测。m6-354#3 错在国际驾驶许可，判断其为假不需要知道国家驾驶执照的地理条件；第 2 句的澳门居民旅游证不是澳门永久居民身份证。澳门卡是列表细节，适合顺带，无须独立 P1。 源 02 EN PDF74/TC PDF84 已双语对照；按 B4/B15/W4。不要把所有旅行文件清单逐个要求补题。

topics.topic: 附录 A：核证人资格、程序及疑点处理
covered_aspects: 须见原件、签日期大写名/身份、使领馆人员、原则不自证、风险较高来源谨慎
missing_aspects: 客户法人的受专业操守规管专业人员以专业身份核证的例外；核证人声明副本与原件相符；真实性/文件属于客户有疑问时另加措施；其他典型合资格核证人范围

snapshot.en: Certification by an independent and appropriate person is effective only if the certifier has seen the original documentation.
snapshot.tc: 由獨立的合適人選認證身分核實文件時，證明人須查閱文件正本，認證才屬有效。

snapshot.en: The certifier should sign and date the copy document, print his or her name clearly in capitals underneath, and clearly indicate his or her position or capacity on it.
snapshot.tc: 證明人必須在文件的複本上簽署並寫上日期，在下方以大楷清楚列示其姓名，並清楚註明其職位或身分。

snapshot.en: An officer of an embassy, consulate or high commission of the country of issue of the identification document is among the examples of appropriate certifiers.
snapshot.tc: 發出身分核實文件的國家的大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員，是合適證明人的例子之一。

snapshot.en: In general, it is not sufficient for copies of identification documents to be self-certified by the customer whose identity is being verified.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，由客戶自行認證其身分核實文件的複本，並不足以達到認證的目的。

snapshot.en: The MSO must exercise caution in accepting certified copies, especially where they originate from a country perceived to represent a high risk or from unregulated entities.
snapshot.tc: 接納經認證的文件複本時必須審慎行事，特別是文件來自被視為涉及高風險的國家或不受監管的實體時。

source_quotes.text: certified the copy documents in his or her professional capacity.
並已經以其專業身分認證該等文件複本。

topics.topic: 术语表及不另命题的导航资料
covered_aspects: AML/CFT Systems、FI 定义、EDD 和 ML/TF 的核心术语已有题

snapshot.en: The Guideline's terms and abbreviations should be read by reference to its Glossary, and other words or phrases, where applicable, as the AMLO sets them out.
snapshot.tc: 本指引的用語及縮寫應參照其詞彙部分的釋義；如適用的話，其他詞語或短語則應按照《打擊洗錢條例》所載列的釋義詮釋。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the term “AML/CFT Systems” used in the Guideline means AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」指打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施。

snapshot.en: Unless specified otherwise, for example an FI as defined in the AMLO, the Guideline's term “financial institutions” has the same definition as in the FATF Recommendations.
snapshot.tc: 除另有指明外（例如符合《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構），「金融機構」一詞的定義與特別組織建議所載者相同。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the abbreviation “EDD” used in the Guideline stands for enhanced customer due diligence.
snapshot.tc: 根據本指引的詞彙部分，指引所用的「更嚴格的盡職審查」一詞，其涵義為更嚴格的客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the abbreviation “ML/TF” used in the Guideline stands for money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集」指洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集。

source_quotes.text: AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls

topics.priority_reason: 本行核心命题已有直接题句，或仅作参考，无需以题数凑覆盖。
topics.notes: 其他缩写在对应实质规则中学习；封面版次、目录、单纯网址及未测试的缩写不自动列补题缺口。

topics.topic: 机构职能专项：FATF 全球合作网络与推动实施
covered_aspects: 制定标准、推动有效实施、评估各司法管辖区及严格跟进、香港须实施最新建议均已测
missing_aspects: 法律、监管及作业三类措施；其他相关威胁范围；协调应对的基础；全球合作网络及成员司法管辖区交流，尚未成为直接题句。

evidence.covers: 标准、实施、评估、跟进和香港义务

snapshot.en: Formed in 1989, the FATF is an inter-governmental body whose objectives are to set standards and promote effective implementation of measures for combating ML, TF and PF.
snapshot.tc: 在1989年成立的特別組織屬跨政府組織，宗旨是制訂標準及推動有效執行打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的措施。

snapshot.en: Recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF, the FATF Recommendations also help ensure a level playing field.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織建議有助營造公平競爭的環境，並獲承認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準。

snapshot.en: To ensure full and effective implementation of its standards, the FATF conducts evaluations on jurisdictions and undertakes stringent follow-up after them.
snapshot.tc: 為確保其標準在全球全面而有效地執行，特別組織會透過評核來監察各司法管轄區的合規情況，並在評核後進行嚴格的跟進程序。

snapshot.en: Jurisdictions it identifies as high-risk could be subject to enhanced scrutiny by the FATF or counter-measures by its members and the international community.
snapshot.tc: 被識別為高度風險的司法管轄區，可能會受到特別組織加強審查，或受到特別組織成員及國際社會採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations, which can be found on the FATF website.
snapshot.tc: 作為特別組織的成員，香港有責任實施最新的特別組織建議，而特別組織建議可在特別組織的網站查閱。

source_quotes.text: a global network for international cooperation that facilitates exchanges between member jurisdictions.

topics.topic: 机构职能专项：海关关长与海关部门
covered_aspects: 海关关长发指引、监管 CDD/纪录、纪律处分、收取机构风险评估及海外无法符合通知，和 JFIU 分工已有题句

snapshot.en: The Guideline is issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise (CCE), and compliance with the Guideline is enforced through the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 本指引由海關關長（關長）公布，而本指引的遵行情況會按照《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》強制執行。

snapshot.en: Disciplinary and other actions under the AMLO may be taken against an MSO that fails to comply with the Guideline, for non-compliance with the relevant requirements.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》採取的紀律行動及其他行動，或會因沒有遵守相關規定而施加於未有遵守本指引的金錢服務經營者。

snapshot.en: The AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs, and gives the JFIU powers to supervise compliance with these and the AMLO's other requirements.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》向金錢服務經營者施加盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定，並賦予財富情報組權力監督該等及其他規定的合規情況。

evidence.covers: 关长收取评估并非 JFIU

snapshot.en: Having mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the JFIU, rather than to the CCE, when required to do so
snapshot.tc: 設有適當機制，在被要求時向財富情報組（而非海關關長）提供該風險評估

evidence.covers: 海外无法符合向关长通知

snapshot.en: The MSO informs the CCE of the failure in its next routine filing, having first recorded the failure and its causes in its own internal records
snapshot.tc: 該經營者會在下一次例行提交資料時將該情況通知關長，並先在其內部記錄該情況及其成因

snapshot.en: Subject to the requirements on procedure and penalty guidelines, the Commissioner may use any one or more of the powers, which include a public reprimand and an order to take remedial action by a set date.
snapshot.tc: 在符合程序及指引的規定下，關長可行使一項或多於一項權力，包括公開譴責該經營者及命令其在指明日期或之前採取糾正行動。

snapshot.en: Having exercised such a power, the Commissioner may disclose to the public details of the decision, the reasons for which it was made and any material facts relating to the case.
snapshot.tc: 關長行使該等權力後，可向公眾披露其決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由以及關於該個案的任何重要事實。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner must inform the operator of the decision by notice in writing, stating the reasons and that the operator may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision.
snapshot.tc: 關長須藉書面通知將決定告知該經營者，通知須載有作出決定的理由及該經營者可向覆核審裁處申請覆核的提示。

snapshot.en: Where they apply, the terms of any reprimand and the action the operator must take under the decision are also to be stated in the Commissioner's notice of the decision.
snapshot.tc: 在適用範圍內，關長的決定通知亦須載有根據該決定譴責該經營者的內容，以及根據該決定規定其採取的行動。

source_quotes.text: provides the CCE with powers to supervise compliance with these requirements

topics.topic: 机构职能专项：JFIU 与 MLRO 的分工
covered_aspects: MLRO 为机构内部报告中枢及 JFIU 联络点；JFIU 接收 STR、确认及同意机制、SAFE 和报告反馈均有题句

snapshot.en: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點

snapshot.en: The MLRO's functions include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向財富情報組報告

snapshot.en: Oversight of the records of internal reviews of disclosures and exception reports is the Compliance Officer's responsibility
snapshot.tc: 監督備存內部披露及例外情況報告的覆核紀錄，屬合規主任的主要職能

snapshot.en: The MLRO's principal functions include oversight of the provision of guidance on how to avoid “tipping off”
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引

snapshot.en: A person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must, as soon as reasonable, file an STR with the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑任何財產是恐怖分子財產，須在合理範圍內盡快向關長提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: Where applicable, an MSO may adopt the “SAFE” approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes screening the account for suspicious indicators and asking the customer appropriate questions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可按情況採用財富情報組所推廣的「SAFE」方法，其中包括篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標及向客戶作出恰當提問。

snapshot.en: The steps of the “SAFE” approach that an MSO may adopt include finding out the customer's records and then filing an STR with the JFIU on what has been found.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可採用的「SAFE」方法，包括翻查客戶的已知紀錄，然後就所得結果向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: An MSO should ensure that its STRs are of high quality, taking into account the feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and by the CCE from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應留意財富情報組在季度報告及關長不時提供的反饋意見及導引，以確保其可疑交易報告屬高水平。

snapshot.en: The JFIU's quarterly report is written specifically for the MSO sector, and consists of an analysis of STRs and matters of interest and feedback.
snapshot.tc: 財富情報組的季度報告是專為金錢服務經營者行業編寫的，分為可疑交易報告的分析及注意事項及反饋意見兩部分。

snapshot.en: The quarterly report sits in a secure area of the JFIU's website, for which an MSO may apply for a login name and password through the registration form or by contacting the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 季度報告可於財富情報組網站的限制區查閱，金錢服務經營者可填妥登記表格或直接聯絡財富情報組申請登入帳戶及密碼。

evidence.covers: JFIU 同意不等于安全保证

snapshot.en: Where the report is made before the MSO undertakes the disclosed acts, the defence applies if the acts are undertaken with the JFIU's consent.
snapshot.tc: 如報告是在作出所披露作為之前作出，而該作為是得到財富情報組同意的，即可提供法定免責辯護。

snapshot.en: If there is no need for imminent action, such as a restraint order on an account, consent will usually be given for the MSO to operate the account.
snapshot.tc: 如無需立即採取行動（例如發出限制令），財富情報組一般會同意金錢服務經營者運作該戶口。

snapshot.en: The statutory defence does not absolve the MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation.
snapshot.tc: 法定免責辯護不會免除金錢服務經營者因該帳戶的持續運作而涉及的法律、聲譽或監管風險。

snapshot.en: A “consent” response to a pre-transaction report should not be construed as a “clean bill of health” for the continued operation of the account.
snapshot.tc: 財富情報組就交易前的報告作出「同意」的回應，不應被解釋為該戶口持續運作的「健康證明」。

source_quotes.text: the main point of contact with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) and law enforcement agencies.

topics.topic: 机构职能专项：FATF 研究洗钱/恐怖融资技术的来源界限
covered_aspects: 已测试 FATF 提供风险指导文件及可作培训的类型学材料

snapshot.en: For more red flag indicators, reference can be made to relevant guidance issued from time to time by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities.
snapshot.tc: 如需了解可疑交易及活動指標的詳情，可參考特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關導引。

snapshot.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Guidance for Money Service Operators in Detecting Terrorist Financing”.
snapshot.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《金錢服務經營者偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。

snapshot.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers”.
snapshot.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《藉匯款和貨幣兌換供應商洗錢》。

evidence.covers: FATF 文件和类型学作培训

snapshot.en: An MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of its training materials.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可考慮使用特別組織的文章及典型案件作為培訓材料。

source_quotes.text: An MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of the training materials.

topics.topic: 能力評核與適當人選及持牌資格
covered_aspects: 評核為高層合規能力及適當人選因素
獲邀／考試合格不等於已符合發牌要求

snapshot.en: The Assessment aims at ensuring that the compliance officer of a licensed MSO has a fundamental knowledge and clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee its AML/CFT systems.
snapshot.tc: 能力評核旨在確保持牌金錢服務經營者的合規主任對打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集具備基本知識並清楚了解，以便妥為監督有關制度。

snapshot.en: According to the Guidance Notes, the Assessment helps to raise compliance standards across the MSO sector and to safeguard the integrity of the AML/CFT regime the AMLO establishes.
snapshot.tc: 《須知》指能力評核有助提升金錢服務業整體的合規水平，亦可捍衛按《打擊洗錢條例》建立的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: In the evaluation of overall fit and proper status, the Assessment result carries a substantial weighting, and it is one of the factors the CCE has regard to in considering a grant or renewal.
snapshot.tc: 在評定整體的適當人選資格時，能力評核的成績會佔相當比重，屬關長考慮批給牌照或將牌照續期時會顧及的因素之一。

snapshot.en: An invitation to the Assessment does not imply that the candidate has fully met the licensing requirements, as the vetting process is still in progress.
snapshot.tc: 鑑於牌照的審批程序仍在進行中，即使應考者已獲邀應考能力評核，亦不代表其已完全符合各項發牌規定。

snapshot.en: A pass in the Assessment does not necessarily make an applicant eligible for a licence; for the grant, the licensing requirements in the AMLO and the Licensing Guide must also be met.
snapshot.tc: 即使在能力評核取得合格成績，亦不代表合資格取得牌照；申請人要獲批給牌照，必須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及《牌照指引》訂明的規定。

snapshot.en: The Guidance Notes aim to give candidates more information on the Assessment, especially on its examination format and its criteria, so that they can better prepare for it.
snapshot.tc: 《須知》旨在向應考者提供更多有關能力評核的資料，尤其是考試形式及能力評核準則方面，讓應考者為考試作好準備。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, each partner in the partnership must be a fit and proper person to operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥，該合夥的每名合夥人均須屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。

snapshot.en: If a corporate applicant has an ultimate owner, the ultimate owner must be fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 如就屬法團的申請人有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied that every director and every shareholder is fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的申請人而言，關長須信納其每名董事及每名股東均屬與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For an application to operate at particular premises, the Commissioner must be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 就要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請而言，關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。

snapshot.en: Once satisfied of every matter that the Ordinance requires, the Commissioner must grant the licence to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 關長一經信納條例規定的所有事宜均已符合，便必須向申請人批給牌照。

source_quotes.text: A pass in the Assessment does not necessarily mean that you are eligible for a licence.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 應考人資格、提名及考試時限
covered_aspects: 高級管理層資格、最多三名合夥人及自然人董事
同公司同場、續期提名、初次應考及重考期限

snapshot.en: An eligible person must be senior management overseeing the money service business and directly involved in decisions on company policy and governance.
snapshot.tc: 合資格人士必須是監督金錢服務業務運作的高級管理層，並直接參與公司政策及管治安排的決策。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant or licensee is a partnership, not more than three of its partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 如牌照申請人或持牌人屬合夥，可獲提名應考能力評核的合夥人不得超過三名。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant or licensee is a corporation, the directors it may nominate include a director that is itself a corporation.
snapshot.tc: 如牌照申請人或持牌人屬法團，可獲提名應考能力評核的董事包括本身屬法團的董事。

snapshot.en: Candidates of the same company under one application or licence must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances.
snapshot.tc: 就同一申請或牌照而言，同屬一所公司的應考者在任何情況下均必須應考同一時段的能力評核。

snapshot.en: A licensee nominates eligible persons for the Assessment when it notifies the deletion of its only eligible person who has passed the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人具報唯一取得合格成績的合資格人士已卸任時，會提名合資格人士應考。

snapshot.en: For the grant of a licence, the eligible persons must sit the Assessment within 30 days upon attending the interview with C&ED officers.
snapshot.tc: 就批給牌照而言，合資格人士必須在與海關人員會面當日起計30日內應考能力評核。

snapshot.en: A licensee that has to nominate for its renewal must do so within 30 days upon receipt of the invitation letter for the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 續牌時須提名的持牌人，必須在接獲邀請信當日起計30日內提名合資格人士應考。

snapshot.en: If its eligible persons fail at renewal, a licensee may arrange a re-take at any time after 30 days upon the notification of result.
snapshot.tc: 續牌時合資格人士如應考失敗，持牌人可在成績通知發出當日起計30日後任何時間安排再次應考。

snapshot.en: If all its eligible persons still fail before the licence expires, the renewal could be refused where the CCE considers the licensee no longer fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 如所有合資格人士在牌照屆滿前仍未取得合格成績，關長若認為持牌人不再屬適當人選，可拒絕續牌申請。

source_quotes.text: must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: B1/B5/E2：續期須提名者才適用7日要求；不把每一行政安排變成補題缺口。

topics.topic: 公司評核資格的失效及補考
covered_aspects: 公司為本資格、最後合格高層離任失效
非獨資的補考安排及180日續期界線
關長酌情附加條件

snapshot.en: The CCE treats a pass as a company-based qualification, which is also one of the fit and proper statuses to be associated with the business.
snapshot.tc: 關長將在能力評核取得合格成績視作以公司為單位取得的資格，這亦關乎是否屬與業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: The qualification becomes void automatically when the licensee no longer has at least one member of its senior management who passed.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人的高級管理層中不再有最少一名成員在能力評核取得合格成績，此項資格將自動失效。

snapshot.en: Once void, a partnership or corporation, but not a sole proprietorship, may have an eligible person sit within 30 days of notifying C&ED of the change.
snapshot.tc: 資格失效後，合夥及法團可安排合資格人士於具報合夥或董事人選改變後30日內應考，但獨資經營的持牌人除外。

snapshot.en: Where a licensee whose qualification is void is due for renewal within 180 days, the Assessment follows the arrangement for renewing a licence.
snapshot.tc: 如資格已失效的持牌人須於180日內將牌照續期，其能力評核須按關於續牌的安排處理。

snapshot.en: On the merits of each case, the CCE may allow a licensee with no eligible person who has passed to continue its business, imposing licensing conditions.
snapshot.tc: 關長經考慮個案情況後，即使持牌人已沒有合資格人士取得合格成績，仍可容許其繼續經營，並會施加發牌條件。

source_quotes.text: the validity of this company-based qualification will be void automatically.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 考試形式、及格標準、範圍及考務
covered_aspects: 35題／75分鐘／七單元及雙重及格門檻
證件、閱卷、惡劣天氣及主要考場規則已有題

snapshot.en: The Assessment has 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English, each with only one correct answer, and candidates must complete it in 1 hour and 15 minutes.
snapshot.tc: 能力評核備有中文或英文版本，共35條選擇題，每題只有一個正確答案，須於1小時15分鐘內完成。

snapshot.en: A candidate who attains a total score of 25 or above for the entire Assessment paper obtains a pass in the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 應考者整份試卷取得的總分達25分或以上，即可在能力評核取得合格成績。

snapshot.en: Candidates will be notified of their results, which are PASS or FAIL only, by e-mail only and within 14 days after the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 能力評核結果只分合格或不合格，並會在考試結束後14日內僅以電郵通知應考者。

snapshot.en: A candidate dissatisfied with the result may ask in writing for a re-check within 14 days after the date of issuance of the result notification.
snapshot.tc: 應考者如對其能力評核成績不滿，可在發出成績通知當日起計14日內以書面要求覆檢。

snapshot.en: A re-check looks at the answer sheet for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies, and its result is final.
snapshot.tc: 覆檢答題紙時會留意輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一等技術錯誤，而覆檢結果將視作最終成績。

snapshot.en: Once a re-check is completed, C&ED will disclose to the candidate, on request, the exact score that the candidate obtained.
snapshot.tc: 完成覆檢後，海關會應要求向應考者披露其在能力評核取得的實際分數。

snapshot.en: One of the seven modules of the Assessment covers general knowledge on AML/CFT and on counter proliferation financing.
snapshot.tc: 在能力評核的七個單元中，其中一個單元涵蓋有關打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集與打擊擴散資金籌集的常識。

snapshot.en: Parts 1 to 7 of the AMLO are covered by one module of the Assessment, and the Schedules to the AMLO by a separate module.
snapshot.tc: 在能力評核中，《打擊洗錢條例》第1至7部屬一個單元，而《打擊洗錢條例》的附表則另屬一個單元。

snapshot.en: In the Assessment, the module on MSO's systems and controls (iii) covers the institutional governance and strategy of an MSO.
snapshot.tc: 在能力評核中，金錢服務經營者的系統及管控措施(iii)單元涵蓋機構層面的管治及策略。

snapshot.en: The Licensing Guide and the guidelines and circulars that the C&ED issues to MSOs are among the materials on which the questions are mainly set.
snapshot.tc: 海關向金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》、各類指引及通函，均屬選擇題大致取材的公開資料。

snapshot.en: Each of the seven modules, including the one on guidelines promulgated by the C&ED, consists of five multiple-choice questions.
snapshot.tc: 能力評核的7個單元中，包括海關頒布的指引在內，每一個單元各由5條選擇題組成。

snapshot.en: Candidates should present a Hong Kong Identity Card or another identification document with a photo, such as a valid travel document.
snapshot.tc: 應考者須出示香港身份證或其他附有相片的身份證明文件，例如有效的旅遊證件。

snapshot.en: Of the documents to be presented, the authorization letter applies only to candidates of a partnership company or a corporation.
snapshot.tc: 應考時須出示的文件中，授權書僅適用於合夥公司及法團的應考者。

snapshot.en: A candidate who presents an identification document that is damaged or defaced will be refused entry to the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 如應考者出示的身份證明文件受損或曾遭塗改，將被拒絕應考能力評核。

snapshot.en: Requests to change the date, time or centre of the Assessment will not be considered, and latecomers will not be let in once it has started.
snapshot.tc: 更改應考日期、時間或試場的要求將不被接納，而開考後應試者不會獲准進入試場。

snapshot.en: A candidate who violates the rules or acts dishonestly during the Assessment is liable to be disqualified, and may also be asked to leave the centre immediately.
snapshot.tc: 應試者如違反規定或以不誠實的行為應考，可被取消考試資格，亦可能被要求立即離開能力評核試場。

snapshot.en: Where the invigilator has any doubt on a candidate's identity, the invigilator may copy the identification document at the centre for further verification when required.
snapshot.tc: 如監考員對應試者的身份有懷疑，可於試場複印其身份證明文件，以便在有需要時作進一步核實。

snapshot.en: A candidate may take an unused question book or answer sheet away from the Assessment centre, but must leave behind any that has been used.
snapshot.tc: 應考者可把未曾使用的問卷或答題紙攜離試場，但已使用的問卷或答題紙則須留在試場。

snapshot.en: Mobile phones, other electronic devices or articles that can emit sound must be switched off throughout the examination.
snapshot.tc: 在整個考試過程中，考生必須關掉手提電話、其他電子裝置或任何備有發聲功能的物品。

snapshot.en: Candidates must bring with them to the Assessment centre the stationery they will need for marking the multiple-choice answer sheet.
snapshot.tc: 應考者須自行準備並攜帶在選擇題答題紙上作答所需的文具，前往能力評核試場應考。

snapshot.en: Answers not written on the multiple-choice answer sheet will not be marked, and nothing may be copied from the question book onto the invitation letter.
snapshot.tc: 寫在選擇題答題紙以外位置的答案將不獲評分，而應考者亦不可將問卷的任何內容抄寫在邀請信上。

snapshot.en: As a general rule, the Assessment is held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, or the Amber or Red rainstorm signal, is issued by the Hong Kong Observatory.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，如天文台發出三號或以下的熱帶氣旋信號，或「黃色」或「紅色」暴雨警告信號，考試會如期舉行。

snapshot.en: If typhoon signal No. 8 or above, or the Black rainstorm warning, is still hoisted at or after 7:00 a.m. on the scheduled date, the Assessment will be suspended.
snapshot.tc: 如八號或以上的熱帶氣旋信號或「黑色」暴雨警告信號於考試當日上午7時或之後仍然生效，能力評核會改期。

snapshot.en: Alternative arrangements, if any, will be published on the website of the MSO Licensing System on the first working day that follows.
snapshot.tc: 如因惡劣天氣而需另作安排，金錢服務經營者牌照系統網頁將於隨後首個工作日公布有關安排。

snapshot.en: Where the C&ED requires changes to the Assessment arrangements, candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如海關須更改能力評核的安排，海關將於能力評核舉行前盡快以電郵通知應考者有關更改。

snapshot.en: The C&ED may require candidates, as appropriate, to produce medical proof confirming their disabilities in order to make suitable arrangements for them.
snapshot.tc: 海關或會在有需要時要求應考者出示醫學證明，以便在確定其殘疾情況後作出適當的應考安排。

snapshot.en: Candidates should not, without permission, enter any area of the centre not open to them, and in any dispute the decision of the C&ED is final and conclusive.
snapshot.tc: 未經准許，應考者不應進入試場內沒有向應考者開放的範圍；如有任何爭議，一概以海關的最終決定為準。

topics.topic: 金錢服務定義及牌照申請原則
covered_aspects: 兌換／匯款定義、向關長先申請牌照
多處所併同申請及不退申請費
紙本、郵寄、網上提交

snapshot.en: A person who wishes to operate a money service is required to apply for a licence, and must apply to the CCE before operating the service.
snapshot.tc: 擬經營金錢服務的人須申請牌照，並必須在經營金錢服務前向關長提出申請。

snapshot.en: Each additional premises is included in the application for the grant of a licence, with a fee paid for each, and needs no separate application.
snapshot.tc: 申請批給牌照時，額外處所須列入同一申請書並就每一處所繳費，無須另行申請。

snapshot.en: If the CCE later refuses to grant the licence, the application fee that was collected for processing the application is refunded to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 如關長其後拒絕批給牌照，就處理該申請而收取的牌照申請費用會發還申請人。

snapshot.en: The completed application, with photocopies of the requisite documents, must be lodged by the applicant in person at the Money Service Supervision Bureau of C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 填妥的申請文件連同所需文件的複本，必須由申請人親自遞交至香港海關金錢服務監理科。

snapshot.en: The application form and the submission guidelines for the Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau or C&ED's website.
snapshot.tc: 申請表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引，可在金錢服務監理科索取，或從海關網站下載。

snapshot.en: Operating only a money changing service, with no remittance service, is operating a money service, and so is operating only a remittance service.
snapshot.tc: 只經營貨幣兌換服務而沒有經營匯款服務，即屬經營金錢服務；只經營匯款服務亦然。

snapshot.en: To fall within the hotel exclusion, every transaction of the service must be a sale by the hotel manager of non-Hong Kong currencies for Hong Kong currency.
snapshot.tc: 要符合酒店的例外情況，有關服務的每宗交易均須是管理酒店的人收取港元貨幣而售出港元以外的貨幣。

snapshot.en: To fall within the hotel exclusion, the service must run within the hotel's premises with the convenience of hotel guests as its primary purpose.
snapshot.tc: 要符合酒店的例外情況，有關服務須在酒店的處所內經營，並以方便入住酒店的顧客為主要目的。

snapshot.en: A remittance service includes arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong, where the service is operated in Hong Kong as a business.
snapshot.tc: 在香港作為業務經營的匯款服務，包括安排在香港以外地方收取金錢的服務。

snapshot.en: Supplying financial institutions with nothing more than message or other support systems for moving funds is not treated as operating a remittance service.
snapshot.tc: 向金融機構提供的如僅屬資金傳送所用的信息或支援系統，提供者並不被當作經營匯款服務。

source_quotes.text: A person must apply for a licence from the CCE before he or she operates a money service.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 牌照FAQ Q1/Q6歷史日期及Q8地址不作背誦目標；Q2郵政署長屬非MSO的制度背景，不作本單元補題。

topics.topic: 牌照格式、年期及停止有效
covered_aspects: 兩年或關長指定期限
牌照須列有效期，不要求列洗錢報告主任姓名
死亡／解散／清盤停止有效

snapshot.en: Subject to revocation or suspension, a licence is valid for 2 years from the date of grant, or another period the Commissioner determines in a particular case.
snapshot.tc: 除被撤銷或暫時吊銷外，牌照自批給當日起計有效2年，或關長在特定個案中決定的其他期間。

snapshot.en: Subject to revocation or suspension, a renewed licence is valid for 2 years, or a longer period the Commissioner determines in a particular case.
snapshot.tc: 除被撤銷或暫時吊銷外，續期的牌照有效2年，或關長在特定個案中決定的較長期間。

snapshot.en: A licence must specify the name of the licensee's money laundering reporting officer and the period for which the licence is valid.
snapshot.tc: 牌照須指明持牌人所委任的洗錢報告主任的姓名，以及該牌照的有效期。

snapshot.en: Where the licensee is an individual, the licence ceases to be valid as soon as the individual is convicted of any offence under the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如屬個人，牌照在該名個人被裁定犯《打擊洗錢條例》所訂罪行時即不再有效。

snapshot.en: A licence ceases to be valid on the dissolution of a licensee that is a partnership, or on the commencement of the winding up of one that is a corporation.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如屬合夥，牌照在該合夥解散時即不再有效；如屬法團，則在該法團開始清盤時即不再有效。

source_quotes.text: Normally, the validity period of a licence granted will be 2 years.

topics.topic: 無牌經營及牌照豁免
covered_aspects: 無牌罪罰
主要豁免類型及附帶業務限制
豁免者不受理牌照申請

snapshot.en: On conviction on indictment for the offence, a person is liable to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for a term of 2 years.
snapshot.tc: 該罪行的犯罪者一經循公訴程序定罪，可處罰款$1,000,000及監禁2年。

snapshot.en: On summary conviction for the offence, a person is liable to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for a term of 1 year.
snapshot.tc: 任何人犯該罪行，一經循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁1年。

snapshot.en: An authorized institution, even where the money service it operates is part of its principal business
snapshot.tc: 認可機構，即使其經營的金錢服務屬其主要業務的一部分

snapshot.en: An authorized insurer, for a money service that is ancillary to the insurer's own principal business
snapshot.tc: 獲授權保險人，而其經營的金錢服務附屬於該保險人本身的主要業務

snapshot.en: A designated retail payment system's system operator, for a money service ancillary to its business as system operator
snapshot.tc: 指定零售支付系統的系統營運者，其金錢服務附屬於其作為系統營運者的業務

snapshot.en: A licensed money lender that operates a money service ancillary to the money lender's principal business
snapshot.tc: 經營金錢服務的持牌放債人，而該服務附屬於該放債人的主要業務

snapshot.en: A licensed corporation that operates a money service forming part of the corporation's principal business
snapshot.tc: 經營金錢服務的持牌法團，而該服務屬該法團的主要業務的一部分

evidence.covers: 豁免申請、儲值支付牌照

snapshot.en: The CCE will not accept an application for the grant or renewal of a licence from an applicant that has been exempted from the licensing requirements.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人本身獲豁免於發牌規定，關長將不會接納其提出的批給牌照或牌照續期申請。

snapshot.en: An SVF licensee, as the exemption uses the term, is a person granted a licence under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 豁免條文所指的工具持牌人，是根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》獲批給牌照的人。

source_quotes.text: CCE will not accept any application for grant or renewal of licence if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: B2採現行s.25，包括穩定幣及保險名稱；不是再教03舊名。詳細法定豁免覆蓋由AMLO組處理。

topics.topic: 適當人選、最終擁有人及發牌審核
covered_aspects: 每名董事／合夥人／最終擁有人
權益／投票／管理控制
違規、定罪、破產及清盤因素按個案衡量

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, each partner in the partnership must be a fit and proper person to operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥，該合夥的每名合夥人均須屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。

snapshot.en: If a corporate applicant has an ultimate owner, the ultimate owner must be fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 如就屬法團的申請人有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied that every director and every shareholder is fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的申請人而言，關長須信納其每名董事及每名股東均屬與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For an application to operate at particular premises, the Commissioner must be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 就要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請而言，關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。

snapshot.en: Once satisfied of every matter that the Ordinance requires, the Commissioner must grant the licence to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 關長一經信納條例規定的所有事宜均已符合，便必須向申請人批給牌照。

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person outside Hong Kong for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing
snapshot.tc: 該人在香港以外地方因關乎洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的罪行而被定罪

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person in Hong Kong for any offence that carries a possible sentence of imprisonment
snapshot.tc: 該人在香港因任何一項可判處監禁的刑事罪行而被裁定有罪

snapshot.en: A persistent failure by the person to comply with requirements imposed under the AMLO or regulations made by the Commissioner
snapshot.tc: 該人屢次不遵從根據《打擊洗錢條例》施加的要求或關長訂立的規例

snapshot.en: For an individual, any adjudication of bankruptcy under the Bankruptcy Ordinance at any time in the past
snapshot.tc: （就個人而言）該人曾在任何時候根據《破產條例》被判定破產

snapshot.en: For a corporation, being in liquidation or the subject of a winding up order, or having a receiver appointed in relation to it
snapshot.tc: （就法團而言）該人正在清盤、屬清盤令的標的，或已有接管人就其獲委任

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person for the offence under the AMLO of knowingly contravening a specified provision
snapshot.tc: 該人因《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的明知而違反指明的條文的罪行而被定罪

snapshot.en: A corporation that controls more than a 25% share of a partnership's capital or profits is, in relation to that partnership, its ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 控制某合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的法團，就該合夥而言屬其最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: Where a licensee who is an individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person is the licensee's ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 如屬個人的持牌人代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬該持牌人的最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: For an individual applicant or licensee, a second individual who ultimately owns or controls its money service business is an ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人或持牌人是個人，另一名最終擁有或控制其金錢服務業務的個人屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: If an individual applicant or licensee is acting on behalf of someone else, the ultimate owner is that someone else.
snapshot.tc: 如屬個人的申請人或持牌人是代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: In a partnership, an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the partnership is an ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 就屬合夥的申請人或持牌人而言，行使對該合夥的管理最終的控制權的個人屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: Each director of a corporate applicant or licensee is one of its ultimate owners by virtue of holding that office.
snapshot.tc: 屬法團的申請人或持牌人的每名董事，均因擔任董事職位而屬其最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: Like the licensee's partners and directors, an ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times.
snapshot.tc: 與持牌人的合夥人及董事一樣，與持牌人有關的最終擁有人在任何時間均必須是適當人選。

evidence.covers: 指引適用及非自動否決

snapshot.en: The F&P Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選指引》適用於每名牌照申請人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將會持有牌照的人士。

snapshot.en: One of the F&P Guideline's factors is whether a person has been convicted of a criminal offence other than those listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選指引》的因素包括某人是否曾被裁定犯了第30(4)(a)及(b)條所列以外的刑事罪行。

snapshot.en: The Supplementary F&P Guideline must be read in conjunction with the F&P Guideline for determining whether an applicant or a licensee is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選補充指引》須與《適當人選指引》一併閱讀，以決定申請人或持牌人是否適當人選。

snapshot.en: Under the Supplementary F&P Guideline, the CCE may still be satisfied that a person who fails to comply with one of its individual elements is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 根據《適當人選補充指引》，某人即使未有符合其中個別項目，關長仍可能信納其屬適當人選。

source_quotes.text: any other matter that the CCE considers relevant.
