topics.topic: 特定處所、共用處所及住宅限制
covered_aspects: 有／無特定處所、訪客例外
住宅整幢不適用／商住每名佔用人同意
出入口、招牌、不可與其他MSO共用及分隔

snapshot.en: Particular premises that are situated in a building that is wholly residential
snapshot.tc: 位於純住宅樓宇內、用以經營金錢服務的特定處所

snapshot.en: Premises declared by another applicant for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence
snapshot.tc: 另一名申請人已填報用以申請批給牌照或將牌照續期的特定處所

snapshot.en: Premises that cannot be entered without the permission of another business sharing them
snapshot.tc: 如未獲共用處所的其他業務准許便不能進入的特定處所

snapshot.en: Premises whose signboard name differs from the name on the Business Registration Certificate
snapshot.tc: 招牌所展示的業務名稱與商業登記證上的名稱並不相同的特定處所

snapshot.en: Premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, with every occupant's written consent
snapshot.tc: 位於混合式商住樓宇內並已取得每名佔用人書面同意的特定處所

snapshot.en: The particular premises that need to be registered are those in which the licensee operates a money changing service and/or a remittance service.
snapshot.tc: 需要登記的特定處所，是持牌人用以經營貨幣兌換服務及／或匯款服務的處所。

snapshot.en: Premises where the licensee is only a visitor or a customer, such as a dining establishment or a bank, are not treated as its particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人只是食肆或銀行等處所的訪客或顧客，有關處所不被視為其特定處所。

snapshot.en: Going to a customer's office to meet the customer there is not considered to be operating a money service at particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人前往顧客的辦事處與顧客會面，不被視為在特定處所經營金錢服務。

snapshot.en: Where another business is run on the same premises, the MSO's money service business must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from it.
snapshot.tc: 如有其他業務在同一處所內經營，金錢服務業務必須設有明顯分隔，與其他業務清楚區分。

snapshot.en: An MSO may share its premises with another MSO to operate money service business, provided that the two businesses are clearly partitioned.
snapshot.tc: 如業務設有明顯分隔，金錢服務經營者可與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所經營業務。

snapshot.en: where the premises are domestic premises, the applicant must secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for the purpose of exercising the powers as conferred by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615 (AMLO)
snapshot.tc: （如該處所屬住宅處所）申請人須確保取得該處所的每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人為行使第615 章《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（打擊洗錢條例）所授予的權力而進入該處所。

source_quotes.text: Sharing the premises with other MSO to operate money service business will not be accepted by the CCE.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 漏報的AMLO s.52由法例組審核；E13移動設備措辭不設雙語陷阱。

topics.topic: 本地管理辦事處的要求
covered_aspects: 無特定處所才須LMO
指定人員駐守、可到訪及電話聯繫、失責停牌撤牌
missing_aspects: LMO不可設於住宅或服務提供者地址
須取得業主同意，申請未提供LMO資料無效

evidence.covers: 適用人、駐守、聯絡及後果

snapshot.en: The licensees operating with or without particular premises must maintain a LMO
snapshot.tc: 無論持牌人會或不會在特定處所經營金錢服務，都須維持本地管理辦事處。

snapshot.en: LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處須駐有持牌人的合規主任、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。

snapshot.en: If an MSO licensee fails to maintain the LMO, it may result in the suspension and revocation of the MSO licence.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者持牌人未能維持本地管理辦事處，將可能會導致暫時吊銷及撤銷金錢服務經營者牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee operating without particular premises must ensure that its local management office can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，必須確保本地管理辦事處可作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。

source_quotes.text: residential address/premises of an MSO or the address/premises of its service provider
金錢服務經營者的住址／住宅處所或其服務供應商（如有的話）的地址／處所

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 以LMO與LPS及業務處所比較，補住宅／秘書公司地址不適用及業主同意。
topics.notes: m4-329測LPS同樣限制，不直接測LMO；兩者可合併一題避免近似重複。

topics.topic: 本地儲存地方的要求
covered_aspects: 所有申請人均須LPS
本港實體地點存全套紀錄、持牌人控制、供查閱
住宅／服務公司不可、業主同意、無效申請與停撤牌

snapshot.en: Every applicant is required to have an LPS, including an applicant that will operate its money service at particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 所有申請人均須有本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，包括擬在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人。

snapshot.en: The LPS is a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records of the licensee's money service transactions.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點是在香港用作儲存完整金錢服務交易帳目及紀錄的實體地點。

snapshot.en: The LPS must be under the licensee's control, so that C&ED officers have access to the books and records to perform their functions under the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點必須由持牌人控制，以便海關人員前往有關地點執行條例賦予的職能。

snapshot.en: The CCE will not accept an MSO's residential premises, or the premises of a service provider such as its accounting firm, as the MSO's LPS.
snapshot.tc: 關長不會接納金錢服務經營者的住宅處所，或其會計事務所等服務供應商的處所，作為其本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點。

snapshot.en: The landlord's permission to use the LPS for money service business should be included in its tenancy agreement or in a letter from the landlord to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 業主准許使用本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點經營金錢服務業務，有關准許應納入該地點的租約，或由業主向申請人發出准許信。

snapshot.en: A licence or renewal application that fails to submit the information of the LPS is deemed an invalid application, which C&ED will not process.
snapshot.tc: 牌照申請或續牌申請如未有就本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點提交資料，會視作無效申請，不獲海關處理。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee's LPS falls foul of the requirements set out in the Licensing Guide.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點未能符合《牌照指引》所載的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

source_quotes.text: all applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 合規主任、洗錢報告主任及商業登記
covered_aspects: CO與MLRO職責、指定身份以外須僱員
高層須通過評核
有效商業登記及發證機關
透過補充表格通知任命

snapshot.en: An applicant must appoint a competent CO as the focal point for overseeing its AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and an MLRO as the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 申請人須委任一名合資格的合規主任，作為監督其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度及合規措施的中心點，以及洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

snapshot.en: Where persons other than the sole proprietor, a partner, a director or an ultimate owner act as CO and MLRO, they must be the applicant's employees under the Employees' Compensation Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 如由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人以外的人擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，他們必須為根據《僱員補償條例》所界定受聘於申請人的僱員。

snapshot.en: The sole proprietor, or any one of the partners and directors, of an applicant or licensee must pass the Competence Assessment conducted by C&ED; the Guidance Notes on it give further details.
snapshot.tc: 申請人或持牌人的獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在由海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，詳情可參閱《金錢服務經營者適用的能力評核須知》。

snapshot.en: Any person carrying on business in Hong Kong must register it, and an applicant must hold a valid Business Registration Certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies before C&ED processes its application.
snapshot.tc: 任何在香港經營業務的人須登記其業務，而申請人必須持有由公司註冊處處長發出的有效商業登記證，海關才會處理其牌照申請。

snapshot.en: Applicants and licensees alike must have a valid Business Registration Certificate, and a licensee that does not have one is liable to have its licence suspended or revoked by the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 申請人及持牌人均須持有有效商業登記證；如已批給牌照的持牌人沒有有效商業登記證，關長仍可暫時吊銷及／或撤銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。

source_quotes.text: the CO and MLRO must be the applicant’s employee

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 申請、續期文件及面見程序
covered_aspects: 表格1／2、計劃政策、複本及面見正本
有權出席者、見證F&P聲明、原件核實
45日前續期、90日提醒、漏文件無效及屆滿停業

snapshot.en: Besides completing Form 1, the supplementary information sheet and the relevant annex, the applicant submits a Business Plan and its AML Policy.
snapshot.tc: 申請人除填寫申請書（表格1）、補充資料表格及相關附件外，亦須遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。

snapshot.en: The form, the supplementary information sheet and the annex may be completed in either English or Chinese, or in both if the case requires.
snapshot.tc: 申請人可用英文或中文填寫申請書、補充資料表格及附件，或在有需要時中英並用填寫。

snapshot.en: Together with the completed form, supplementary information sheet and annex, the applicant must submit to C&ED the originals of the requisite documents.
snapshot.tc: 填妥的申請書、補充資料表格及附件，必須連同所需文件的正本，一併遞交至香港海關辦理。

snapshot.en: The completed application, with photocopies of the requisite documents, must be lodged by the applicant in person at the Money Service Supervision Bureau of C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 填妥的申請文件連同所需文件的複本，必須由申請人親自遞交至香港海關金錢服務監理科。

snapshot.en: The application form and the submission guidelines for the Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau or C&ED's website.
snapshot.tc: 申請表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引，可在金錢服務監理科索取，或從海關網站下載。

snapshot.en: On receipt of a licence application, the applicant is given an acknowledgment receipt, and a reminder for any outstanding documents is issued where necessary.
snapshot.tc: 海關收到牌照申請書後，會向申請人發出確認收到申請書通知，並在有需要時發信催交尚欠文件。

snapshot.en: Together with the notice for an interview, the applicant receives an invitation letter for nominating its sole proprietor, partners or directors to attend the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 申請人收到會面通知時，亦會收到信件邀請提名其獨資經營者、合夥人或董事應考能力評核。

snapshot.en: At the interview the original documents are verified, and the applicant is required to sign the application for an MSO licence in the presence of a Justice of the Peace.
snapshot.tc: 在會面時，海關人員會查驗文件的正本，而申請人須於太平紳士面前在金錢服務經營者牌照申請書上簽署。

snapshot.en: The applicant is briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements applicable to MSOs, so that it can fully understand and fulfil a licensee's obligations.
snapshot.tc: 人員會向申請人簡介金錢服務經營者適用的法定發牌及合規規定，確保其全面了解及符合持牌人的規定。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, a staff member of the applicant may attend the interview if any one of the partners has authorized the staff member in writing.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥業務，申請人的員工如已獲任何一名合夥人以書面授權，即可代表申請人出席會面。

snapshot.en: The processing time may vary with factors including on-site inspection at the business premises and obtaining records from other authorities for the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 處理時間的長短，視乎在業務處所進行實地視察、為判定適當人選向其他機構索取紀錄所需的時間等因素。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a corporation, each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation is required to apply for the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬法團，則法團的每名董事以及每名最終擁有人，均須申請進行適當人選判定。

snapshot.en: An individual completes Form 3A with Appendices I and II and a corporation completes Form 3B, and the form is submitted to C&ED with supporting documents.
snapshot.tc: 個人須填寫表格3A連同附錄I及II，法團則須填寫表格3B，並須將表格連同證明文件呈交海關。

snapshot.en: Appendix I to Form 3A must be signed before a witness who is an authorized officer of C&ED, a practising professional, a notary public or a Justice of the Peace.
snapshot.tc: 表格3A的附錄I須在見證人在場下簽署，見證人包括海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士、公證人或太平紳士。

snapshot.en: The witness must check the particulars stated in Appendix I against the original, or a certified copy, of the declarant's identity documents.
snapshot.tc: 見證人須將附錄I內載列的個人資料，與聲明人的身份證明文件的正本或核證副本互相核對。

snapshot.en: The CCE's checks on a declaration form include vetting the details against information held by C&ED and by other government and law enforcement agencies.
snapshot.tc: 關長就適當人選聲明表格進行的查驗，包括將資料與海關、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。

snapshot.en: The fee paid for the fit and proper person test is non-refundable, so it is not returned to the applicant even if the CCE later refuses the licence.
snapshot.tc: 為判定適當人選而繳交的費用屬不可退還，即使關長其後拒絕批給牌照，費用亦不會退回。

snapshot.en: C&ED sends each licensee a reminder 90 days before expiry, but it is the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry.
snapshot.tc: 海關會在牌照屆滿前90日向持牌人發出提示通知，但持牌人有法定責任在屆滿前45日申請續期。

snapshot.en: For a renewal at particular premises, at least four 4R-size photographs of the premises should be attached to the application form.
snapshot.tc: 如屬在特定處所經營金錢服務的續牌申請，申請書應夾附最少四張4R尺寸的處所照片。

snapshot.en: Once all the requisite documents for a renewal are found to be in order, the CCE issues the licensee with a notice for an interview.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人遞交的續牌所需文件全部確認符合要求後，關長會向持牌人發出會面通知。

snapshot.en: A renewal application is deemed invalid if, after C&ED's reminder for outstanding documents, the licensee fails to produce them all within the specified period.
snapshot.tc: 如海關已發信催交尚欠文件，但持牌人未能在指明期限內遞交所有證明文件，續牌申請將被視作無效。

snapshot.en: Where an invalid renewal application cannot be processed, the licence lapses automatically when its validity period expires and the licensee must cease operating.
snapshot.tc: 續牌申請如屬無效而未能處理，現有牌照會於有效期屆滿後自動失效，持牌人亦必須停止經營金錢服務。

source_quotes.text: the licensee’s legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry of the licence.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: B5/B6/B7：必要時才提名；每次測試費；法律隨申請繳費與實務繳款通知並存。

topics.topic: 拒批、暫停撤銷及覆核權
covered_aspects: 不完整申請、CO/MLRO及評核失敗
不營業、無LPS/LMO、未交報表等理由
陳詞機會及21日覆核

snapshot.en: The applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED
snapshot.tc: 申請人未能根據海關頒布的相關指引提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策

snapshot.en: The applicant appoints one person to act both as its Compliance Officer and as its Money Laundering Reporting Officer
snapshot.tc: 申請人委任同一人同時擔任其合規主任及其洗錢報告主任

snapshot.en: The applicant fails to appoint a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer
snapshot.tc: 申請人未能為其業務委任合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任

snapshot.en: The applicant's Business Plan projects that its money service business will make a loss in its first year
snapshot.tc: 申請人的業務計劃預計其金錢服務業務在首年會出現虧損

snapshot.en: The application for the grant of a licence that the applicant submits to C&ED is incomplete or invalid
snapshot.tc: 申請人就批給牌照向海關遞交的申請並不完整或屬無效

snapshot.en: Any one member of the applicant's senior management fails the Competence Assessment designated by C&ED
snapshot.tc: 申請人的高級管理層中任何一名成員在海關指定的能力評核中失敗

snapshot.en: The circumstances the Guide lists in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence are examples only, and the list is not exhaustive.
snapshot.tc: 《牌照指引》所列關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的情況只屬例子，並非詳盡無遺。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence whose holding fails to fulfil its purpose of providing a money service, for example where the licensee has never provided one.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人持有牌照而未能符合提供金錢服務的發牌目的，例如從未提供金錢服務，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee's LPS falls foul of the requirements set out in the Licensing Guide.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點未能符合《牌照指引》所載的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee's failure to appoint, or to maintain, a competent Compliance Officer or MLRO is one of the examples given for revocation or suspension.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人未能委任或維持具備合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任，是可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的例子之一。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee fails to comply with any requirement under the AMLO, including those in Part 5.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人未能遵從條例所訂的任何規定，包括條例第5部訂明的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee's failure to submit a periodic return on time is another of the examples in which the CCE may revoke or suspend its licence.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人未能按時遞交定期申報表，亦屬關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照的例子之一。

snapshot.en: Before deciding to revoke the licence, the Commissioner had to give the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
snapshot.tc: 關長須先給予該持牌人合理的陳詞機會，方可作出撤銷其牌照的決定。

snapshot.en: The revocation takes effect when the licensee receives the notice, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later.
snapshot.tc: 該項撤銷在持牌人接獲通知時或在通知指明的時間（兩者以較遲者為準）生效。

snapshot.en: The decision to revoke the licence is a specified decision, which the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal to review.
snapshot.tc: 撤銷牌照的決定屬指明決定，該持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。

snapshot.en: Applying for a review does not by itself stay the revocation, but the licensee may apply to the Tribunal for a stay before the review is determined.
snapshot.tc: 提出覆核申請本身不具暫緩執行撤銷決定的效力，但持牌人可在覆核裁定前向審裁處申請暫緩執行。

snapshot.en: If the licensee applies for a stay, the Tribunal must conduct a hearing to determine that application as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如申請暫緩執行，審裁處須在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快進行聆訊，以裁定該申請。

snapshot.en: A person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person may apply for a review within the period ending 21 days after the notice of it is sent.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可在告知該決定的通知送出後的21日期間申請覆核。

snapshot.en: The specified authority that made the decision may by order extend the time within which an application for review may be made.
snapshot.tc: 作出該指明決定的指明當局，可藉命令延展有關的人向審裁處提出覆核申請的限期。

snapshot.en: An application for review must be made in writing and must state the grounds on which the person makes the application.
snapshot.tc: 向審裁處提出的覆核申請，須藉書面提出，並須述明該申請所據的理由。

source_quotes.text: give the licensee an opportunity to be heard before revoking or suspending the licence.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: B8寬廣指引理由須經適當人選準則連結，並非擴寫法定權力。

topics.topic: 變更需預先批准、事後通知及停止業務
covered_aspects: 董事／最終擁有人／合夥人／增加處所先批准
表格4/5/6/7及一個月通知
轉法律實體重申請、轉有無處所程序
停業前通知、7日交還牌照、無退款

snapshot.en: A licensee licensed at specified premises must not operate at other premises unless the Commissioner has, on its application, added them to the licence.
snapshot.tc: 獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人，除非關長已應其申請將新處所加入牌照上，否則不得在新處所經營。

snapshot.en: A licensee not required by its licence to operate at particular premises must not operate at any particular premises until the Commissioner adds them to the licence.
snapshot.tc: 如牌照並無規定持牌人在特定處所經營，持牌人須待關長將特定處所加入牌照上，方可在該處所經營。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner may grant an application to add premises on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3 and may impose any condition the Commissioner thinks fit.
snapshot.tc: 關長可在附表3指明的費用獲繳付後批准加入處所的申請，並可施加任何其認為合適的條件。

snapshot.en: Operating at premises not added to the licence, without reasonable excuse, is an offence punishable on conviction by a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months.
snapshot.tc: 在未加入牌照的處所經營而無合理辯解，即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

snapshot.en: A person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing.
snapshot.tc: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請而給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner may approve a proposed director only if satisfied that the person is fit and proper to be associated with the licensee's money service business.
snapshot.tc: 關長須信納擬任董事屬與經營持牌人金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，方可給予批准。

snapshot.en: In judging whether a proposed partner is fit and proper, the Commissioner must have regard, among other relevant matters, to the matters listed for the grant of a licence.
snapshot.tc: 關長在斷定擬成為合夥人的人是否適當人選時，除其他有關事宜外，亦須考慮批給牌照時須顧及的事宜。

snapshot.en: A person who, without reasonable excuse, becomes a partner of a licensee without the Commissioner's approval is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
snapshot.tc: 任何人無合理辯解而在未獲關長批准下成為持牌人的合夥人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

snapshot.en: The approval must be applied for by the licensee, in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies, and the application must be accompanied by the Schedule 3 fee.
snapshot.tc: 批准須由持牌人申請，申請須採用關長指明的格式及方式，並須附隨附表3指明的費用。

snapshot.en: A change in the bank account used for operating the money service business must be notified to the CCE on the Notification of Change in Particulars (Form 6).
snapshot.tc: 用以經營金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶有改變，須填寫表格6（具報詳情改變）向關長具報。

snapshot.en: A licensee that changes its legal entity may carry on under its existing licence by notifying the change to the CCE on Form 6.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如改變法律實體，可以表格6向關長具報有關改變，並繼續沿用現有牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee changing from money changing to remittance service must file a written submission with the CCE, including an updated Business Plan and AML Policy.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人由貨幣兌換改為匯款服務，須向關長遞交書面陳詞，包括經修訂的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。

snapshot.en: The offence of failing to notify a change in particulars carries, on conviction, a fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months.
snapshot.tc: 違反具報詳情改變規定的罪行，一經定罪，可被判港幣5萬元罰款及監禁6個月。

snapshot.en: Some changes in particulars, such as a change in the fit and proper status of a director, may result in a review of the validity of the licence.
snapshot.tc: 若干詳情的改變，例如董事的適當人選身分有改變，或會引致牌照被檢視是否仍有效。

snapshot.en: A licensee wishing to switch from particular premises to operating without them must notify the CCE of the cessation of its business and apply for a new licence.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如由在特定處所經營改為在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，須具報停業並提出新的牌照申請。

snapshot.en: Where its business ends with the expiry of its licence, a licensee must still notify the CCE on Form 7 before the date of expiry.
snapshot.tc: 如業務隨牌照有效期屆滿而終止，持牌人仍須在屆滿日期前填寫表格7向關長具報。

snapshot.en: A licensee that stops operating at one of its specified premises must apply in Form 5 to have those premises removed from its licence.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如停止在其中一個指明處所經營，須填寫表格5申請將該處所從牌照上刪除。

snapshot.en: A licensee that cancels its licence within its validity period is refunded the part of the fees that covers the unexpired period.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如在牌照生效期間取消牌照，可獲退還已繳費用中涵蓋餘下有效期的部分。

snapshot.en: Contravening the duty to notify the CCE of a cessation, without reasonable excuse, is an offence and will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned.
snapshot.tc: 無合理辯解而違反具報停業的規定即屬犯罪，而此等違例行為會對有關個人是否屬適當人選造成負面影響。

snapshot.en: Where a person proposes to become a partner, the licensee must apply in Form 4 and that person must submit a fit and proper person declaration form.
snapshot.tc: 如有人擬成為合夥人，持牌人須填寫表格4提出申請，而擬成為合夥人的人則須遞交適當人選聲明表格。

snapshot.en: To begin operating at particular premises, a licensee that has none must apply in Form 5 and must also submit a Business Plan and updated AML Policy.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如由在沒有特定處所的情況下經營改為在特定處所經營，須遞交表格5、業務計劃及經修訂的打擊洗錢政策。

snapshot.en: An application to add new business premises carries a fee of HK$945 for each new business premises to be added to the licence.
snapshot.tc: 申請要求加入新的業務處所時，須就每一新的業務處所繳付港幣945元的費用。

snapshot.en: To add premises at which to operate a money service, a licensee must notify the CCE of the change in business premises information on Form 6.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如要加入新處所經營金錢服務，須以表格6向關長具報業務處所資料有改變。

snapshot.en: Within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation, the licensee must return its licence to the Commissioner for cancellation or amendment.
snapshot.tc: 由停業日期起計的7日內，持牌人須把牌照交回關長，供關長取消或修訂。

snapshot.en: A licensee that ceases to operate at only one of the premises specified in its licence must return the licence to the Commissioner for amendment.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如只停止在牌照指明的其中一個處所經營，亦須將牌照交回關長以作修訂。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner must cancel or amend a returned licence, and delete the relevant particulars from the register, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving it.
snapshot.tc: 收到交回的牌照後，關長須在合理地切實可行範圍內盡快把牌照取消或修訂，並把有關詳情從登記冊刪除。

source_quotes.text: within one month beginning on the date on which such change takes place.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 法定罪罰的細分由AMLO來源組另作審核；本列聚焦實務變更程序及時限。

topics.topic: 持牌人的持續義務及定期申報
covered_aspects: 申報可疑交易、維持有效政策及適當人選
展示正本牌照、維持LPS/LMO
定期申報及通知CO/MLRO任命

snapshot.en: A licensee must comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and the guidelines issued by the CCE, and must report on suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人務必遵從條例的所有適用條文及關長發出的指引，並必須報告可疑交易。

snapshot.en: A licensee must develop an AML Policy that is effective in mitigating ML/TF risks, and must also maintain that policy.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人必須制訂有效的打擊洗錢政策以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並維持該政策。

snapshot.en: A licensee operating without particular premises must ensure that its local management office can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，必須確保本地管理辦事處可作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。

snapshot.en: A licensee must submit its periodic return to the CCE in a timely manner, and must use the form that the CCE specifies for it.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人必須按時向關長遞交定期申報表，而申報表須採用關長指明的格式。

snapshot.en: A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。

snapshot.en: A licensee must lodge its periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year, unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在每半年開始後的兩星期內遞交定期申報表，除非關長透過通知書另作指定。

snapshot.en: Returns are lodged twice a year, not quarterly, and the first return of each year covers the transactions from 1 January to 30 June.
snapshot.tc: 定期申報表每年遞交兩次而非每季遞交，每年第一次涵蓋1月1日至6月30日的交易資料。

snapshot.en: New periodic returns must be submitted through the MSOS, and C&ED no longer accepts periodic returns submitted in paper form.
snapshot.tc: 新定期申報表須經牌照系統遞交，海關亦不再接受以紙本形式遞交的定期申報表。

snapshot.en: Licensees must give further information in the new return, including the jurisdictions involved in, and the delivery channels used for, remittances.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在新定期申報表提供額外資料，包括匯款交易所涉司法管轄區及匯款交易使用的交付渠道。

snapshot.en: Licensees were required to lodge their first new return, covering transactions from 1 January to 30 June 2025, beginning from 1 July 2025.
snapshot.tc: 第一份新定期申報表涵蓋2025年1月1日至6月30日的交易，須在2025年7月1日起遞交。

snapshot.en: The licensee must display the original or the copy of the licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在指明的處所內的一處顯眼地方，展示該牌照的正本或複本。

source_quotes.text: A licensee must submit periodic return to the CCE

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 16通函附件的申報欄位缺口由通函組負責，不重複計入。

topics.topic: 經營用銀行帳戶允許的戶名
covered_aspects: 禁止使用第三方銀行戶口、無銀行帳戶需詳述經營方式
missing_aspects: 戶名可為持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人，並非只能公司名

snapshot.en: A third party's bank account may be used for the business, provided that the plan gives that account's number and the name of its owner.
snapshot.tc: 如業務計劃已提供帳戶號碼及戶口擁有人的資料，申請人的業務可使用第三方的銀行戶口經營。

snapshot.en: An applicant that intends to operate a money service without using a bank account is required to provide details of how its money service business is operated in that circumstance.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人擬不使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務，便須就如何在此情況下經營金錢服務業務提供相關細節。

source_quotes.text: the bank account must be in the name of the licensee’s company, the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee.
該銀行帳戶必須屬持牌人公司、持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人名下。

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 對比准許的負責人名下帳戶與不准的其他第三方；避免把「不得第三方」誤解為「只准公司戶」。
topics.notes: 03與06 item8（不得第三方銀行戶口）須清楚區分。本次未找到兩者關係的既有決策號；建議新題明確限定03所列許可戶名，不自行把06的「第三方」擴張為一概禁止負責人戶口。若要跨文件統一解釋，須先記錄此待釐清點。

topics.topic: 公眾登記冊、紀律處分及費用表
covered_aspects: 登記冊處所／通訊地址及公眾查閱
兩套處分：100萬與1000萬或利潤三倍
新牌／續牌／測試／負責人變更／處所費

snapshot.en: For a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the address of every premises at which it may operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有其可經營金錢服務的每一個處所的地址。

snapshot.en: For a licensee not licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the correspondence address of the licensee instead.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人並非獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有該持牌人的通訊地址。

snapshot.en: Members of the public may inspect the register during normal office hours on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3.
snapshot.tc: 公眾人士須繳付附表3指明的費用，方可在通常辦公時間內查閱登記冊。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner may order the licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding $1,000,000.
snapshot.tc: 關長可根據《打擊洗錢條例》命令持牌人繳付不多於$1,000,000的罰款。

snapshot.en: A licensee who fails to take ordered remedial action may be ordered to pay up to $10,000 for each day the failure continues.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人沒有遵從採取糾正行動的命令，關長可命令其繳付不超逾$10,000的按日罰款。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner may take the action before giving the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
snapshot.tc: 關長可在給予持牌人合理的陳詞機會之前，先就該持牌人行使紀律行動權力。

snapshot.en: A pecuniary penalty of up to $10,000,000 may be ordered or, if it is greater, up to 3 times the profit the institution gained or the costs it avoided through the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 罰款以$10,000,000與該機構因違反而獲取的利潤或避免的開支的3倍兩者中的較大者為上限。

snapshot.en: If the institution fails to comply with an order to take remedial action, it may further be ordered to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000.
snapshot.tc: 該機構如沒有遵從飭令採取糾正行動的命令，有關當局可進一步命令其繳付不超逾$100,000的按日罰款。

snapshot.en: An application for the grant of a licence carries a fee of $3,810, with $2,440 added for each additional business premises.
snapshot.tc: 申請批給牌照的費用為$3,810，並須就每多一個營業處所另加$2,440。

snapshot.en: A renewal application carries the same basic fee as a grant application, $3,810, plus $410 for each additional business premises.
snapshot.tc: 申請牌照續期的基本費用與批給牌照相同，為$3,810，每多一個營業處所另加$410。

snapshot.en: An application for the grant of a licence also carries $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 申請批給牌照時，亦須就每一個須判定是否適當人選的人另加$945。

snapshot.en: An application for approval to become a licensee's director carries a fee of $945 for each application that is made.
snapshot.tc: 申請要求批准擔任持牌人董事的費用，為每宗提出的申請$945。

snapshot.en: For each person in relation to whom approval to become a licensee's ultimate owner or partner is sought, the fee is $945.
snapshot.tc: 就申請批准擔任持牌人最終擁有人或合夥人而言，申請所關乎的每一人須繳費$945。

snapshot.en: An uncertified copy of an entry in the register of licensees costs $160 per copy, the same as a certified copy.
snapshot.tc: 提供登記冊內記項的未經核證複本，費用為每份$160，與核證複本相同。

snapshot.en: An application to add new business premises carries a fee of HK$945 for each new business premises to be added to the licence.
snapshot.tc: 申請要求加入新的業務處所時，須就每一新的業務處所繳付港幣945元的費用。

source_quotes.text: publicly reprimand the licensee;

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 頁面費用表文字抽取錯位，以Sch.3與既有決策B6核對；網頁／實體查冊地點屬操作參考。

topics.topic: 牌照支持文件清單
covered_aspects: 處所租約、平面圖、業主與佔用人信、LMO商登
個人董事身份／F&P表格、最近年報
第三方合約、CO/MLRO住址期、銀行確認、授權信
missing_aspects: 本地與非香港公司／未在香港註冊法團的不同支持文件
業務計劃及政策須由指定相關人確認認可
CO/MLRO有效僱傭合約

snapshot.en: For each premises used for operating a money service, a copy of the stamped tenancy agreement or record of ownership and a floor plan are required.
snapshot.tc: 每一個用作經營金錢服務的處所，均須遞交該處所的已加蓋釐印租約或業權紀錄的複本及平面圖。

snapshot.en: Copies of consent letters from every occupant of the premises are required for each of the premises that the applicant uses for operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 每一個用作經營金錢服務的處所，均須遞交由處所內每一名佔用人發出的同意書的複本。

snapshot.en: The documents for a local management office include a copy of a valid Business Registration Certificate, which the LPS documents do not include.
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處須遞交的文件包括有效商業登記證的複本，本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點的文件則不包括這一項。

snapshot.en: For premises used for operating a money service, a copy of the landlord's letter permitting the premises to be used for money service business is required.
snapshot.tc: 用作經營金錢服務的處所，須遞交由業主發出容許將該處所用作經營金錢服務的同意書複本。

snapshot.en: The supporting documents are stamped with the applicant's company chop and submitted with the completed Form 1 or 2, annex and supplementary information sheet.
snapshot.tc: 證明文件須蓋上申請人的公司印章，並連同已填妥的表格1或2、附件及補充資料表格一併遞交。

snapshot.en: The list is not exhaustive, and C&ED may require other supporting documents to determine the applicant's fitness and propriety and the suitability of the premises.
snapshot.tc: 所列文件並非詳盡無遺，海關可要求申請人出示其他證明文件，以斷定申請人是否屬適當人選及處所是否適合。

snapshot.en: For each individual director who is not a Hong Kong resident, a completed Form 3A with Appendices I and II and a copy of the bio-data page of the travel document
snapshot.tc: 每名非香港居民個人董事已填妥的表格3A（連同附錄I及II）及其旅遊證件的個人資料頁的複本

snapshot.en: For the CO and the MLRO, a copy of residential address proof, such as a utility bill or a bank statement, issued within the last six months from the application date

snapshot.en: A copy of the authorization letter signed by all partners where the applicant is a partnership, or by the board of directors where it is a corporation

snapshot.en: The F&P Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選指引》適用於每名牌照申請人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將會持有牌照的人士。

snapshot.en: The Supplementary F&P Guideline must be read in conjunction with the F&P Guideline for determining whether an applicant or a licensee is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選補充指引》須與《適當人選指引》一併閱讀，以決定申請人或持牌人是否適當人選。

snapshot.en: Under the Supplementary F&P Guideline, the CCE may still be satisfied that a person who fails to comply with one of its individual elements is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 根據《適當人選補充指引》，某人即使未有符合其中個別項目，關長仍可能信納其屬適當人選。

snapshot.en: Each of the two guidelines describes itself as binding on applicants for a licence and on licensees, rather than as advisory.
snapshot.tc: 兩份指引均各自表明，其本身是一份對金錢服務經營者牌照申請人及持牌人具約束力的文件。

snapshot.en: Each of the two guidelines will be kept under review and may be revised or updated from time to time as considered appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 當局會持續檢討《適當人選指引》及《適當人選補充指引》的內容，並按情況不時作出修訂或更新。

topics.topic: 誠信、經營能力與監管紀錄
covered_aspects: 遵規、條件、刑事／紀律程序與調查
合理善意投訴、真實經營意向、能力與內控
誠實資料、組織、人事、其他業務風險
未結案控罪、撤銷董事資格及專業處分

snapshot.en: Whether the person is the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or anywhere else
snapshot.tc: 該人是否在香港或其他地方於尚未結案的刑事檢控中屬於被告

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction from being a director
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格

snapshot.en: Whether the licensee has been the subject of any complaint relating to its conduct of carrying on the business
snapshot.tc: 持牌人經營業務的行為是否曾遭任何人提出任何投訴

snapshot.en: Whether the person has genuine intention and readiness to carry on the money service business proposed in its application
snapshot.tc: 該人是否具備真正意向並已準備就緒經營申請牌照時擬議的業務

snapshot.en: Whether the person has failed to comply with any conditions imposed by the CCE on the licence
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾不遵從關長在其牌照上施加的任何條件

snapshot.en: Whether the person has any record of non-compliance with the AMLO or relevant regulation that resulted in administrative action, prosecution, a written warning or discipline by the CCE
snapshot.tc: 該人是否有任何不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或相關規例的紀錄，以致關長採取行政制裁行動、檢控、發出警告信或作出紀律處分

snapshot.en: Whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for money service operators in the regulatory regime, such as the Licensing Guide and the AML/CFT Guideline
snapshot.tc: 該人是否遵從在監管制度下為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引，例如《牌照指引》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been the subject of any criminal or disciplinary proceedings, or notified of any potential proceedings or any investigation which might lead to those proceedings, under any law in any jurisdiction
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾面對任何刑事或紀律程序，或曾否獲告知有任何擬執行的程序或調查，而有關調查可能引致在任何司法管轄區根據任何法例執行該等程序

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been untruthful, or omitted material information to the CCE, or has been uncooperative with the C&ED in the performance of a function under the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾不誠實或遺漏要項資料而未有向關長提供，或在海關根據《打擊洗錢條例》執行職能時對海關採取不合作態度

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been refused or restricted from the right to carry on any trade, business or profession for which a specific licence, registration or other authorization is required by law in Hong Kong or elsewhere
snapshot.tc: 該人是否被拒絕或限制享有權利，以進行根據香港或其他地方的法律規定須獲發指定牌照、註冊或其他認可方可進行的行業、業務或專業

evidence.covers: 能力／治理／監管／其他業務

snapshot.en: On whether effective AML/CFT systems are established, the example is that the person must have a competent MLRO of sufficient seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee them.
snapshot.tc: 所舉有效打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的例子，是該人必須在持牌人內有具一定資歷及權力的合資格洗錢報告主任監督。

snapshot.en: In assessing the person's skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism for the business's functions, the person is generally expected to display an understanding of the statutory and regulatory requirements that apply.
snapshot.tc: 在評核該人是否具備所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業意識時，該人一般需要展示明白業務適用的法定及監管規定。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether a regulatory authority or professional body, in Hong Kong or elsewhere, has censured, disciplined or publicly criticized the person.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人曾否遭受任何監管機構或專業團體（不論在香港或其他地方）譴責、紀律處分或公開批評。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether the person has put in place the infrastructure and internal control systems necessary to eliminate risk, avoid conflicts of interest and leave a proper audit trail.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人是否設有所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，藉以消除風險、避免利益衝突，並留存適當的審計線索。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is the state of affairs of any other business the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship with, such as one exposing it to potential money laundering risk.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人正經營、擬經營或有任何業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況，例如有其他業務使該人面對潛在的洗錢風險。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether the person has established an organizational structure and staffing that meet the legislative or regulatory requirements relevant to it.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人有否確立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構，並配備符合規定的人事安排。

snapshot.en: One of the F&P Guideline's factors is whether a person has been convicted of a criminal offence other than those listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選指引》的因素包括某人是否曾被裁定犯了第30(4)(a)及(b)條所列以外的刑事罪行。

snapshot.en: The source of the applicant's capital, and whether the applicant is associated with or controlled by any entities or group company
snapshot.tc: 申請人的資金來源，以及申請人是否與任何實體或集團公司有聯繫或受其控制

snapshot.en: The expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital
snapshot.tc: 未來兩年每類產品及服務的預計利潤幅度和營業額，以及業務日常運作的營運資本

snapshot.en: A written confirmation that it is well aware of, and will comply with, the duty to notify a change in particulars within one month
snapshot.tc: 書面確認全然知悉並會遵從須在詳情改變後一個月內藉書面向關長具報的法定規定

snapshot.en: The plan should give the company name, business name, website address, business logo and trademark that will be used to promote the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應就將用作推廣金錢服務業務的公司名稱、業務名稱、網址、業務標誌及商標提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should give the nationality, employment history, qualification and education level of each and every member of the applicant's staff.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應就申請人旗下每一名職員的國籍、曾任職位、資歷及教育水平分別提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should state where senior management is located, being the place of key business decisions, and the purpose and whereabouts of any back-end office in or outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應述明作出重要業務決策的高級管理層所在位置，以及香港或香港以外任何後勤辦事處的職能及位置。

snapshot.en: On its customers, the plan should give the geographical location and nationality of its potential and expected customers and its mode of contacting them.
snapshot.tc: 就客戶而言，業務計劃應就準客戶及預期客戶的地理位置及國籍，以及聯絡客戶的方式等提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should elaborate the business operation to take place in Hong Kong, detailing the entire transaction process, and the reason for obtaining a licence locally.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應詳述將在香港進行的業務運作（須詳載完整的交易過程）及在本地領取牌照的理由。

snapshot.en: A third party's bank account may be used for the business, provided that the plan gives that account's number and the name of its owner.
snapshot.tc: 如業務計劃已提供帳戶號碼及戶口擁有人的資料，申請人的業務可使用第三方的銀行戶口經營。

snapshot.en: An applicant that intends to operate a money service without using a bank account is required to provide details of how its money service business is operated in that circumstance.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人擬不使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務，便須就如何在此情況下經營金錢服務業務提供相關細節。

evidence.covers: 集團／共享／外判／系統／監管

snapshot.en: The plan should attach an organizational chart of the applicant's group of companies in Hong Kong, with a brief description of each entity in the group and the business it carries out.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃需夾附申請人在香港的公司集團的組織圖，並概述集團內每個實體的資料及經營的業務。

snapshot.en: If its business premises are shared by other businesses, the applicant should elaborate whether those businesses are also owned by the applicant or its director, partner or staff.
snapshot.tc: 如營業處所與其他業務共用，申請人應闡述該等其他業務是否同樣由申請人或其董事、合夥人或員工擁有。

snapshot.en: For AML/CFT purposes, any outsourced service the applicant uses, e.g. an external audit function or a specified intermediary, should be named in the plan together with its nature.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應列出申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而外判的任何服務的名稱，例如外部審核職能或指明的中介人，並說明其性質。

snapshot.en: The plan should elaborate the computerized and other automation systems used in the business, for example naming the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solution and sanction screening.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應闡述用於業務的電腦系統及其他自動化系統，例如自動化打擊洗錢方案及篩查制裁名單的商業服務或數據庫提供者的名稱。

snapshot.en: If the applicant's local business, or the international group it belongs to, holds a licence granted by another regulator or competent authority, the plan should name that body.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人的本地業務或其所屬的國際公司集團持有其他監管機構／主管當局批給的牌照，業務計劃需提供有關名稱。

topics.topic: AML政策的自我風險評估及配合業務
covered_aspects: 政策以本身風險評估與業務特性為本
合理保障、有效程序及合規主任／報告主任
清單非盡列

snapshot.en: The items tabulated are by no means exhaustive, and the applicant must consider other important issues peculiar to its business model.
snapshot.tc: 所列項目並非詳盡無遺，申請人必須顧及本身業務模式獨有的其他重要事項。

snapshot.en: The MSO should use an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework, whose complexity should be proportionate to the nature and size of its business.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採用風險為本的方法制訂客戶風險評估框架，而框架的複雜程度應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。

snapshot.en: The results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should form the basis on which the framework is designed.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應以其機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果為依據，制訂客戶風險評估框架。

snapshot.en: In general, the framework will include customer, country, and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，框架會包含客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素。

snapshot.en: The MSO should keep the records so that it can demonstrate to the JFIU how it assesses a customer's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 有關紀錄應讓金錢服務經營者能夠向聯合財富情報組證明它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring for a customer is appropriate to the customer's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 有關紀錄應能證明，基於個別客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。

snapshot.en: Compliance management arrangements should include, as a minimum, senior management oversight and the appointment of both a CO and an MLRO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排最低限度應涵蓋高級管理層的監督，以及合規主任和洗錢報告主任各一名的委任。

snapshot.en: An applicant must appoint a competent CO as the focal point for overseeing its AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and an MLRO as the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 申請人須委任一名合資格的合規主任，作為監督其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度及合規措施的中心點，以及洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

evidence.covers: 風險相稱及高層批准制度

snapshot.en: An MSO should have AML/CFT Systems that its senior management has approved and that enable the MSO to manage and mitigate effectively the risks relevant to it.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應設有經其高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，使其能有效管理及減低與其相關的風險。

snapshot.en: As well as having AML/CFT Systems approved by senior management and monitoring their implementation, an MSO should take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate the risks where higher risks are identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者除應備有經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度並監察其推行情況外，亦應在識別出較高風險時採取更嚴格的措施，以管理和減低風險。

evidence.covers: 政策列明合资格CO/MLRO与报告线

snapshot.en: The policy's introduction should state that a qualified CO and MLRO are employed to implement its policies and procedures, with the line of reporting clearly stated.
snapshot.tc: 政策簡介應述明僱用合資格的合規主任及洗錢報告主任執行政策及程序，並清楚訂明報告流程。

source_quotes.text: The policy must be based on the applicant’s risk assessment and meet its particular business risk profile.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 此列主要跨單元5；政策提交要求與控制實質不重複製造補題。

topics.topic: AML政策：法律框架及CDD工作流程
covered_aspects: ML/TF/PF框架、階段、指標、STR及通風報訊
CDD閾值、風險評估、簡化／加強、SOF/SOW及記錄
高風險例子20萬、記錄一日可檢索

snapshot.en: The legal obligations that an MSO has in respect of ML, TF and PF under different legislation
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在不同法例下有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法律責任

snapshot.en: Why it is important for the applicant's business to have an AML/CFT system in place
snapshot.tc: 就申請人的業務而言，為何必須具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度

snapshot.en: What a politically exposed person is, and what source of funds and source of wealth are
snapshot.tc: 何謂政治人物，以及資金來源和財富來源各自所指的是甚麼

snapshot.en: What the three stages of ML are, and the typical signs or indicators for ML, TF and PF
snapshot.tc: 何謂洗錢的三個階段，以及洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的典型迹象或指標

snapshot.en: Actions required of the applicant if a suspicion arises, and the procedure and timing of handling an STR
snapshot.tc: 如出現可疑情況申請人須採取的行動，以及處理可疑交易報告的程序及時間

snapshot.en: What tipping off is, and the legal obligations of the applicant in respect of it
snapshot.tc: 何謂通風報訊，以及申請人在通風報訊方面須承擔甚麼法律責任

snapshot.en: On record keeping, the policy should state whether the system can retrieve the records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day.
snapshot.tc: 就備存紀錄而言，政策應闡述有關系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日內）提取有關紀錄。

snapshot.en: The guidelines' example of a situation assessed as high risk is a walk-in customer remitting HK$120,000 in cash to the Mainland.
snapshot.tc: 指引所舉評定為高風險情況的例子，是有街客要求將港幣120,000元現金匯往內地。

snapshot.en: Source of wealth refers to the origin of the particular funds or other assets that are the subject of the business relationship between an individual and the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 財富來源是指個人與金錢服務經營者的業務關係中，所涉及的特定資金或其他資產的源頭。

snapshot.en: Source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from where the funds may have been transferred, but should also cover the activity that generates them.
snapshot.tc: 追查資金來源時，所得資料不應僅限於了解資金從何轉帳，亦要知悉衍生該等資金的活動。

snapshot.en: Under a risk-based approach, an MSO is required to establish source of wealth in high risk situations, and is not expected to do so for each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者須在高度風險的情況下確立財富來源，但無須就每名客戶確立財富來源。

snapshot.en: Ongoing monitoring of a business relationship has three aspects: ongoing CDD, transaction monitoring, and regular screening of the customer against sanctions lists.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係涵蓋三個方面：持續的盡職審查、監察交易，以及定期根據制裁名單篩查客戶。

snapshot.en: An MSO should review the existing CDD records of its customers on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events, under clear policies and procedures, especially on how often periodic reviews take place.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應定期及／或遇有觸發事件時覆核客戶的現存盡職審查紀錄，並應制訂清晰的政策和程序，尤應訂明定期覆核的頻密程度。

snapshot.en: What constitutes a trigger event for reviewing customers' CDD records is a matter that the CCE defines for MSOs in the circulars it issues to them.
snapshot.tc: 何謂覆核客戶盡職審查紀錄的觸發事件，是由關長在致金錢服務經營者的通函中為其界定的事宜。

snapshot.en: The systems and processes should support the ongoing monitoring of a business relationship in a holistic approach, which may include monitoring a customer's multiple accounts within or across lines of business.
snapshot.tc: 交易監察系統及程序應能夠支援以全面的方式持續監察商業關係，可包括監察客戶在業務範圍內或跨業務的多個戶口的活動。

snapshot.en: The parameters and thresholds of an MSO's transaction monitoring systems should be properly documented and independently validated, and the adequacy and effectiveness of the systems reviewed regularly.
snapshot.tc: 交易監察系統及程序所採用的參數及門檻應妥為記錄在案並經獨立驗證，而金錢服務經營者應定期覆核該等系統及程序是否合適及有效。

source_quotes.text: Whether the system can retrieve those records within a reasonable timeframe say one day.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 本列是政策內容綱要；各個CDD實務細目由第6單元來源組逐項審核。

topics.topic: AML政策：商業模型、匯款及篩查
covered_aspects: 產品、渠道比例、貨幣、客戶、司法區及收入
支付／資金流與對手、海外分支代理監督
TFS／PEP篩查、風險評估方法

snapshot.en: On distribution channels, the policy should state the percentage of the applicant's transactions that are face-to-face and non-face-to-face.
snapshot.tc: 就分銷渠道而言，政策應闡述申請人面對面及非面對面交易各佔的百分率。

snapshot.en: On remittance, the policy should elaborate the target jurisdictions of the applicant's inward remittance transactions and of its outward remittance transactions.
snapshot.tc: 就匯款的目標司法管轄區而言，政策應分別闡述「匯入匯款交易」及「匯出匯款交易」的目標司法管轄區。

snapshot.en: Under the revenue model, the policy should explain how the applicant earns its profit, for instance by taking a certain percentage of each transaction or a handling charge.
snapshot.tc: 政策中的收費模式部分應說明申請人如何從業務獲取利潤，例如收取每宗交易款額的某個百分率或收取手續費。

snapshot.en: In elaborating its remittance and wire transfer procedures, the policy should cover how the company monitors its overseas branch and agents for compliance with its AML/CFT policy.
snapshot.tc: 就匯款交易及／或電傳轉帳的程序而言，政策應包括如何監察公司的外地分行及代理人是否遵從其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策。

snapshot.en: Its remittance procedures should include procedures for taking other reasonable measures to mitigate ML/TF risks, such as identifying the source of funds.
snapshot.tc: 其匯款程序應包括採取其他合理措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的程序，例如識別資金來源。

snapshot.en: On sanctions screening, the example given is screening customers to mitigate risks of targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism and TF, those related to proliferation, and PEPs.
snapshot.tc: 就篩查制裁名單而言，所舉例子是篩查客戶，以減低涉及恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集、武器擴散的針對性金融制裁及政治人物風險。

snapshot.en: The policy should elaborate the main types of currencies provided in the money service business, and the target customers of the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 就貨幣類別及目標客戶而言，政策應闡述金錢服務業務提供的主要貨幣類別及業務的目標客戶。

snapshot.en: On products and services, the policy should cover the money changing and/or remittance services that the applicant will offer in its business.
snapshot.tc: 就產品及服務而言，政策應涵蓋申請人所提供的貨幣兌換及／或匯款服務的資料。

snapshot.en: The MSO should use an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework, whose complexity should be proportionate to the nature and size of its business.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採用風險為本的方法制訂客戶風險評估框架，而框架的複雜程度應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。

snapshot.en: The results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should form the basis on which the framework is designed.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應以其機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的結果為依據，制訂客戶風險評估框架。

snapshot.en: In general, the framework will include customer, country, and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，框架會包含客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道的風險因素。

snapshot.en: The records should show that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring for a customer is appropriate to the customer's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 有關紀錄應能證明，基於個別客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。

evidence.covers: 政策列明风险评估方法、因素和程序

snapshot.en: The applicant should elaborate its risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes, for example the relevant risk factors and its risk assessment procedures.
snapshot.tc: 申請人應闡述其為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而進行風險評估的方法，例如相關風險因素及風險評估程序。

source_quotes.text: Elaborate the procedures in conducting sanctions screening.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: AML政策：監督、STR、審核及培訓
covered_aspects: 管理監督及CO責任、報告流程
審核配合當前風險
培訓內容／效果及出席紀錄

snapshot.en: Both senior management and the board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, should clearly understand the MSO's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層，以及董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用），均應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Management information on ML/TF risks should reach senior management in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner.
snapshot.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層。

snapshot.en: Senior management is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems that can adequately manage the ML/TF risks identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以妥善管理已識別的風險。

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint the MLRO at the management level, with overall responsibility for establishing and maintaining the AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的洗錢報告主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: Developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory requirements and are effective
snapshot.tc: 制定及／或持續覆核金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以確保其反映現況、符合現行法定規定並且有效

snapshot.en: Overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including monitoring their effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary
snapshot.tc: 監督金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的所有方面，包括監察其成效並在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序

snapshot.en: Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies
snapshot.tc: 與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況

snapshot.en: appointment of an Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
snapshot.tc: 委任一名洗錢報告主任

snapshot.en: shortlisting internal reports by the frontline staff before reporting to the MLRO
snapshot.tc: 向洗錢報告主任報告前，先由前線人員篩選內部報告

snapshot.en: implementing clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the Joint Financial Investigation Unit, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off
snapshot.tc: 就內部報告、向財富情報組作出報告、作出報告後如何減低風險及防止通風報訊執行清晰的政策和程序

snapshot.en: keeping proper records of internal reports and Suspicious Transaction Reports
snapshot.tc: 備存內部報告及可疑交易報告的妥善紀錄

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑

snapshot.en: The MSO will monitor, and keep records of, which staff have been trained, when they received the training and what type of training it was.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者將就職員接受培訓的情況，包括誰人、何時及培訓類別，進行監察並備存紀錄。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of the possible consequences for their failure to report suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應促使職員留意他們因未能舉報可疑交易而可能需要承擔的後果。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of new and emerging ML/TF techniques and trends, to the extent needed for their particular roles.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員在其特定職責所需的範圍內，留意洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的嶄新及新興技巧及趨勢。

evidence.covers: 培訓法例政策及工作職責

snapshot.en: The ordinances under which staff should be made aware of statutory and regulatory obligations concerning their MSO and themselves, and of the possible consequences of breaches, include the WMD(CPS)O.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員留意與其本身及金錢服務經營者有關的法定及監管責任以及違反的可能後果，所涉條例包括《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT policies and procedures of the MSO, including those for identifying and reporting suspicious transactions, are among the matters of which staff should be made aware.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序（包括如何識別及舉報可疑交易），屬應促使職員留意的事項。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel, may be trained on the MSO's policies and procedures for the CDD and record-keeping requirements relevant to their job responsibilities.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）可接受培訓，認識金錢服務經營者在客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄方面與其職責相關的政策及程序。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion and in the relevant policies and procedures, such as lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員可就可能出現可疑交易的情況及相關政策及程序接受培訓，例如報告的流程及應何時提高額外警覺。

snapshot.en: The quality and quantity of internal reports may be monitored so that further training needs may be identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可監察內部報告的質和量，藉此找出進一步的培訓需要。

snapshot.en: Following up with staff who miss training without reasonable cause is one way of monitoring training effectiveness.
snapshot.tc: 對沒有合理因由而缺席培訓的職員作出跟進，是監察培訓效用的方法之一。

evidence.covers: 政策列明合规监督、STR和审计

snapshot.en: In elaborating its AML/CFT compliance function, the applicant may describe, for example, management oversight and any relevant committee or panel.
snapshot.tc: 闡述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規職能時，申請人可例如說明管理層的監督及任何相關委員會／小組。

snapshot.en: The applicant should elaborate its procedures for reporting suspicious transactions, the relevant reporting lines and the roles of the MLRO and relevant staff.
snapshot.tc: 申請人應闡述舉報可疑交易的程序及相關報告流程，並說明洗錢報告主任與相關職員所擔當的角色。

snapshot.en: In elaborating its AML/CFT audit function, the applicant may describe, for example, an internal or an external audit function.
snapshot.tc: 闡述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的審核職能時，申請人可例如說明採用內部或外部審核職能。

source_quotes.text: MSO will monitor the effectiveness of training by testing their staff’s understanding

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 控制實質跨單元5/7已有題；詳細培訓範圍由AML組審核。

topics.topic: AML政策：其他控制、支持附件及協作
covered_aspects: 其他內控、可附內部表格但非一概強制
海關檢查／調查及按香港法律與其他機關協作

snapshot.en: The policy states that the applicant will cooperate with the Customs and Excise Department about its routine inspection or investigation.
snapshot.tc: 在配合監管機構及執法機構方面，政策述明申請人將配合香港海關的例行視察或調查。

snapshot.en: The policy states that the applicant will also cooperate with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of any jurisdiction.
snapshot.tc: 政策述明申請人亦將按照任何司法管轄區的法例規定，配合其他執法機構。

snapshot.en: The applicant is required to attach its internal forms, such as those for reporting suspicious transactions and conducting CRA, to its policy.
snapshot.tc: 申請人須在其政策夾附內部表格，例如用作舉報可疑交易及進行客戶風險評估的表格，以便闡述政策。

snapshot.en: If the applicant has other internal control systems for AML/CFT purposes, its policy should elaborate the relevant policies and procedures.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人有為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而設立的其他內部監控系統，政策應闡述相關政策及程序。

source_quotes.text: wherever required under the laws of Hong Kong.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 兩套紀律罰款權及指引地位
covered_aspects: 牌照違規與指定條文分別依s.43／s.21
可合併其他處分、須顧及指引
通常公開決定、考慮所有情況

snapshot.en: Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the CCE may, amongst other disciplinary actions, impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.
snapshot.tc: 根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，持牌人如違反其牌照的任何條件，關長除其他紀律行動外，可以向該持牌人施加罰款。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Fining Guideline says that, for an MSO that contravenes a specified provision, the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on its own or combine it with other disciplinary sanctions.
snapshot.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》訂明，金錢服務經營者如違反指明的條文，關長可單單施加罰款，亦可將罰款與其他紀律制裁一併實施。

snapshot.en: In deciding whether to impose a pecuniary penalty and its amount, the CCE considers all of the circumstances of the particular case, including the relevant factors the guidelines describe.
snapshot.tc: 關長在考慮是否施加罰款及罰款金額時，會考慮有關個案的所有情況，包括兩份指引所述的相關因素。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Action Guideline indicates how the CCE will exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).
snapshot.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》示明關長如何行使權力，向違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文的金錢服務經營者施加罰款。

snapshot.en: Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the more serious the contravention, the more likely the CCE is to impose a pecuniary penalty, the amount of which will reflect its gravity.
snapshot.tc: 根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，違規者的行為愈嚴重，關長就愈有可能施加罰款，而罰款額也會反映該違規行為的嚴重性。

snapshot.en: The factors the guidelines list for determining the seriousness of a contravention are not exhaustive, and some of them may not be applicable in a particular case.
snapshot.tc: 兩份指引均表明所列用以決定違規行為嚴重性的因素並非詳盡無遺，其中有些因素在某些個案中並不適用。

snapshot.en: As a matter of policy, the CCE will usually make public all of its decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO.
snapshot.tc: 按照目前的政策，關長通常會公布所有向金錢服務經營者施加罰款的決定。

source_quotes.text: The CCE will have regard to this Guideline when exercising the power

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 罰款目的、嚴重程度及財力
covered_aspects: 個別與一般阻嚇、不致財困
故意／魯莽／疏忽、持續頻率、損害、集團角色
內控系統缺陷、累積小問題及犯罪程度

snapshot.en: The CCE takes the MSO's size and financial resources into account, as a penalty should not be likely to put the MSO in financial jeopardy.
snapshot.tc: 關長會顧及金錢服務經營者的規模及財政資源，因罰款不應令其陷入財政困難。

snapshot.en: A contravention caused merely by negligence, or conduct resulting only in a technical breach, is generally regarded as less serious.
snapshot.tc: 純粹因疏忽所造成的違規行為，或只屬技術性違規的行為，一般會視作嚴重性較低。

snapshot.en: A number of smaller issues, which individually may not justify a penalty but do so when taken collectively, are a factor considered.
snapshot.tc: 若干較輕微的違規事項個別未必足以施加罰款，但合起來則可施加罰款，這屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: The CCE's aim in imposing a pecuniary penalty is to deter the MSO concerned and, as a general deterrent, other MSOs too.
snapshot.tc: 關長施加罰款，旨在阻嚇有關金錢服務經營者，同時對其他金錢服務經營者起一般的阻嚇作用。

snapshot.en: The duration and frequency of the contraventions, and the nature and extent of any financial crime facilitated or occasioned by the contravention
snapshot.tc: 該違規行為持續的時間及頻密程度，以及由該違規行為促成或引致的任何金融罪行的性質及程度

snapshot.en: Whether the contravention was the licensee's or MSO's own act or was committed as part of a group, and its role within that group
snapshot.tc: 該違規行為是持牌人或金錢服務經營者獨自作出，還是作為集團一分子作出，以及其在集團內的角色

snapshot.en: Whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the reputation of the Customs and Excise Department as the regulator of MSOs
snapshot.tc: 該違規行為是否有可能引致損害或有損香港海關作為金錢服務經營者監管機構的聲譽

snapshot.en: Whether the contravention reveals serious or systemic weaknesses in the internal controls over the procedures for reporting suspicious transactions
snapshot.tc: 該違規行為是否顯示出舉報可疑交易程序的內部監控制度存在嚴重的或系統性的弱點

snapshot.en: The size and the financial resources of the particular licensee or MSO that has committed the contravention in question
snapshot.tc: 作出有關違規行為的持牌人或金錢服務經營者本身的業務規模及財政資源狀況

snapshot.en: Whether the contravention caused, or potentially caused, loss to any other person, or imposed costs on any other person
snapshot.tc: 該違規行為會否對任何其他人造成或有可能造成損失，或使任何其他人承擔支出

source_quotes.text: A pecuniary penalty should not have the likely effect of putting the licensee concerned in financial jeopardy.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 罰款額不會自動與利潤掛鈎
missing_aspects: 三倍利潤／避免開支是法定最高額之一，不是自動計罰公式

source_quotes.text: the CCE will not automatically link the fine imposed in any particular case with the profit gained, or costs avoided.
但關長不會將任何特定個案的罰款額，與違規者所獲得的利潤或避免的開支金額自動掛鈎。

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 以三倍上限與實際裁量罰款作區分，避免重考最高額。

topics.topic: 罰款：事後行為及過往紀錄
covered_aspects: 合作程度、再犯風險、過往承諾
獲利對象、主動通報及類案一致
遵當時指引一般不處分
missing_aspects: 隱瞞、補救／處分涉事者／預防再犯
以往同類違規及其他機關對同一事的懲罰

snapshot.en: A factor is the degree of cooperation with the CCE, other relevant authorities and/or law enforcement agencies during the investigation of the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 在調查違規行為期間與關長、其他有關當局及／或執法機構的合作程度，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: A factor is the likelihood that the contravener will commit the same type of contravention in the future if no penalty, or a lighter penalty, is imposed.
snapshot.tc: 如無施加罰款或施加較輕的罰款，違規者日後重犯同一類別違規行為的可能性，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: Among the factors on previous record and compliance history is whether the contravener had undertaken not to engage in the conduct that resulted in the contravention.
snapshot.tc: 在過往紀律處分紀錄及合規情況方面，違規者過往曾否承諾不會作出引致有關違規事件的行為，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: A factor is the amount of any benefit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention by the customers of the licensee or MSO.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人或金錢服務經營者的客戶從違規行為中所獲得的利益或所避免開支的數額，屬考慮因素之一。

snapshot.en: As a mitigating factor, the CCE considers whether the contravener has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to its attention.
snapshot.tc: 作為求情因素，關長會考慮違規者有否迅速、有效及完全地知會關長有關違規行為或可能違規行為。

snapshot.en: The CCE considers what action it and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases; in general, similar cases should be treated consistently.
snapshot.tc: 關長會考慮其本身及／或其他有關當局曾就過往的類似個案採取甚麽行動；相若的個案一般應以貫徹一致的方式處理。

snapshot.en: The CCE generally takes no disciplinary action for conduct that was in line with the guidance current at the time of the conduct.
snapshot.tc: 如有關行為符合當時適用的導引，關長一般不會就該行為採取紀律行動。

source_quotes.text: whether the licensee attempted to conceal its contravention(s);
該金錢服務經營者有否嘗試隱瞞該違規行為

topics.question_brief: 用事後補救和隱瞞的對照場景，補過往紀錄及其他機關已罰的因素。

topics.topic: 非香港居民的可靠證明
covered_aspects: 旅遊證件／國民身分證／國家駕駛執照、國際駕駛許可不等同國家駕照

snapshot.en: For a non-resident who is not physically present in Hong Kong, an international driving permit bearing the individual's photograph is acceptable for verifying identity.
snapshot.tc: 至於沒有現身香港的非香港居民，金錢服務經營者可接納附有其照片的國際駕駛許可證，用以核實其身分。

snapshot.en: Where a jurisdiction has no national ID cards and the customer has no photographic travel document or driving licence, any other document accepted as evidence must bear a photograph.
snapshot.tc: 對於沒有國民身分證的司法管轄區的客戶，金錢服務經營者破例接受作身分證據的其他文件，必須附有其照片。

snapshot.en: An individual's driving licence, issued to the individual by a governmental body and bearing the individual's own photograph
snapshot.tc: 由政府機構發給個人並載有該名個人本身相片的駕駛執照

source_quotes.text: a valid national driving licence incorporating all the required identification information

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 依B4按客戶在港與否區分，不以FAQ省略所在地製造新衝突。

topics.topic: 可接納旅遊證件例子
covered_aspects: 澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證為有效例子

snapshot.en: The Permit for residents of Macau issued by the Director of Immigration and the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents constitute travel documents for identity verification.
snapshot.tc: 由入境事務處處長簽發的澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證，均為可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件。

source_quotes.text: Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents;

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 其餘清單例子可作替換練習，不為每一證件另要求新題。

topics.topic: 旅遊證件個人資料頁的保存
covered_aspects: 保存含照片及個人資料頁複本，非額外認證要求

evidence.covers: 個人資料頁與認證陷阱

snapshot.en: For the record-keeping requirements, an MSO should retain a certified copy of the “biodata” page of a travel document, which contains the bearer's photograph and biographical details.
snapshot.tc: 為符合備存紀錄規定，金錢服務經營者應保存一份經認證的旅遊證件「個人資料頁」複本，即載有持證人照片及個人資料的一頁。

source_quotes.text: An MSO should retain a copy of the “biodata” page

topics.topic: 自然人改名的核實及建立關係前例外
missing_aspects: 可靠獨立來源核實新姓名
以原紀錄核對出生日期／證號防冒認
疑問時可索改名文件
開戶前已改名只識別核實現名

source_quotes.text: only the current name is required to be identified and verified.
如客戶的姓名於建立業務關係前已作更改，則只須識別和核實現時的姓名。

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 一題含關係建立前後改名、交叉核對及疑問時文件，避免延伸成必須核實所有曾用名。

topics.topic: 主要營業地點的含義及異常地址
covered_aspects: 須取得主要營業地點
missing_aspects: 主要營運／活動地點可不同於註冊辦事處
地址不符業務或客戶狀況時須了解理據

snapshot.en: Principal place of business
snapshot.tc: 主要營業地點

source_quotes.text: the MSO should seek to understand the rationale for why that address is provided to the MSO.
金錢服務經營者應致力找出獲提供該地址的理據。

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 用公司註冊地址與實際營運地址不同的場景，測合理差異及須查問的異常。

topics.topic: 註冊辦事處地址的文件證明
covered_aspects: 可靠獨立文件已載地址可接納，已知過時除外

snapshot.en: A document from a reliable and independent source that includes the registered office address, such as a certificate of incumbency, may be accepted as evidence of it unless the MSO knows it is out of date.
snapshot.tc: 載有註冊辦事處地址的可靠及獨立來源文件（例如職權證明書）可作該地址的證據，除非金錢服務經營者知悉地址不能反映現況。

source_quotes.text: unless the MSO was made aware that such address was out of date.

topics.topic: 合夥身份文件及低風險簡化
covered_aspects: 註冊／協議契約、低風險摘錄、額外權力文件
行業資歷／公開資料下會員確認

snapshot.en: The identity of a customer that is a partnership can be verified by reference to a record of registration, or to a partnership agreement or deed.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可參考合夥的註冊記錄，或其合夥協議或契約，以核實屬合夥的客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: Where the customer or the circumstances are not deemed to present a high ML/TF risk, an extract or redacted version of the partnership agreement or deed may be accepted.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶或情況並非被視為會造成高度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，可接納合夥協議或契約的摘錄或刪節本。

snapshot.en: Even where a record of registration is obtained, an additional document may be required to understand the powers that regulate and bind the partnership.
snapshot.tc: 即使已取得合夥的註冊記錄，金錢服務經營者可能仍需額外文件，才能了解規管和約束合夥的權力。

snapshot.en: Confirming a partnership's membership of a relevant professional or trade association is likely to suffice to verify its identity if it is a well-known, reputable organisation with a long industry history.
snapshot.tc: 如合夥為眾所周知、有信譽及在業內歷史悠久的組織，確認其具有相關專業或行業協會會員身分便可能足以核實其身分。

source_quotes.text: an extract or redacted version for customers / circumstances that are not deemed to present a high ML/TF risk

topics.topic: 擁有權架構表與中間層
covered_aspects: 需了解架構但不強制圖表
須識別中間層、不例行核實每間公司
複雜結構合理原因

snapshot.en: Obtaining an ownership chart from the customer is the most convenient way of understanding its ownership and control structure, but there is no strict requirement to obtain one.
snapshot.tc: 向客戶索取擁有權架構表雖是了解其擁有權及控制權結構最方便的方法，但金錢服務經營者並無強制規定要索取。

snapshot.en: Although an MSO needs to identify any intermediate layers, it need not, as a matter of routine, verify the details of the intermediate companies in the ownership structure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者雖然需要識別任何中介層，但不必把核實擁有權結構內中介層公司的細節列作例行事項。

snapshot.en: Where a customer has a complex ownership or control structure, the MSO should obtain sufficient information to satisfy itself that there is a legitimate reason behind that structure.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶的擁有權或控制權結構複雜，金錢服務經營者應索取足夠資料，從而使本身信納採用該結構具有合法理由。

source_quotes.text: there is no strict requirement to do so.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 法人開戶代表及非面對面措施
covered_aspects: 可為獲授權非董事／實益擁有人
面對面至少一代表在場
非面對面須減低額外風險、授權驗證

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

snapshot.en: The Guideline does not mandate that the natural person be a director or a beneficial owner of the customer, so long as that person has been properly authorised to act on the customer's behalf.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》並沒有強制規定該自然人須為客戶的董事或實益擁有人，只要該自然人已妥善地獲授權代表客戶行事。

snapshot.en: If the business relationship is established through a face-to-face channel, at least two natural persons authorised to establish it should be physically present at the time of account opening.
snapshot.tc: 若業務關係透過面對面的方式建立，至少兩名獲客戶授權建立業務關係的自然人應於開立戶口時現身。

snapshot.en: If the business relationship is established through a non-face-to-face channel, the MSO should mitigate any increased risk, for example by applying additional due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 如業務關係透過非面對面的渠道建立，金錢服務經營者仍應減低任何增加的風險，例如執行額外的盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: Where the MSO is provided with copies of documents to identify and verify the customer, it should also mitigate any increased risk, such as by the additional measures for customers not physically present.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者僅獲文件的複本以識別及核實客戶，亦應減低任何增加的風險，例如執行為不曾現身的客戶而設的額外措施。

source_quotes.text: at least one natural person who is authorised to establish the business relationship should be physically present
