missing_aspects: 個人關係、融資、親密家族／合約／違約安排可構成控制
控制可未實際行使，受益於資產亦可能推定

snapshot.en: Where nothing obtained in the CDD process suggests that a person exercising ultimate control over the customer exists, there is no requirement to actively identify such a person.
snapshot.tc: 如在客戶盡職審查過程中所得資料並沒有顯示有人能對客戶行使最終控制權，則無要求積極地識別該人。

source_quotes.text: A natural person who exerts control without ownership by participating in the financing of the enterprise
而在沒有擁有權下對法團施加控制。

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 用零持股但透過融資／家族／合約控制的情境，與25%門檻區分。

topics.topic: 識別代表客戶行事者的判斷框架
covered_aspects: 按角色活動及風險判定、法例沒有完整定義
建立各客群判斷框架，部門方法與理據一致

snapshot.en: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
snapshot.tc: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Although FATF Recommendation 10 and the AMLO require any PPTA to be identified and verified, neither the FATF Recommendations nor the AMLO defines the scope of a PPTA.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織第10項建議及《打擊洗錢條例》雖要求識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，但兩者均沒有界定其涵蓋範圍。

snapshot.en: As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

evidence.covers: 反向題句直接測試各部門不得各訂理據

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt a framework of procedures for assessing who would ordinarily be a PPTA for each customer segment, with each department setting its own approach and rationale.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取有系統的程序，評估每個客戶類別中通常被視為看似代表客戶行事的人，並由各部門自行訂定方法及理據。

source_quotes.text: The approach and rationale should be consistent across departments and customer segments, to the extent possible.

topics.priority_reason: 跨文件題句m6-369第5句已直接測試框架一致性。

topics.topic: 授權簽署人、PPTA名單及最低資料
covered_aspects: 非所有簽署人均PPTA
低風險才可獨立部門確認名單核實
missing_aspects: 自然人及法人PPTA均須取得各自最低識別資料；名單替代核實不免除識別資料

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk, the MSO could verify the PPTAs' identities by reference to a list of PPTAs confirmed by an independent department of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 如業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險被評為屬於高，金錢服務經營者可根據經客戶內部獨立部門核實的清單，核實看似代表客戶行事的人的身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO is not required to identify and verify every authorized signatory of a customer: signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are PPTAs.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者無須識別及核實客戶的所有獲授權簽署人；僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。

evidence.covers: 自然人客戶同類資料，非專測PPTA

snapshot.en: The MSO should obtain at least the customer's full name, date of birth, nationality, and identity number and document type.
snapshot.tc: 最低限度應收集客戶的全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件類別。

source_quotes.text: the MSO is required to identify the PPTA by obtaining at least the following identification information:
金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集以下識別資料以識別看似代表客戶行事的人

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 補名單核實不能省略最低資料，加入法人PPTA；與AML Guideline ¶4.5.3缺口合併。

topics.topic: 電子文件的可靠性及自行下載例外
covered_aspects: 適當措施核實電子文件可靠
自己從可靠來源下載毋須另佐證

snapshot.en: Where the MSO itself downloads a document from a reliable source, such as the Hong Kong Companies Registry's website, instead of receiving a print copy, no corroboration is required.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者自行從可靠的來源（例如香港公司註冊處的網頁）下載文件，而非收取其印刷本，便無須進行核對。

snapshot.en: If a customer cannot produce an original identification document, for example because it is in electronic form, the MSO should take appropriate measures to ensure the reliability of the documents obtained.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶無法出示識別文件的正本（例如正本為電子版本），金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施確保取得的識別文件屬可靠。

source_quotes.text: corroboration would not be required for instances where the MSO itself has downloaded a particular document

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 外語文件翻譯來源
covered_aspects: 無須專業第三方，可靠技術／常用翻譯工具可用

snapshot.en: There is no requirement that a foreign-language document be translated by a professional third party; the MSO may obtain a translation from a reliable source, such as commonly used translation tools.
snapshot.tc: 現時並無規定以外語書寫的文件須由專業第三方翻譯；金錢服務經營者可透過可靠來源（包括常用的翻譯工具）取得譯本。

source_quotes.text: There is no requirement that the translation has to be performed by a professional third party

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 文件到期與CDD資料更新
covered_aspects: 單純證件到期不必重新核實
定期／觸發CDD審查確保資料現況相關

snapshot.en: The MSO need not re-verify any aspect of a customer's identification just because an identity document obtained earlier, such as a passport, has expired.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者不需要僅因為早前取得的身分證明文件（例如護照）已過期，而再次核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO should review the existing CDD records of its customers on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events, under clear policies and procedures, especially on how often periodic reviews take place.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應定期及／或遇有觸發事件時覆核客戶的現存盡職審查紀錄，並應制訂清晰的政策和程序，尤應訂明定期覆核的頻密程度。

source_quotes.text: just because of the expiry of a previously obtained identity document.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 財富來源調查的比例與歷史證據
covered_aspects: 高風險情況需確立財富來源、非每名客戶一律
missing_aspects: 高風險亦不需完全相同程序
風險不支持時不要求數十年前證據
普通客戶職業／業務資料可支持基礎狀況理解

snapshot.en: Under a risk-based approach, an MSO is required to establish source of wealth in high risk situations, and is not expected to do so for each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者須在高度風險的情況下確立財富來源，但無須就每名客戶確立財富來源。

source_quotes.text: there is no expectation to apply the same source of wealth procedures to all these customers in the same manner
金錢服務經營者無須就所有客戶的財富來源以相同方式應用相同的程序

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 測風險相稱與避免不必要追溯，勿重問是否每人必查。

topics.topic: FATF呼籲與持續監察名單的不同處理
covered_aspects: 呼籲名單比例相稱EDD
持續監察名單資訊納入風險分析
missing_aspects: 持續監察名單本身不自動強制EDD

snapshot.en: EDD measures proportionate to the risks should be applied to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons from jurisdictions for which the FATF calls for this.
snapshot.tc: 對於與來自特別組織對其作出呼籲的司法管轄區的自然人和法人的業務關係及交易，應執行合乎風險比例的更嚴格盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: Where the FATF calls for mandatory EDD or countermeasures, the CCE may, by notice in writing, require MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice.
snapshot.tc: 如特別組織呼籲執行更嚴格的盡職審查或採取針對措施，關長可透過書面通知，要求金錢服務經營者採取通知內所述的特定針對措施。

snapshot.en: The FATF calls on all members and urges all jurisdictions to apply enhanced due diligence to the countries identified as high-risk and, in the most serious cases, countermeasures.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求所有成員及促請所有司法管轄區對被識別為高風險的國家採取更嚴格的盡職審查，並在最嚴重的情況下採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: The FATF requires its members to take into account, in their risk analysis, the information in its updated statement on jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求其成員在進行風險分析時，參考其發布的有關被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新聲明所載述的資料。

source_quotes.text: conducting EDD is not mandatory for customers connected to jurisdictions
更嚴格盡職審查措施並非強制性規定。

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 一題對照兩類名單，避免把灰名單等同強制EDD；可併入通函20題。
topics.notes: 舊FAQ名單名稱按現行20通函對照，不擅自引入網外新版；合併時僅計一次。

topics.topic: 聯合國機構的國際組織地位
covered_aspects: 聯合國機構為國際組織

snapshot.en: Agencies of the United Nations, such as those listed on the UN website, are international organisations for the purposes of establishing PEP status.
snapshot.tc: 就確定政治人物地位而言，聯合國的機構（例如聯合國網站所列者）屬於國際組織。

source_quotes.text: agencies of the United Nations are international organisations

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 國際組織定義與類似組織風險
covered_aspects: 條約、法律地位及非居民單位
非符合定義組織未必PEP仍須看風險

snapshot.en: An individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent function by an international organisation, such as a deputy director or a member of its board, is an international organisation PEP.
snapshot.tc: 在國際組織擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人，包括該組織的副總監或理事會成員等高級管理層成員，屬國際組織政治人物。

snapshot.en: Under the Guideline's definition, international organisations are recognised by law in their member countries and are not treated as resident institutional units of the countries where they are located.
snapshot.tc: 根據指引的界定，國際組織的地位獲成員國的法律認可，而且國際組織不會被視作其所處國家的常駐機構單位。

snapshot.en: If a customer holds a prominent function at an organisation that resembles but does not meet the definition of an international organisation, the MSO should consider whether this impacts the customer's risk profile.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶在與國際組織相似但不符合其定義的組織擔任重要公職，金錢服務經營者應考慮會否影響該客戶的風險狀況。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the International Maritime Organization, the Council of Europe, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and the World Trade Organization.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括國際海事組織、歐洲理事會、北大西洋公約組織及世界貿易組織。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, an economic organisation, and the International Olympic Committee.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括東南亞國家協會及國際奧林匹克委員會等國際組織。

source_quotes.text: the MSO should consider whether this impacts the risk profile of the customer.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 前政治人物停止加強措施的批准條件
covered_aspects: 不存在固定離任年期自動豁免
missing_aspects: 須高級管理層批准且不再高風險
對香港／非香港／國際組織前PEP作適當風險評估

snapshot.en: Once a former non-Hong Kong PEP has been out of office for a prescribed length of time, the MSO may stop applying EDD measures to that customer.
snapshot.tc: 前非香港政治人物卸任已滿訂明期間後，金錢服務經營者即可停止對其執行更嚴格的盡職審查措施。

source_quotes.text: Such decision can only be made with the approval of the MSO’s senior management
有關決定須獲金錢服務經營者的高級管理層批准，而該政治人物須不再構成高度洗錢/恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 一題測離任、風險評估及高層批准三者關係，不重複固定年限陷阱。

topics.topic: PEP批准人的明文政策及資歷
covered_aspects: 可包括另一司法區高層，須符合組織風控
missing_aspects: MSO自行決定、有清晰明文批准名單政策
足夠資歷，數目職銜因規模類型風險不同

snapshot.en: Senior management approving a PEP relationship may include personnel in another jurisdiction, if this reflects the MSO's organisational structure and risk management practices.
snapshot.tc: 如能反映組織結構及風險管理方法，批准與政治人物建立業務關係的高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區的人員。

source_quotes.text: MSOs should maintain clear and documented policies setting out the persons within the institution
金錢服務經營者應維持有明文依據的清晰政策

topics.priority_reason: 已有主要規則，補充執行細節或區分可提高完整度。
topics.question_brief: 可與Q20合併測哪些人可批及書面授權，無須固定職銜。

topics.topic: 依賴中介人不包括持續監察
covered_aspects: 可讓中介人收集更新文件
CDD與持續監察是獨立責任
missing_aspects: 不能依賴中介人代為持續CDD和交易監察（有別於協助收集資料）

snapshot.en: An MSO may use an intermediary to collect further documents, data and information, and to provide or coordinate updates, to help keep its CDD records up-to-date and relevant.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可藉中介人收集進一步的文件、數據和資料，及提供或協調相關更新，以協助確保其盡職審查紀錄反映現況及仍屬相關。

snapshot.en: Continuously monitoring a business relationship is a separate duty, and is not one of the measures that the AMLO defines as customer due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係是另一項獨立的責任，並不屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的客戶盡職審查措施之一。

source_quotes.text: an MSO cannot rely on an intermediary to continuously monitor its business relationships with a customer
金錢服務經營者不能依賴中介人持續監察其與客戶的業務關係

topics.priority_reason: 核心法定或實務責任、權限或重要例外尚未直接測試。
topics.question_brief: 以中介做開戶CDD之後，誰負責監察為場景，區分收集更新與依賴監察。

topics.topic: 交易監察系統的獨立驗證
covered_aspects: 外部或內審可驗證
適當分工、足夠專業資源及獨立性

snapshot.en: The independent validation of the MSO's transaction monitoring systems and processes can be performed by an external party or by its internal audit function.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的交易監察系統及程序的獨立核實工作，可由外界人士或其內部審核職能執行。

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責

snapshot.en: The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報

source_quotes.text: Such validation can be performed by an external party or an internal audit function

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 跨境支付最低篩查相關各方
covered_aspects: 跨境轉帳及匯款須篩相關方，包括中介機構及具名人士

snapshot.en: In a cross-border wire transfer or remittance transaction, the relevant parties to be screened at a minimum include the intermediary institution and the named parties in the payment message.
snapshot.tc: 在跨境電傳轉帳或匯款交易中，金錢服務經營者最低限度應篩查的相關各方，包括中介機構及撥付訊息中被具名的人士。

source_quotes.text: named parties (e.g., individuals, companies, banks etc) in the payment message.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。
topics.notes: 此列以最低篩查名單核心適用為單位，非每個名詞均須獨立題句。

topics.topic: 匯款人資料已核實後的準確性
covered_aspects: 合規核實即視準確、通常無須再核但可個案酌情

snapshot.en: The required originator information is deemed to be accurate if the originator's identity has been verified in compliance with the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人的身分已根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢指引》的規定核實，所需的匯款人資料便視為準確。

snapshot.en: No further verification of the originator information is normally required, although an ordering institution may exercise its discretion to verify it further in individual cases.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，匯款機構無需再進一步核實匯款人資料，但仍可運用酌情權，就個別個案作進一步核實。

source_quotes.text: No further verification of the originator information is normally required

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 匯款地址與郵政信箱例外
covered_aspects: 地址須可辨明位置以篩查監察
無其他選擇才可郵箱

snapshot.en: Address information accompanying a wire transfer or remittance should identify clearly where the parties are, for sanctions screening and AML/CFT monitoring, so a PO box should be avoided unless no alternative exists.
snapshot.tc: 電傳轉帳及匯款交易附隨的地址資料應足以清楚識別各方位置，以便篩查受制裁名單及為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集而監察，故除非別無選擇，應避免以郵政信箱為地址。

source_quotes.text: having a PO Box as an address should be avoided except where no alternative exists.

topics.priority_reason: 已測試所列核心命題，或僅作參考。

topics.topic: 認證文件的範圍及不用認證的情況
covered_aspects: 認證人看正本、簽署身份及非自行認證等程序
missing_aspects: 不要求認證所有其他CDD資料
可公開來源核對時毋須認證
客戶出示正本的機會（措辭依E7）

snapshot.en: Certification by an independent and appropriate person is effective only if the certifier has seen the original documentation.
snapshot.tc: 由獨立的合適人選認證身分核實文件時，證明人須查閱文件正本，認證才屬有效。

snapshot.en: The certifier should sign and date the copy document, print his or her name clearly in capitals underneath, and clearly indicate his or her position or capacity on it.
snapshot.tc: 證明人必須在文件的複本上簽署並寫上日期，在下方以大楷清楚列示其姓名，並清楚註明其職位或身分。

snapshot.en: An officer of an embassy, consulate or high commission of the country of issue of the identification document is among the examples of appropriate certifiers.
snapshot.tc: 發出身分核實文件的國家的大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員，是合適證明人的例子之一。

snapshot.en: In general, it is not sufficient for copies of identification documents to be self-certified by the customer whose identity is being verified.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，由客戶自行認證其身分核實文件的複本，並不足以達到認證的目的。

snapshot.en: The MSO must exercise caution in accepting certified copies, especially where they originate from a country perceived to represent a high risk or from unregulated entities.
snapshot.tc: 接納經認證的文件複本時必須審慎行事，特別是文件來自被視為涉及高風險的國家或不受監管的實體時。

snapshot.en: Supplementary measures may include using an independent and appropriate person to certify identification documents, or checking relevant data against reliable databases or registries.
snapshot.tc: 增補措施可包括由獨立的合適人選認證身分證明文件，或根據可靠的數據庫或登記冊核對相關數據。

source_quotes.text: There is no expectation to require certification for all other CDD information or documents
金錢服務經營者在能將有關文件與公開來源進行核對的情況下，亦無須認證該等文件。

snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在指明的處所內的一處顯眼地方，展示該牌照的正本或複本。

snapshot.en: where the premises are domestic premises, the applicant must secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for the purpose of exercising the powers as conferred by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615 (AMLO)
snapshot.tc: （如該處所屬住宅處所）申請人須確保取得該處所的每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人為行使第615 章《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（打擊洗錢條例）所授予的權力而進入該處所。

snapshot.en: If there is any change in the particulars that are provided to the Commissioner in connection with a licensee’s application for licence or renewal of licence, the licensee must notify the Commissioner in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place
snapshot.tc: 如在與持牌人提出的牌照申請或牌照續期申請有關連情況下提供予關長的詳情有改變，該持牌人須在自改變發生之日起計的一個月內，藉書面向關長具報有關改變。

snapshot.en: If a licensee intends to cease to operate a money service, it is required to notify the Commissioner of Customs & Excise in writing of the intention before the date of cessation
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如擬停止經營金錢服務，須在停業日期前藉書面向海關關長具報該意向。

snapshot.en: Identifying the customer and verifying the customer’s identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a governmental body

snapshot.en: MSO must continuously monitor the business relationship with a customer by conducting appropriate scrutiny of transactions carried out for the customer to ensure that they are consistent with its knowledge of the customer and the customer’s business and risk profile
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須藉對為客戶執行的交易進行適當的審查，以確保它們符合其對客戶、客戶的業務及風險狀況的認知，以持續監察與客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: Before carrying out a remittance transaction involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, MSO must verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator’s identification document
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在進行涉及相等於$8,000或以上的款額的匯款交易前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。

snapshot.en: LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee

snapshot.en: LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers

snapshot.en: If an MSO licensee fails to maintain the LMO, it may result in the suspension and revocation of the MSO licence.

topics.topic: 跨境现金类物品申报与罚则
topics.locators: 第2–6段；金额门槛另见17第1段
covered_aspects: 超过12万港元门槛；指明管制站、其他入境及离境情形；货物预先申报；最高刑罚

evidence.covers: 旅客与货物程序以及刑罚

snapshot.en: A traveller arriving in Hong Kong via a specified control point with a large quantity of CBNIs must make a written declaration to a Customs officer, using the Red Channel.
snapshot.tc: 經指明管制站抵達香港並管有大量現金類物品的旅客，須使用紅綠通道系統下的紅通道，向海關人員作出書面申報。

snapshot.en: A traveller who is about to leave Hong Kong with a large quantity of CBNIs must make a written declaration to a Customs officer, using the Red Channel.
snapshot.tc: 即將離開香港並管有大量現金類物品的旅客，須使用紅綠通道系統下的紅通道，向海關人員作出書面申報。

snapshot.en: A traveller arriving not via a specified control point must disclose, on a Customs officer's request, whether he or she has a large quantity of CBNIs.
snapshot.tc: 非經指明管制站抵達香港的旅客，須在海關人員要求下，披露是否管有大量現金類物品。

snapshot.en: For a large quantity of CBNIs imported or exported in a cargo consignment, an advance declaration must be made through the Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments Declaration System.
snapshot.tc: 進口或出口同一批次屬貨物的大量現金類物品，必須利用海關網上的「現金類物品申報系統」，預先向海關作出申報。

snapshot.en: A person who fails to comply with the requirements of the Ordinance is liable to a maximum penalty of a fine of HK$500,000 and imprisonment for seven years.
snapshot.tc: 任何違反《條例》所訂規定的人士，最高可被處以罰款港幣500,000元及監禁七年的刑罰。

snapshot.en: For travellers who need to make a written declaration, declaration forms are available at the Red Channel of the Customs Arrival Hall and on the C&ED's website.
snapshot.tc: 需要作出書面申報的旅客，可於海關入境大堂的紅通道索取有關申報表，亦可於香港海關的網站下載申報表。

snapshot.en: The E-form lets travellers, before arriving in or departing from Hong Kong, pre-fill information on CBNIs with a total value of more than HKD120,000 and obtain a QR code.
snapshot.tc: 電子表格供旅客在抵達或離開香港之前，預先填寫總價值高於12萬港元的現金類物品資料，以取得作申報用的二維碼。

source_quotes.text: the total value of which is more than HK$120,000
source_quotes.locator: 第2–6段；金额门槛另见17第1段

source_quotes.text: 總價值高於港幣120,000元

topics.topic: 交付渠道的风险评估与定期复核
covered_aspects: 经营模式变化引起的机构风险评估；合作前评估；客户、伙伴及交易对手的渠道风险
missing_aspects: 题句尚未直接测试渠道须定期复核，以符合相关司法管辖区的最新监管规定

snapshot.en: To ensure their AML/CFT controls are appropriate and effective, MSOs should review the adequacy of their institutional risk assessment in response to emerging threats arising from original or changed modes of operation.
snapshot.tc: 為確保打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施適當而有效，金錢服務經營者須因應原本經營模式或其轉變後帶來的潛在威脅，覆核機構層面風險評估是否合適。

snapshot.en: When establishing or maintaining business relationships with customers, business partners and/or counterparties in their delivery channels, MSOs should exercise caution in assessing how vulnerable these channels are to ML/TF abuse.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者與屬其交付渠道一部分的客戶、業務夥伴及／或交易對手建立或維持業務關係時，應審慎評估此等渠道面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度。

snapshot.en: All MSOs are required to establish and maintain adequate and appropriate risk-based controls to protect consumer interest and address any ML/TF risks emanating from the use of particular delivery channels.
snapshot.tc: 所有金錢服務經營者須設立及維持適當的風險為本的管控措施，足以保障消費者利益，並應對因使用特定交付渠道而造成的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: The C&ED expects each MSO to have a comprehensive risk assessment before engaging other parties in its business model, and to pay attention to the relevant risks associated with delivery channels.
snapshot.tc: 海關要求各金錢服務經營者在其業務模式下與其他各方開展合作之前，先進行全面風險評估，並留意涉及交付渠道的風險。

snapshot.en: The assessment may take into account Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and should take into account any higher risks notified to MSOs by the CCE
snapshot.tc: 評估可考慮香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並應顧及關長通報的任何較高風險

source_quotes.text: these channels should be reviewed by MSOs on a regular basis
金錢服務經營者亦須定期覆核此等渠道

topics.priority_reason: 主要制度已有题，补齐执行条件或操作细节可避免只会原则。
topics.question_brief: 补充渠道定期复核与因经营模式变化触发复核的区别；不重复“合作前评估”。
topics.notes: 具体渠道题主要在单元6；单元5已有一般机构评估与更新。本行只把渠道层面的持续复核细节列为不足。

topics.topic: 高风险渠道的强化措施与可疑交易报告
covered_aspects: 高风险采取强化措施；形成怀疑后尽快报告；不限已经完成的交易

evidence.covers: 识别较高风险后加强措施

snapshot.en: The MSO should take enhanced measures to manage and to mitigate those risks where any higher risks are identified
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應在識別出較高風險時採取更為嚴格的措施，以管理和減低該等有關風險

evidence.covers: 更严格尽调适用高风险而非所有客户

snapshot.en: Besides having CDD policies that meet the statutory requirements, MSOs should apply enhanced due diligence requirements to each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 除制定符合法定規定的盡職審查政策外，金錢服務經營者應對每一名客戶均施加更嚴格的盡職審查要求。

snapshot.en: Once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an STR should be filed even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 知悉或懷疑一旦確立，即使沒有交易由或透過金錢服務經營者進行，也應提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: The STR must be made as soon as reasonably practical after the transaction giving rise to the suspicion has been completed.
snapshot.tc: 可疑交易報告必須在引起懷疑的該項交易完成後，在切實可行範圍內盡快提交。

snapshot.en: A person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must, as soon as reasonable, file an STR with the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑任何財產是恐怖分子財產，須在合理範圍內盡快向關長提交可疑交易報告。

source_quotes.text: diligence (EDD) when encountering high risk customers or transactions.

topics.notes: 相同义务分散在单元1、5和7，计入全库覆盖，不要求每份通函重复出题。

topics.topic: 境外行为是否构成可公诉罪行得益
covered_aspects: 境外行为按其如在香港发生是否构成可公诉罪行判断，不以当地是否合法决定

snapshot.en: Property shown to have come from identifiable acts committed overseas is caught by section 25(1) of the OSCO if that conduct constituted an indictable offence in Hong Kong, whatever its legal position where it took place.
snapshot.tc: 若有證據顯示相關財產來自於海外犯下的可識別行為，而該行為在香港構成可公訴罪行，則無論其發生地的法律地位如何，均受《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25(1)條囿制。

source_quotes.text: irrespective of the legal position in the jurisdiction where such conduct took place.

topics.topic: 客户风险评估的一致性与跟进
covered_aspects: 跟进矛盾资料；准确档案；保留评估依据；识别高风险并加强措施；目的误导后迅速跟进

evidence.covers: 高风险措施与矛盾资料、评估纪录

snapshot.en: An MSO should identify and categorise money laundering and terrorist financing risks at the customer level, differentiate higher-risk customers and apply enhanced measures to eliminate the risk.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應妥為識別客戶的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險水平並予以分類，辨別擁有較高風險的客戶，並實施更嚴格的措施以消除該風險。

snapshot.en: An MSO should ensure its staff follow up on inconsistent information given by customers to establish accurate profiles, and keep proper records of customer risk assessments with relevant documents.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保其員工就客戶所提供的不一致資料作出跟進以建立準確的客戶檔案，並將客戶風險評估的適當紀錄與相關文件一同保存。

snapshot.en: Where the MSO ascertains that a customer has misled it about the purpose and intended nature, it should take prompt action to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如確定客戶就業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質誤導了它，應迅速採取行動，以識別是否有理由作出懷疑。

evidence.covers: 风险状况变化时更新评估

snapshot.en: As the customer risk profile will change over time, the MSO should review and update the assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring
snapshot.tc: 由於客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，該經營者應不時（尤其在持續監察期間）覆核及更新該評估

source_quotes.text: require their staff to keep proper records of CRAs together with relevant documents

topics.notes: 一项风险因素恶化时复核整体评级的具体场景可作以后深度练习；当前一般更新义务已测试，不另算独立重大缺口。

topics.topic: 实益拥有人识别、核实及筛查范围
covered_aspects: 识别25%以上权益的实益拥有人；按风险核对公开股权资料；政治人物及制裁筛查涵盖实益拥有人

snapshot.en: An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of a corporation's issued share capital is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地擁有或控制（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）法團已發行股本的25%以上的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is entitled to or controls, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of a partnership is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地有權攤分或控制合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人，是合夥的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: Depending on the associated risks, MSOs should corroborate ownership and shareholding information collected from the customer with publicly available information, such as annual returns.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據相關風險，使用公開資料（例如年報、重要控制人登記冊）核對從客戶收集的擁有權及股權資料。

snapshot.en: The name screening procedures for identifying PEPs must cover not only the customer but also any beneficial owners of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 用以識別政治人物的姓名篩查程序，須涵蓋客戶，以及客戶的任何實益擁有人。

evidence.covers: 制裁筛查不因低风险免除

snapshot.en: An MSO should screen its customers and any beneficial owners of its customers whatever risk profile it has attributed to the customer, low risk customers included.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應對其客戶及客戶的任何實益擁有人進行篩查，即使客戶被評定的風險狀況屬於低亦然。

source_quotes.text: The name screening procedures for the identification of PEPs must cover not only the customer, but also any beneficial owners of the customer.

topics.topic: 代表客户行事者的角色与授权
covered_aspects: 按角色和风险判断；法人一般至少一名代表；不能把代表误当客户；授权文件及部门一致性

snapshot.en: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
snapshot.tc: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

evidence.covers: 董事会决议等授权证明

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

evidence.covers: 客户与代表的区分及跨部门一致

snapshot.en: Among the deficiencies found, some MSOs failed to identify the corporate customer and treated the person purporting to act on its behalf as the customer instead.
snapshot.tc: 合規視察發現的缺失或不足之處，包括部分金錢服務經營者沒有識別公司客戶，並把看似代表客戶行事的人當成客戶處理。

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt a framework of procedures for assessing who would ordinarily be a PPTA for each customer segment, with each department setting its own approach and rationale.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取有系統的程序，評估每個客戶類別中通常被視為看似代表客戶行事的人，並由各部門自行訂定方法及理據。

source_quotes.text: each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA

topics.topic: 代表客户行事者须收集的最低识别资料
missing_aspects: 自然人代表的四类资料；法人代表的五类资料，含注册地点与主要营业地点

source_quotes.text: In the case of a natural person PPTA, (a) full name; (b) date of birth; (c) nationality; and (d) unique identification number and document type.
如看似代表客戶行事的人屬自然人，(a)全名；(b)出生日期；(c)國籍；及(d)獨特識別號碼及文件的類別。

topics.priority_reason: 具体身份识别义务存在空白，直接影响尽职审查的完整性。
topics.question_brief: 以自然人和法人代表的最低资料对照写一组组合题；避免只考客户本人的资料。
topics.notes: m6-343、m6-362涵盖代表的角色和授权，m6-341涵盖客户本人资料，均未直接测试代表的资料清单。与指引4.5.3的缺口合并补题。

topics.topic: 第三方支付的定义与洗钱风险
topics.locators: 第1页正文及注3；第6页结尾
covered_aspects: 第三方指客户之外的人；掩饰实益拥有人或资金来源；短期客户汇入风险；未识别明显警讯也会被调查

snapshot.en: Accepting payment from third parties exacerbates some MSOs' vulnerabilities, as criminals would attempt to use such payments to obscure the beneficial owner's identity or the source of illicit funds.
snapshot.tc: 由於罪犯可藉使用第三方支付進行交易以掩飾實益擁有人的身分或非法資金的來源，接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者有更大可能遭到利用。

snapshot.en: Among cross-boundary remittance services, the circular singles out outward remittance initiated by transient customers as one that could be exploited as a conduit for crime proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 通函特別指出，在金錢服務經營者提供的跨境匯款服務中，短期客戶要求進行的匯出服務可被利用作轉移犯罪得益的管道。

snapshot.en: A third party means any person other than the customer, and an MSO should exercise care if it suspects that a customer may be effecting a transaction on behalf of one.
snapshot.tc: 「第三方」指客戶以外的任何人；如懷疑客戶可能正為第三方進行交易，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

snapshot.en: An MSO that does not take reasonable steps to detect, or properly address, apparent red flags may be in breach of legal or regulatory requirements.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者若未有採取合理步驟，偵察明顯的可疑交易訊號或妥善處理該等訊號，便可能違反法律或規管性規定。

snapshot.en: The C&ED will investigate cases where MSOs appear to have failed to detect and act on red flags, not only those where they are suspected of knowingly facilitating third party payments.
snapshot.tc: 海關會調查金錢服務經營者看似未能偵察可疑交易訊號並作出相應行動的情況，而不只是有理由懷疑其明知而促成第三方支付的情況。

source_quotes.text: “third party” means any person other than the customer.
source_quotes.locator: 第1页正文及注3；第6页结尾

topics.topic: 第三方支付警讯清单
covered_aspects: 不符合客户活动；拆分交易概念；非居民街客的大额现金跨境款；无商业关系的代付；同一非受规管人获多客授权；无合理原因的频繁或大额代付
missing_aspects: 看似无关客户使用同一交易模式（例如转入同一个人账户）；客户不能应要求立即提供额外身份证明文件

snapshot.en: Large transfers to or from a place outside Hong Kong with instructions for payment in cash, made all the more suspicious where the originators or recipients are long-standing resident customers
snapshot.tc: 指示以現金支付從香港以外地方轉入或向香港以外地方轉出大額金錢，如匯款人或收款人是長期往來的居民客戶，則更為可疑

snapshot.en: Transactions which are carried out by the customer on behalf of a third party, where the customer has no appropriate business relationship with that third party
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的客戶代表第三方作出交易，但客戶與該第三方之間沒有適當的業務關係

snapshot.en: A large number of seemingly unrelated customers having authorised the same third party, who is not a regulated person or entity, to give instructions to the MSO through the business relationship
snapshot.tc: 多名看似沒有關連的客戶授權同一個並非受規管人士或實體的第三方，經由已建立的業務關係向金錢服務經營者作出指示

snapshot.en: Frequent or large fund transfers carried out by the customer which are funded by a third party without a credible commercial rationale or explanation
snapshot.tc: 客戶在沒有可信的商業理由或解釋的情況下，進行由第三方資助的頻繁或大額資金轉帳

snapshot.en: Transactions that cannot be reconciled with the usual activities of the customer, or that are incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer
snapshot.tc: 不符合客戶慣常活動的交易，或不符合金錢服務經營者對有關客戶的認知和經驗的交易

evidence.covers: 有关连操作须合并考虑尽调门槛

snapshot.en: An occasional transaction carried out in several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked calls for CDD measures beforehand if it involves $120,000 or more, or the equivalent in another currency.
snapshot.tc: 以金錢服務經營者覺得有關連的若干次操作執行、涉及$120,000或以上款額（或折算為其他貨幣的相同款額）的非經常交易，須事先執行客戶盡職審查措施。

source_quotes.text: a concentration of seemingly unrelated customers that share the same transaction pattern
客戶不能應要求立即提供額外的身分證明文件。

topics.priority_reason: 主要制度已有题，补齐执行条件或操作细节可避免只会原则。
topics.question_brief: 补两种尚未直接测试的警讯，配合已知情境辨别；不把所有第三方支付一律说成犯罪。
topics.notes: 拆分交易的尽调义务已在单元3测试，不能仅因通函清单未逐字复述而报完全缺失。

topics.topic: 第三方支付的接纳条件与政策
topics.locators: 主要管控措施第1–5项及注5
covered_aspects: 应认真考虑拒绝；无法妥善管控则不接纳；仅限特殊合法情况；严格管理层审批；政策清单、支持文件、自有账户安排

snapshot.en: An MSO that is unable to put in place adequate control measures to mitigate the inherently high risks of third party payments should not accept any third party payment.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如無法設立充分的管控措施以減低第三方支付本身附帶的高風險，便不應接受任何第三方支付。

snapshot.en: Third party payments should be accepted only under exceptional and legitimate circumstances, and when they are reasonably in line with the customer's profile and normal commercial practices.
snapshot.tc: 第三方支付應僅在特殊及合法情況下，以及在合理地符合客戶狀況和一般商業作業手法時，方可獲接納。

snapshot.en: To facilitate prompt identification of the sources of payments, MSOs are strongly encouraged to require customers to designate bank accounts held in their own names for all payments.
snapshot.tc: 為能盡早識辨支付資金來源，金錢服務經營者獲強烈鼓勵要求客戶指定其本人名下的銀行帳戶進行所有支付。

snapshot.en: MSOs should take reasonable steps to identify and establish the true and full identity of each customer and beneficial owner, and should refuse third party payments.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取合理步驟識別並確立每名客戶及實益擁有人的真實及全部身分，並應拒絕第三方支付。

snapshot.en: An MSO that accepts third party payments should put in place clear and detailed policies and procedures for scrutinising them, and ensure that their acceptance is subject to stringent management approval.
snapshot.tc: 接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者應設立清晰詳細的政策及程序予以審查，並確保須經過管理層嚴格審批方可接受第三方支付。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT Systems for third party payments should be approved by the MLRO, effectively communicated to all relevant staff members and enforced through robust compliance monitoring programmes.
snapshot.tc: 有關第三方支付的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應由洗錢報告主任審批、有效傳達所有有關職員，並經嚴格合規監察計劃執行。

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures on third party payments should address the exceptional and legitimate circumstances under which such payments may be accepted, and their evaluation criteria.
snapshot.tc: 有關第三方支付的政策及程序應處理第三方支付可獲接納的特殊及合法情況，以及其評估準則。

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures should address the enhanced monitoring of client accounts involving third party payments, and the reporting of any ML/TF suspicions identified to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 有關政策及程序應處理更嚴格監察涉及第三方支付的客戶帳戶，以及在識辨出任何懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況時向財富情報組報告。

snapshot.en: As an example of controls for identifying third party payments, MSOs should obtain supporting documents, such as bank statements and advice slips, from customers to ascertain whether payments came from third parties.
snapshot.tc: 作為識辨第三方支付的管控措施的例子，金錢服務經營者應向客戶取得證明文件（如銀行結單及通知書），以確定款項是否來自第三方。

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures on third party payments should address the respective designated managers or staff members who are responsible for carrying them out.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者有關第三方支付的政策及程序，應處理專責實施該等政策及程序的經理或職員的事宜。

source_quotes.text: Third party payments should be accepted only under exceptional and legitimate circumstances
source_quotes.locator: 主要管控措施第1–5项及注5

topics.topic: 第三方风险等级与额外审查情形
topics.locators: 主要管控措施第7–8项及注6–8
covered_aspects: 直系亲属和实益拥有人一般较低风险；高风险查资金来源；关系难核实或同一第三方服务多客时额外审查
missing_aspects: 较低风险例子中的客户联系公司及受规管金融机构未直接测试；支付前无法提供第三方身份资料的情形尚未直接测试

snapshot.en: Immediate family members of the customer, such as a spouse, parent or child, and its beneficial owners are examples of third parties generally considered to pose relatively low risks.
snapshot.tc: 客戶的直系親屬（例如配偶、父母或子女）及客戶的實益擁有人，均是一般可視為具有較低風險的第三方的例子。

evidence.covers: 高风险资金来源和额外审查

snapshot.en: MSOs should apply enhanced scrutiny to third-party payers which might pose higher risks, and establish the source of wealth of the relevant customer or beneficial owner involved in the corresponding transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應對具有較高風險的第三方付款人進行更嚴格的審查，並確立相應交易所涉客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源。

snapshot.en: MSOs should exercise extra caution where the relationship between the customer and the third party is hard to verify, or where a single third party is making or receiving payments for or from several seemingly unrelated customers.
snapshot.tc: 若客戶與第三方之間的關係難以核實，或一個第三方向數名看似沒有關連的客戶付款或從數名看似沒有關連的客戶收款，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

evidence.covers: 追加未曾使用的核实资料

snapshot.en: For example, where the relationship between the customer and the third party is hard to verify, the MSO should verify the third party's identity again against the identification documents it has already used.
snapshot.tc: 例如，若客戶與第三方之間的關係難以核實，金錢服務經營者應根據先前已用作核實的身分證明文件，再次核實第三方的身分。

source_quotes.text: beneficial owners or affiliated companies of the customers, or regulated financial institution.
source_quotes.locator: 主要管控措施第7–8项及注6–8

source_quotes.text: 客戶在進行支付前無法就第三方付款人的身分提供詳細資料作核實之用
source_quotes.locator: 主要管控措施第7–8项及注6–8

topics.priority_reason: 主要制度已有题，补齐执行条件或操作细节可避免只会原则。
topics.question_brief: 把较低风险第三方的范围与支付前资料不足放在同一组判断；较低风险不等于免审批。

topics.topic: 第三方支付尽调与资金来源
topics.locators: 主要管控措施第6–7项及注7
covered_aspects: 理由及必要性；第三方身份及关系；有相关职能的高层批准；查询与批准留痕；资金来源不只转出账户

snapshot.en: The due diligence process should include critically evaluating the reasons for and need for a third party payment, and taking reasonable measures, on a risk-sensitive basis, to verify the third party's identity and ascertain its relationship with the customer.
snapshot.tc: 盡職審查程序應包括嚴格評估使用第三方支付的原因及需要，並因應風險程度採取合理措施，核實第三方的身分及確定其與客戶之間的關係。

snapshot.en: MSOs should apply enhanced scrutiny to third-party payers which might pose higher risks, and establish the source of wealth of the relevant customer or beneficial owner involved in the corresponding transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應對具有較高風險的第三方付款人進行更嚴格的審查，並確立相應交易所涉客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源。

snapshot.en: The due diligence process for assessing a third party payment should include obtaining approval for its acceptance from senior management with a relevant AML/CFT role at the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 評估第三方支付的盡職審查程序應包括就接納該次支付，取得擔任打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集相關職位的高級管理層批准。

snapshot.en: The findings of enquiries made and the corroborative evidence obtained during the evaluation and approval of a third party payment should be properly documented.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應妥為記錄評估第三方支付期間取得的查詢結果、核對證據，以及接納該次支付的批准。

evidence.covers: 资金来源包含产生资金的活动

snapshot.en: Source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from where the funds may have been transferred, but should also cover the activity that generates them.
snapshot.tc: 追查資金來源時，所得資料不應僅限於了解資金從何轉帳，亦要知悉衍生該等資金的活動。

source_quotes.text: critically evaluating the reasons of and the need for third party payments;
source_quotes.locator: 主要管控措施第6–7项及注7

topics.topic: 第三方支付的持续监控、培训及客户沟通
topics.locators: 主要管控措施第9–12项及结尾
covered_aspects: 加强监察及定义警讯；有怀疑即报告；职员指引；记录与客户解释政策；覆核通函改进控制

snapshot.en: Identification of potentially suspicious transactions involving third party payments should prompt follow-up enquiries and further investigation, with an STR made to the JFIU once ML or TF has been confirmed.
snapshot.tc: 識辨出涉及第三方支付的潛在可疑交易時，應及時作跟進查詢及進一步調查，並在確定涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集後向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: Ongoing monitoring of transactions involving third party payments should be stepped up, and comprehensive red flags for such payments should be defined in the MSO's transaction monitoring system.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應加強對涉及第三方支付的交易的持續監察，而其交易監察系統應就第三方支付定義全面的可疑交易訊號。

snapshot.en: Staff responsible for evaluating whether a third party payment is acceptable should be given clear and sufficient guidance, including a list of third-party payers approved in advance by the C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 應向負責評估第三方支付是否可接納的職員提供清晰和充足的導引，當中包括經海關預先批核的第三方付款人名單。

evidence.covers: 记录、客户沟通和制度更新

snapshot.en: The findings of enquiries made and the corroborative evidence obtained during the evaluation and approval of a third party payment should be properly documented.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應妥為記錄評估第三方支付期間取得的查詢結果、核對證據，以及接納該次支付的批准。

snapshot.en: MSOs should clearly inform customers of their policies for handling third party payments, including requirements for customers to provide supporting documents to ascertain whether payments have come from third parties.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應清楚告知客戶其處理第三方支付的政策，包括客戶須提供證明文件以確定款項來自第三方的規定。

snapshot.en: MSOs are strongly advised to review the C&ED's advisory circulars, assess whether their AML/CFT Systems need any enhancements, and then adopt appropriate and effective control measures.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者獲強烈建議覆閱海關發出的忠告通函，評估其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度是否需要加強，並採取適當而有效的管控措施。

source_quotes.text: MSOs should clearly inform customers of their policies for handling third party payments.
source_quotes.locator: 主要管控措施第9–12项及结尾

topics.notes: 这些操作题目前在单元6已有直接练习，故全库计已覆盖。

topics.topic: 冒认网站及社交媒体欺诈的应对
covered_aspects: 保护个人资料及业务身份；提醒公众；向海关及警方报告

snapshot.en: Fraudulent websites and bogus social media advertisements impersonating MSOs' identities to carry out illegal money service operations or fraud are on an upward trend.
snapshot.tc: 越來越多欺詐網站和偽造社交媒體平台廣告仿冒金錢服務經營者，以經營非法金錢服務業務或進行欺詐。

snapshot.en: MSOs are reminded to take appropriate security measures to protect personal data and stay vigilant of any websites or social media platforms getting hold of their business information without their permission.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取適當的保安措施以保護個人資料，並對未經其批准取得其業務資料的任何網站及社交媒體平台保持警覺。

snapshot.en: If an MSO encounters a suspected fraudulent website related to its own business identity, the circular recommends that the MSO notify the public.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者遇到與其本身業務身分有關的疑似欺詐網站，該通函建議其向公眾發出通知。

snapshot.en: If an MSO encounters a suspected fraudulent website related to its own business identity, the circular recommends reporting it to the C&ED, the Police and the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者遇到與其業務身分有關的疑似欺詐網站，通函建議其向海關、香港警務處及個人資料私隱專員報案。

source_quotes.text: they are recommended to notify the public, and report the case to the C&ED and the Hong Kong Police force.

topics.topic: 定期申报周期、期限及电子提交
covered_aspects: 每半年两次；申报期与期限；电子提交并停止纸本；新增资料要求

evidence.covers: 期限、期次、系统及新增数据

snapshot.en: A licensee must lodge its periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year, unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在每半年開始後的兩星期內遞交定期申報表，除非關長透過通知書另作指定。

snapshot.en: Returns are lodged twice a year, not quarterly, and the first return of each year covers the transactions from 1 January to 30 June.
snapshot.tc: 定期申報表每年遞交兩次而非每季遞交，每年第一次涵蓋1月1日至6月30日的交易資料。

snapshot.en: New periodic returns must be submitted through the MSOS, and C&ED no longer accepts periodic returns submitted in paper form.
snapshot.tc: 新定期申報表須經牌照系統遞交，海關亦不再接受以紙本形式遞交的定期申報表。

snapshot.en: Licensees must give further information in the new return, including the jurisdictions involved in, and the delivery channels used for, remittances.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在新定期申報表提供額外資料，包括匯款交易所涉司法管轄區及匯款交易使用的交付渠道。

source_quotes.text: The new lodgement arrangement is on a half-yearly basis, i.e. 2 submissions per year

topics.notes: 遵循既有冲突决定；2025年首报过渡时间只是历史背景，不额外增加日期记忆题。

topics.topic: 定期申报附件的数据填报规则
missing_aspects: 兑换部分排除汇款金额；金额降序；交付渠道与客户类别比例各合计100%；尽调、强化尽调和拒绝交易数量；可疑报告与执法要求数量；提交日香港金钱服务业务的估计资产总值

source_quotes.text: Input the data related to MONEY CHANGING ONLY, excluding the amount involved in remittance transactions in Part 1
在第1 部，僅輸入貨幣兌換相關數據，不包括匯款交易金額

topics.priority_reason: 主要制度已有题，补齐执行条件或操作细节可避免只会原则。
topics.question_brief: 用两题分别考金额分类与比例、合规活动及资产填报口径；截图示例数值不当成要求记忆。
topics.notes: 已渲染英文PDF第3–5页核对截图。提取文本缺少截图内若干字段，逐字校验覆盖文本标注，图内字段按原页人工核对。

topics.topic: 旅客现金类物品电子预填及现场申报
covered_aspects: 超过12万港元或等值外币；出入境前预填、取得二维码、现场向关员出示；使用电子表格属受邀便利措施

snapshot.en: The E-form lets travellers, before arriving in or departing from Hong Kong, pre-fill information on CBNIs with a total value of more than HKD120,000 and obtain a QR code.
snapshot.tc: 電子表格供旅客在抵達或離開香港之前，預先填寫總價值高於12萬港元的現金類物品資料，以取得作申報用的二維碼。

snapshot.en: As MSOs' business may require them to declare CBNIs carried through the passenger channel, the C&ED invites them to use the E-form, which may reduce clearance time on the spot.
snapshot.tc: 鑑於金錢服務經營者的業務或需經旅客通道跨境運送現金類物品及申報，海關誠邀它們使用電子表格，以節省現場清關時間。

snapshot.en: Under the declaration procedures, after obtaining the QR code, the traveller presents it to a Customs officer on the spot to make the declaration.
snapshot.tc: 按電子表格的申報流程，旅客在預先填寫資料並獲取二維碼後，於現場向海關人員出示二維碼以完成申報。

source_quotes.text: Present the QR code to a Customs officer on the spot to make the declaration

topics.topic: 货币兑换商条例修订所提示的义务
covered_aspects: 修订及生效背景；兑换业务须注意交易单据和展示汇率义务

snapshot.en: According to the C&ED's reminder to MSOs, the MCO, Cap. 34, has been amended, with the amended Ordinance in effect from 24 August 2025.
snapshot.tc: 海關提醒金錢服務經營者，《貨幣兌換商條例》（第34章）已於2025年8月24日通過修訂並生效。

snapshot.en: Statutory obligations on transaction notes and rates display, set out in Schedules 2 and 3 to the MCO, are ones that MSOs carrying out money changing services should note.
snapshot.tc: 《貨幣兌換商條例》附表2及3內有關交易單據及展示匯率的法定責任，是經營貨幣兌換服務的金錢服務經營者需留意的。

source_quotes.text: statutory obligations relating to transaction notes and rates display

topics.notes: 这份通函没有逐项载明第34章附表的单据格式和展示细则；未把未归档的条例正文当作这23份资料内的遗漏。

topics.topic: 贸易洗钱手法及空壳公司风险
covered_aspects: 虚假合同发票；掩饰资金与实益拥有人；新设无实质经营实体；FATF风险指标来源

snapshot.en: TBML is the process of disguising the proceeds of crime and moving value through trade activities, in an attempt to legitimise their illegal origins or finance criminal activities.
snapshot.tc: 貿易洗錢為通過利用貿易活動掩飾犯罪得益或轉移價值的過程，以試圖合法化其非法來源，或為其非法活動提供資金。

snapshot.en: Recent TBML typologies involve the use of falsified trade documents, such as fake contracts and invoices, to create bogus transaction records.
snapshot.tc: 近期的貿易洗錢手法涉及使用偽造貿易文件（如假合同及發票），用於製造虛假的交易記錄。

snapshot.en: The risk indicators provided to enhance MSOs' ability to identify suspicious activities associated with TBML were designed by the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應參閱由聯合財富情報組設定的風險指標，以加強識別與貿易洗錢相關的可疑活動的能力。

snapshot.en: Domestic and foreign criminal activities would attempt to use shell companies and fabricated documents to obscure the identity of the beneficial owner or the source of illicit funds.
snapshot.tc: 境內外的犯罪活動可能會使用空殼公司及偽造文件來掩飾實益擁有人的身份或非法資金的來源。

snapshot.en: Newly established legal entities without significant assets, employees and/or active business operations pose much higher ML and TF risks, to which MSOs should pay attention.
snapshot.tc: 新成立而缺乏顯著資產、員工，及／或活躍業務運作的法律實體帶來較高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者應予注意。

source_quotes.text: falsified trade documents, such as fake contracts and invoices

topics.notes: 遵循E32和E35；外链FATF报告全文不属于本次23份本地资料。

topics.topic: 贸易洗钱的风险升级与尽调措施
covered_aspects: 多项指标升报高层；高风险强化尽调；考虑资金及财富来源；反欺诈核实；前两道防线培训

evidence.covers: 通函列明的升级与控制措施

snapshot.en: Where multiple risk indicators are present on customers, the cases should be flagged and escalated to the MSO's senior management.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶出現多項風險指標，金錢服務經營者便應將相關情況作出標記及上報至高級管理層。

snapshot.en: Besides having CDD policies that meet the statutory requirements, MSOs should apply enhanced due diligence requirements to each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 除制定符合法定規定的盡職審查政策外，金錢服務經營者應對每一名客戶均施加更嚴格的盡職審查要求。

snapshot.en: MSOs must obtain information on the source of funds and source of wealth of their customers in order to better understand their profiles.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者必須索取客戶的資金來源及財富來源的資料，以更有效了解客戶的狀況。

snapshot.en: MSOs should proactively consider anti-fraud procedures for scrutinising information obtained from customers, to verify the genuineness of transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應主動考慮採取反欺詐程序以審查由客戶所獲得的資料，從而核實相關交易的真實性。

snapshot.en: Adequate training and guidance to staff are needed to facilitate sufficient ML/TF risk awareness in both the first and second lines of defence.
snapshot.tc: 需有足夠員工培訓及指導，使第一及第二道防線均具備充足的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險意識。

snapshot.en: An MSO should review the existing CDD records of its customers on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events, under clear policies and procedures, especially on how often periodic reviews take place.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應定期及／或遇有觸發事件時覆核客戶的現存盡職審查紀錄，並應制訂清晰的政策和程序，尤應訂明定期覆核的頻密程度。

source_quotes.text: flagging and escalating cases to MSOs’ senior management where multiple risk indicators are present on the customers.

topics.topic: 贸易洗钱警报处理及可疑交易报告
covered_aspects: 警报不可无理关闭；决定是否报告时同时考虑汇款人和收款人资料；不限金额及已完成交易

snapshot.en: MSOs should not close the alerts generated by their transaction monitoring systems without sufficient justification and analysis.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者不應在沒有充分理由及分析的情況下，消除監察交易系統作出的警報。

snapshot.en: Once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an STR should be filed even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 知悉或懷疑一旦確立，即使沒有交易由或透過金錢服務經營者進行，也應提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: The obligation to report suspicions of ML/TF applies irrespective of the amount involved, and also covers attempted transactions.
snapshot.tc: 舉報懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的責任不論所涉金額均適用，並涵蓋試圖進行的交易。

snapshot.en: An MSO holding information on both the originator and the recipient should consider all of it in deciding whether to file an STR.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者掌握匯款人和收款人的資料時，應考慮所有有關資料以決定是否提交可疑交易報告。

source_quotes.text: The obligations also apply whether or not a transaction was actually conducted and cover attempted transactions.

topics.notes: 差距分析是制度改进背景；现有题已经直接测试主要操作义务，未要求逐个措辞重复出题。

topics.topic: FATF高风险、针对措施及加强监察的区别
covered_aspects: 高风险强化尽调及最严重情况针对措施；归档版本中的朝鲜、伊朗与缅甸区别；加强监察名单及风险分析措辞

evidence.covers: 分层、措施例子及本版名单

snapshot.en: The FATF calls on all members and urges all jurisdictions to apply enhanced due diligence to the countries identified as high-risk and, in the most serious cases, countermeasures.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求所有成員及促請所有司法管轄區對被識別為高風險的國家採取更嚴格的盡職審查，並在最嚴重的情況下採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: Besides the DPRK and Iran, Myanmar is also a jurisdiction subject to a FATF call for applying countermeasures to protect the international financial system.
snapshot.tc: 除朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗外，緬甸亦屬需遵從特別組織要求而採取針對措施的司法管轄區，以免國際金融體系受損。

snapshot.en: The countermeasures listed by the FATF include terminating correspondent relationships with DPRK banks and limiting business relationships with DPRK persons.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織列出的針對措施包括終止與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的銀行的代理關係，以及限制與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的人士的業務關係。

snapshot.en: The FATF requires its members to take into account, in their risk analysis, the information in its updated statement on jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求其成員在進行風險分析時，參考其發布的有關被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新聲明所載述的資料。

snapshot.en: MSOs are reminded that two jurisdictions, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Iraq, were newly added to the list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新名單加入了兩個司法管轄區，即波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那及伊拉克。

source_quotes.text: apply enhanced due diligence, and, in the most serious cases, apply countermeasures

topics.notes: 只确认2026-07-03归档通函的覆盖。名单和缅甸2026年10月条件会变化，正式发布前须核对当时官方版本；外交进度和历年日期不列优先补题。

topics.topic: 支付透明度修订的方向与时间
covered_aspects: 跨境支付信息透明度；防止欺诈与错误；目标实施时间是2030年底

evidence.covers: 修订方向与未来实施期限

snapshot.en: The FATF agreed in June 2025 to revise Recommendation 16 so that it keeps pace with changes in the payment landscape.
snapshot.tc: FATF在2025年6月通過修訂第16項建議，使該建議與支付格局的變化同步。

snapshot.en: The revisions increase the transparency of information accompanying cross-border payments and require tools to protect against fraud and error.
snapshot.tc: 第16項建議的修訂將提升跨境支付資訊的透明度，並要求引入防止詐騙及錯誤的工具。

snapshot.en: The end of 2028 is the date by which all jurisdictions around the world are expected to be ready to implement the changes.
snapshot.tc: 全球各司法區預計需在2028年底前，完成實施經修訂的第16項建議所帶來的相關變更。

source_quotes.text: All jurisdictions around the world are expected to be ready to implement the changes by the end of 2030.

topics.notes: 这是未来标准与咨询背景，不能写成当时已对MSO生效的本地新义务。

topics.topic: 支付透明度咨询的议题范围
covered_aspects: 新支付方式，包括电子钱包和移动支付
missing_aspects: 防误付及三种校正检查选项的咨询议题；数据保护与隐私的协调

snapshot.en: Feedback is invited on whether the guidance gives sufficient clarity on how Recommendation 16 applies to digital wallets and mobile money.
snapshot.tc: FATF邀請的意見範圍包括指引是否清晰說明第16項建議如何適用於電子錢包與移動支付等新興支付方式。

source_quotes.text: Implementing Recommendation 16 and meeting data protection and privacy requirements together.
落實第16項建議並同時符合資料保護及隱私的要求。

topics.priority_reason: 属于咨询或补充背景，收益低于现行核心义务。
topics.question_brief: 若扩大背景练习，再补咨询所讨论的范围；不把草案中的工具写成现行强制要求。
topics.notes: 低优先级、可不补；咨询回复期限依E25不应作为考点。

topics.topic: 咨询回复日期与联系方式

evidence.covers: 现有题仍测试已过的咨询截止日期及抄送邮箱

snapshot.en: The circular asks those interested in giving feedback to send their response by 21 August 2026, with a copy to mso_feedback@customs.gov.hk.
snapshot.tc: 通函請有意回應者於2026年8月21日前提交回覆並抄送mso_feedback@customs.gov.hk。

source_quotes.text: send your response by 21 August 2026, with a copy to mso_feedback@customs.gov.hk.

topics.notes: E25明确判定不是考试内容且日期已过。此处是既有题的范围收缩建议，不是补题缺口；待后续修题时替换该句，不在本次修改。

¶4.16.2(d): specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations; TC: 專門化的國家、國際、非政府及商業機構
doubts: Both true against their own official texts. EN explicitly says recent; TC source does not add a recency word. The item preserves each edition and does not test that difference.

False in both languages: the named issuer is CCE/關長, not JFIU/聯合財富情報組. The list-specific stem prevents substituting another body's publications.

EN or and TC 及 match their respective source editions. TC naturally enumerates organisation categories; it does not require a publication jointly issued by every category. No second defensible truth reading.

existing.en: For more red flag indicators, reference can be made to relevant guidance issued from time to time by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities.
existing.tc: 如需了解可疑交易及活動指標的詳情，可參考特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關導引。

existing.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Guidance for Money Service Operators in Detecting Terrorist Financing”.
existing.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《金錢服務經營者偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。

existing.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the “Yearly ML/TF Typologies Report” issued by the FATF.
existing.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集案例分析年度報告》。

existing.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers”.
existing.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《藉匯款和貨幣兌換供應商洗錢》。

existing.en: Details of the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions that the JFIU recommends are available on the JFIU's website.
existing.tc: 財富情報組推薦用以查問客戶、藉以識別可疑交易的有系統方法，其詳情可於財富情報組網站瀏覽。

candidates.topic: 国际货币基金组织、世界银行、埃格蒙特集团等可信来源
candidates.reason: 三机构作为可信来源已直接成题；不从外部资料扩写其机构职权。

existing.en: The credible sources that identify jurisdictions of greater vulnerability may include the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group
existing.tc: 用以識別具有較大漏洞的司法管轄區的可靠消息來源，可包括國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織

candidates.topic: 司法管辖区对等评估四类资料：地区组织／特別组织／关长／其他机构
candidates.reason: 现有m6-371只测评估责任及定期／触发复核，并未逐项测试四类考量。本题按第6单元的客户尽调操作归类，避免把机构名称硬塞入第1单元。

existing.en: Whether a jurisdiction outside the FATF membership imposes requirements similar to those under Schedule 2, and so counts as an equivalent jurisdiction, is a matter the CCE assesses and decides.
existing.tc: 特別組織成員以外的司法管轄區是否施加類似附表2所施加的規定、從而屬對等司法管轄區，是由關長評估及斷定的事宜。

existing.en: As a jurisdiction's AML/CFT regime will change over time, an MSO should review its jurisdictional equivalence assessment on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events.
existing.tc: 鑑於司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度會隨時間而改變，金錢服務經營者應定期及／或遇有觸發事件時覆核對等評估。

candidates.topic: 保安局局长／联合国委员会、警方／海关的法定职责
candidates.reason: 已有主体错误陷阱及许可／指定题；无需重复。

existing.en: The OSCO empowers officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Independent Commission Against Corruption to investigate organized crime and triad activities.
existing.tc: 調查有組織罪行及三合會活動的權力，由《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予香港警方及廉政公署人員。

existing.en: Among the provisions of particular relevance to MSOs, one empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property.
existing.tc: 在與金錢服務經營者尤其相關的條文中，其中一項授權保安局局長凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產。

existing.en: Where a UNSC Committee designates a person as a terrorist, the Secretary for Security may publish a notice in the Gazette specifying the person's name.
existing.tc: 凡聯合國安全理事會的委員會指定某人為恐怖分子，保安局局長可在憲報刊登公告指明該人的姓名。

existing.en: An MSO seeking a licence from the Secretary for Security, for example to pay a designated party's reasonable living expenses, should write to the Security Bureau.
existing.tc: 金錢服務經營者如尋求保安局局長批予特許，例如向指定各方支付合理生活開支，須向保安局提出書面申請。

candidates.topic: 邮政署署长及其他金融行业有关当局对应
candidates.reason: 直接服务金钱服务经营者的关长职责已有覆盖；余项属于边界名词或其他行业，不为达到题数而增设。

existing.en: The AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs, and gives the JFIU powers to supervise compliance with these and the AMLO's other requirements.
existing.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》向金錢服務經營者施加盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定，並賦予財富情報組權力監督該等及其他規定的合規情況。

limits: 两道新题已完成独立盲答并加入当前题库；候选清单的判断仍对应补题前基线。
英文第4.16.2(a)有recent，中文对应项没有近期；新题各自忠实官方原文，不以语言差异设陷阱。
没有归档证据支持另行编造FATF、APG或JFIU职责。
